16.22.m: The king in whose realm a brahmin wastes away from hunger— / that kingdom of his quickly collapses in a hundred pieces.

16.22.s:
yadrājā kurute pāpaṃ pramādādyacca vibhramāt ..
vasanto brāhmaṇā rāṣṭre śrotriyāḥ śamayanti tat .. 97 ..
16.22.d:
यद्राजा कुरुते पापं प्रमादाद्यच्च विभ्रमात् ..
वसन्तो ब्राह्मणा राष्ट्रे श्रोत्रियाः शमयन्ति तत् .. 97 ..
16.22.m: Whatever sin a king commits through negligence or through delusion, / the Vedic brahmins residing in the kingdom appease it.

16.22.s:
pūrvarātrāṃtarātreṣu dvijairyasya vidhīyate ..
sa rājā saha rāṣṭreṇa vardhate brahmatejasā .. 98 ..
16.22.d:
पूर्वरात्रांतरात्रेषु द्विजैर्यस्य विधीयते ..
स राजा सह राष्ट्रेण वर्धते ब्रह्मतेजसा .. 98 ..
16.22.m: [The king] for whom rites are performed by the twice-born in the early hours and at midnight— / that king, along with his realm, prospers through brahminical radiance.

16.22.s:
brāhmaṇānpūjayennityaṃ prātarutthāya bhūmipaḥ ..
brāhmaṇānāṃ prasādena dīvyanti divi devatāḥ .. 99 ..
16.22.d:
ब्राह्मणान्पूजयेन्नित्यं प्रातरुत्थाय भूमिपः ..
ब्राह्मणानां प्रसादेन दीव्यन्ति दिवि देवताः .. 99 ..
16.22.m: Rising early in the morning, the king should constantly honor brahmins. / By the grace of brahmins, the gods sport in heaven.

16.22.s:
atha kiṃ bahunoktena brāhmaṇā māmakī tanuḥ ..
ye kecitsāgarāṃtāyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ kīrtitā dvijāḥ ..
tadūpaṃ devadevasya śivasya paramātmanaḥ .. 7.1.22.100 ..
16.22.d:
अथ किं बहुनोक्तेन ब्राह्मणा मामकी तनुः ..
ये केचित्सागरांतायां पृथिव्यां कीर्तिता द्विजाः ..
तदूपं देवदेवस्य शिवस्य परमात्मनः .. 7.1.22.100 ..
16.22.m: Now, what is the use of speaking at length? The brahmins are my own body. / Whatever twice-born are celebrated on this ocean-girdled earth, / they are the form of the supreme self, Śiva, the god of gods.

16.22.s:
etāndviṣaṃti ye mūḍhā brāhmaṇānsaṃśitavratān ..
te māṃ dviṣaṃti vai nūnaṃ pūjanātpūjayanti mām.. 101 ..
16.22.d:
एतान्द्विषंति ये मूढा ब्राह्मणान्संशितव्रतान् ..
ते मां द्विषंति वै नूनं पूजनात्पूजयन्ति माम्.. 101 ..
16.22.m: Those fools who hate these brahmins of strict vows / surely hate me; and by honoring them, they honor me.

16.22.s:
na pradveṣastataḥ kāryo brāhmaṇeṣu vijānatā ..
pradveṣeṇāśu naśyanti brahmaśāpahatā narāḥ .. 102 ..
16.22.d:
न प्रद्वेषस्ततः कार्यो ब्राह्मणेषु विजानता ..
प्रद्वेषेणाशु नश्यन्ति ब्रह्मशापहता नराः .. 102 ..
16.22.m: Therefore, one who knows should bear no hostility toward brahmins. / Through hatred, men struck down by a brahmin's curse quickly perish.

16.22.s:
ityevaṃ kathitaścandra brāhmaṇānāṃ guṇārṇavaḥ ..
kuruṣvānantaraṃ kāryyaṃ yadbravīmyahameva te .. 103 ..
16.22.d:
इत्येवं कथितश्चन्द्र ब्राह्मणानां गुणार्णवः ..
कुरुष्वानन्तरं कार्य्यं यद्ब्रवीम्यहमेव ते .. 103 ..
16.22.m: Thus, O Moon, has this ocean of the brahmins' virtues been proclaimed. / Next, perform the task that I myself tell you.

16.22.s:
śāpasyānugraho datto mayā tava niśākara ..
na cānyathā vacaḥ karttuṃ śakyaṃ teṣāṃ drijanmanām .. 104 ..
16.22.d:
शापस्यानुग्रहो दत्तो मया तव निशाकर ..
न चान्यथा वचः कर्त्तुं शक्यं तेषां द्रिजन्मनाम् .. 104 ..
16.22.m: Favor regarding the curse has been granted to you by me, O Maker of the Night; / yet the word of those twice-born cannot be annulled

16.22.s:
śāpānugrahadaiḥ sarvai devairapi savāsavaiḥ ..
tasmāccandra tvayā śoko naiva kāryo vijānatā .. 1085 ..
kṣayaste bhavitā pakṣaṃ pakṣaṃ vṛddhirbhaviṣyati ..
athānyadvacanaṃ candra śṛṇu kāryaṃ yathā tvayā .. 106 ..
idaṃ yatsāgaropāṃte tiṣṭhate liṃgamuttamam ..
dharāmadhyagataṃ tacca devānāṃ dṛṣṭigocaram .. 107 ..
kukkuṭāṃḍasamaprakhyaṃ sarpamekhalamaṃḍitam ..
mamādyaṃ paramaṃ tejo na cānyo veda kaścana .. 108 ..
itaḥ sāgaramadhye tu dhanuṣāṃ ca śatatraye ..
tiṣṭhate tatra liṃgaṃ tu suguptaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam .. 109 ..
ādikalpe maharṣīṇāṃ śāpena patitaṃ mama ..
liṃgaṃ sāgaramadhye tu tattvaṃ śīghraṃ samānaya .. 7.1.22.110 ..
sparśākhyaṃ yatra me liṃgaṃ tatra sthāne niveśaya ..
niveśya tu prayatnena sahito viśvakarmaṇā .. 111 ..
16.22.d:
शापानुग्रहदैः सर्वै देवैरपि सवासवैः ..
तस्माच्चन्द्र त्वया शोको नैव कार्यो विजानता .. 1085 ..
क्षयस्ते भविता पक्षं पक्षं वृद्धिर्भविष्यति ..
अथान्यद्वचनं चन्द्र शृणु कार्यं यथा त्वया .. 106 ..
इदं यत्सागरोपांते तिष्ठते लिंगमुत्तमम् ..
धरामध्यगतं तच्च देवानां दृष्टिगोचरम् .. 107 ..
कुक्कुटांडसमप्रख्यं सर्पमेखलमंडितम् ..
ममाद्यं परमं तेजो न चान्यो वेद कश्चन .. 108 ..
इतः सागरमध्ये तु धनुषां च शतत्रये ..
तिष्ठते तत्र लिंगं तु सुगुप्तं लक्षणान्वितम् .. 109 ..
आदिकल्पे महर्षीणां शापेन पतितं मम ..
लिंगं सागरमध्ये तु तत्त्वं शीघ्रं समानय .. 7.1.22.110 ..
स्पर्शाख्यं यत्र मे लिंगं तत्र स्थाने निवेशय ..
निवेश्य तु प्रयत्नेन सहितो विश्वकर्मणा .. 111 ..
16.22.m:
even by all the gods together with Indra, who grant curses and favors. / Therefore, O Moon, you who understand must not grieve at all.
You shall have waning for one fortnight, and waxing for one fortnight. / Now hear another word, O Moon, concerning what you must do.
This supreme liṅga that stands on the shore of the ocean, / situated at the center of the earth, visible to the gods,
resembling a hen's egg, adorned with a snake-girdle, / is my primordial, supreme light; and no one else knows it.
From here, however, in the midst of the ocean, at a distance of three hundred bows, / there stands a liṅga, well concealed, endowed with auspicious marks. // 109
In the primeval kalpa, it fell by the curse of the great seers. / Bring that liṅga of mine swiftly from the midst of the ocean. // 110
Install it in that place where my liṅga called Sparśa stands. / Having installed it with care, together with Viśvakarman, // 111

16.22.s:
tato brahmāṇamāhūya sametaṃ tu munīśvaraiḥ ..
pratiṣṭhāṃ kāraya vibho iṣṭvā tatra mahāmakhaiḥ .. 112 ..
evamuktvā sa bhagavāṃstatraivāṃtaradhīyata ..
tataḥ prabhāṃ punarlebhe rātrinātho varānane .. 113 ..
tataḥ prabhṛti tatkṣetraṃ prabhāsamiti viśrutam ..
niṣprabhasya prabhā dattā prabhāsaṃ tena cocyate .. 114 ..
dakṣasya tu vṛthā śāpo na kṛtastena lāṃchanam ..
somaḥ prabhāsate lokānvaraṃ prāpya maheśvarāt ..
vyaktībhūtaḥ sa deveśaḥ somasyaiva mahātmanaḥ .. 115 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye somavarapradānavarṇanaṃnāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. .. 22 ..
16.22.d:
ततो ब्रह्माणमाहूय समेतं तु मुनीश्वरैः ..
प्रतिष्ठां कारय विभो इष्ट्वा तत्र महामखैः .. 112 ..
एवमुक्त्वा स भगवांस्तत्रैवांतरधीयत ..
ततः प्रभां पुनर्लेभे रात्रिनाथो वरानने .. 113 ..
ततः प्रभृति तत्क्षेत्रं प्रभासमिति विश्रुतम् ..
निष्प्रभस्य प्रभा दत्ता प्रभासं तेन चोच्यते .. 114 ..
दक्षस्य तु वृथा शापो न कृतस्तेन लांछनम् ..
सोमः प्रभासते लोकान्वरं प्राप्य महेश्वरात् ..
व्यक्तीभूतः स देवेशः सोमस्यैव महात्मनः .. 115 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सोमवरप्रदानवर्णनंनाम द्वाविंशोऽध्यायः.. .. 22 ..
16.22.m:
then summon Brahmā, together with the lords of sages, / and perform the consecration, O powerful one, having sacrificed there with great sacrifices.” // 112
Having spoken thus, the Lord vanished right there. / Then the lord of the night regained his radiance, O fair-faced woman. // 113
From then on, that sacred field has been famed as Prabhāsa. / Splendor (prabhā) was granted to the lusterless one; therefore it is called Prabhāsa. // 114
Dakṣa's curse, however, was not made void; by it a mark remained. / Having obtained a boon from Maheśvara, Soma illuminates the worlds. / That Lord of gods became manifest to the great-souled Soma alone. // 115
Thus ends the twenty-second chapter, titled "Description of the Granting of the Boon to Soma," in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses]. // 22

16.23.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tataḥ śāṃtamanā bhūtvā caṃdramā vismayānvitaḥ ..
śaṃbhubhaktyā parītātmā prabhāsakṣetramāsthitaḥ .. 1 ..
16.23.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततः शांतमना भूत्वा चंद्रमा विस्मयान्वितः ..
शंभुभक्त्या परीतात्मा प्रभासक्षेत्रमास्थितः .. 1 ..
16.23.m: Īśvara said: / Then, his mind calmed and filled with wonder, / his being pervaded by devotion to Śambhu, the Moon remained in Prabhāsa sacred field. // 1

16.23.s:
pūrvoktaṃ yattu devena sa tathā kṛtavānvibhuḥ ..
gatvā sāgaramadhye tu gṛhītvā liṃgamuttamam .. 2 ..
16.23.d:
पूर्वोक्तं यत्तु देवेन स तथा कृतवान्विभुः ..
गत्वा सागरमध्ये तु गृहीत्वा लिंगमुत्तमम् .. 2 ..
16.23.m: The powerful one did just as had been previously spoken by the God: / going into the ocean, he took that excellent liṅga. // 2

16.23.s:
viśvakarmmāṇamāhūya sahitaṃ paricārakaiḥ ..
ādideśa svayaṃ somastvaṣṭāraṃ devaśilpinam.. 3 ..
16.23.d:
विश्वकर्म्माणमाहूय सहितं परिचारकैः ..
आदिदेश स्वयं सोमस्त्वष्टारं देवशिल्पिनम्.. 3 ..
16.23.m: Summoning Viśvakarman along with his attendants, / Soma himself commanded Tvaṣṭṛ, the artisan of the gods: // 3

16.23.s:
.. caṃdra uvāca .. ..
viśvakarmannidaṃ liṃgaṃ mama dattaṃ tu śaṃbhunā ..
gṛhāṇa tvaṃ mahābāho yuktasthāne niveśaya .. 4 ..
16.23.d:
.. चंद्र उवाच .. ..
विश्वकर्मन्निदं लिंगं मम दत्तं तु शंभुना ..
गृहाण त्वं महाबाहो युक्तस्थाने निवेशय .. 4 ..
16.23.m: The Moon said: / “O Viśvakarman, this liṅga was given to me by Śambhu. / Take it, O mighty-armed one, and install it in a suitable place. // 4

16.23.s:
rakṣasva tāvadgantāsmi svakīyaṃ bhavanaṃ vibho ..
yajñārthamānayiṣyāmi yajñopakaraṇāni ca .. 5 ..
16.23.d:
रक्षस्व तावद्गन्तास्मि स्वकीयं भवनं विभो ..
यज्ञार्थमानयिष्यामि यज्ञोपकरणानि च .. 5 ..
16.23.m: Protect it meanwhile; I must go to my own abode, O powerful one. / I shall bring the utensils for the sacrifice for the sake of the sacrifice.” // 5

16.23.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
ityuktvā ca tadā caṃdraścaṃdra lokaṃ jagāma ha..
gatvā tatra mahādevi caṃdralokaṃmahāprabham..6..
16.23.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
इत्युक्त्वा च तदा चंद्रश्चंद्र लोकं जगाम ह..
गत्वा तत्र महादेवि चंद्रलोकंमहाप्रभम्..6..
16.23.m: Īśvara said: / Having spoken thus, the Moon then went to the realm of the Moon. / Having gone to the realm of the Moon, possessing great radiance, O great goddess, // 6

16.23.s:
koṭiyojanavistīrṇaṃ sadāmṛtamayaṃ śubham..
tatrāhūya mahādevi pratīhāraṃ sumedhasam .. 7 ..
16.23.d:
कोटियोजनविस्तीर्णं सदामृतमयं शुभम्..
तत्राहूय महादेवि प्रतीहारं सुमेधसम् .. 7 ..
16.23.m: which extends ten million yojanas, is ever filled with nectar, and is auspicious, / and having summoned there, O great goddess, his intelligent door-keeper, // 7

16.23.s:
maṃtriṇaṃ hemagarbhāṃgaṃ bṛhaspatisamaṃ dhiyā ..
yajñopaskarasaṃbhāraṃ sarvamādāya satvarāḥ .. 8 ..
16.23.d:
मंत्रिणं हेमगर्भांगं बृहस्पतिसमं धिया ..
यज्ञोपस्करसंभारं सर्वमादाय सत्वराः .. 8 ..
16.23.m: [and] his minister whose body is golden-wombed, equal in intellect to Bṛhaspati: / “Quickly taking all the assembly of equipment for the sacrifice, // 8

16.23.s:
prabhāsakṣetraṃ gacchaṃtu mamādeśaparāyaṇāḥ ..
sāgnibhirbrāhmaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ gacchaṃtu kṣetramuttamam .. 9 ..
16.23.d:
प्रभासक्षेत्रं गच्छंतु ममादेशपरायणाः ..
साग्निभिर्ब्राह्मणैः सार्द्धं गच्छंतु क्षेत्रमुत्तमम् .. 9 ..
16.23.m: let them go to the Prabhāsa sacred field, dedicated to my command. / Together with the brahmins who maintain the sacred fires, let them go to the excellent sacred field. // 9

16.23.s:
śīghraṃ saṃpādyatāṃ sarvaṃ yathā yajñaḥ pravartate ..
sarveṣāmeva viprāṇāṃ caṃdralokanivāsinām .. 7.1.23.10 ..
16.23.d:
शीघ्रं संपाद्यतां सर्वं यथा यज्ञः प्रवर्तते ..
सर्वेषामेव विप्राणां चंद्रलोकनिवासिनाम् .. 7.1.23.10 ..
16.23.m: Let everything be quickly accomplished so that the sacrifice proceeds. / To all the brahmins dwelling in the realm of the Moon, // 10

16.23.s:
pṛthakpṛthagvimānaṃ tu deyaṃ teṣāṃ mahādhanam ..
gavāṃ ca daśalakṣāṇāṃ savatsānāṃ payomucām .. 11 ..
16.23.d:
पृथक्पृथग्विमानं तु देयं तेषां महाधनम् ..
गवां च दशलक्षाणां सवत्सानां पयोमुचाम् .. 11 ..
16.23.m: an aerial chariot of great wealth must be given individually; / and a million cows, accompanied by their calves and yielding milk, // 11

16.23.s:
hemabhārairbhūṣitānāṃ kāmadhenūpamatviṣām..
aśvānāṃ śyāmakarṇānāṃ sapādaṃ lakṣameva ca .. 12 ..
16.23.d:
हेमभारैर्भूषितानां कामधेनूपमत्विषाम्..
अश्वानां श्यामकर्णानां सपादं लक्षमेव च .. 12 ..
16.23.m: adorned with loads of gold, with splendor equal to the wish-fulfilling cow; / and one hundred and twenty-five thousand black-eared horses; // 12

16.23.s:
daṃtināmayutaṃ caiva ghaṃṭābharaṇaśobhitam ..
sahasrāṇi ca catvāri rathānāṃ vātaraṃhasām .. 13 ..
16.23.d:
दंतिनामयुतं चैव घंटाभरणशोभितम् ..
सहस्राणि च चत्वारि रथानां वातरंहसाम् .. 13 ..
16.23.m: ten thousand tusked elephants adorned with bells as ornaments; / and four thousand chariots with the speed of the wind; // 13

16.23.s:
lakṣaṃ tu karabhāṇāṃ ca maṇimāṇikyasaṃyutam ..
sainyānāṃ koṭirekā tu caturaṃgabalānvitā .. 14 ..
16.23.d:
लक्षं तु करभाणां च मणिमाणिक्यसंयुतम् ..
सैन्यानां कोटिरेका तु चतुरंगबलान्विता .. 14 ..
16.23.m: one hundred thousand young camels equipped with jewels and rubies; / and one crore of troops endowed with the fourfold army; // 14

16.23.s:
agniśaucāni vastrāṇi brāhmaṇārthaṃ tathaiva ca ..
vibhūṣaṇāni divyāni ṛtvigarthaṃ śubhāni ca .. 15 ..
16.23.d:
अग्निशौचानि वस्त्राणि ब्राह्मणार्थं तथैव च ..
विभूषणानि दिव्यानि ऋत्विगर्थं शुभानि च .. 15 ..
16.23.m: fire-purified garments for the brahmins as well, / and divine, auspicious ornaments for the officiating priests; // 15

16.23.s:
nānābhakṣyāṇi bhojyāni pānāni vividhāni ca ..
lakṣaṃ karmakarāṇāṃ tu dāsīnāṃ lakṣameva ca .. .. 16 ..
16.23.d:
नानाभक्ष्याणि भोज्यानि पानानि विविधानि च ..
लक्षं कर्मकराणां तु दासीनां लक्षमेव च .. .. 16 ..
16.23.m: various pastries, foods, and diverse drinks; / one hundred thousand laborers, and one hundred thousand female servants. // 16

16.23.s:
dāruvaṃśāvadhi proktaṃ yatkiṃcitsvaṃ madājñayā ..
anyadyadbrāhmaṇā brūyustatsarvaṃ tatra nīyatām .. 17 ..
16.23.d:
दारुवंशावधि प्रोक्तं यत्किंचित्स्वं मदाज्ञया ..
अन्यद्यद्ब्राह्मणा ब्रूयुस्तत्सर्वं तत्र नीयताम् .. 17 ..
16.23.m: Whatever property from wood down to bamboo has been prescribed by my order, / and whatever else the brahmins may ask for—let all that be brought there. // 17

16.23.s:
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ tu yakṣagaṃdharvarakṣa sām ..
saptadvīpakṣitīśānāṃ saptapātālavāsinām .. 18 ..
16.23.d:
देवानां दानवानां तु यक्षगंधर्वरक्ष साम् ..
सप्तद्वीपक्षितीशानां सप्तपातालवासिनाम् .. 18 ..
16.23.m: To the gods, the Dānavas, the Yakṣas, Gandharvas, and Rakṣasas, / to the rulers of the earth of the seven continents, and to the dwellers in the seven subterranean realms, // 18

16.23.s:
nānānṛpasahasrāṇāṃ ghoṣaṇā kriyatāṃ muhuḥ ..
sarveṣāṃ ghoṣaṇā kāryā prabhāsāgamanaṃ prati .. 19 ..
16.23.d:
नानानृपसहस्राणां घोषणा क्रियतां मुहुः ..
सर्वेषां घोषणा कार्या प्रभासागमनं प्रति .. 19 ..
16.23.m: and to thousands of various kings, let proclamation be made repeatedly. / A proclamation must be made to all regarding coming to Prabhāsa.” // 19

16.23.s:
ityuktvā maṃtriṇaṃ tatra caṃdramāstvarayā'nvitaḥ ..
brahmalokaṃ sa gatavānyajñārthaṃ brahmaṇoṃtikam .. 7.1.23.20 ..
16.23.d:
इत्युक्त्वा मंत्रिणं तत्र चंद्रमास्त्वरयाऽन्वितः ..
ब्रह्मलोकं स गतवान्यज्ञार्थं ब्रह्मणोंतिकम् .. 7.1.23.20 ..
16.23.m: Having instructed his minister there in this way, the Moon, filled with haste, / went to Brahmā's world, to the presence of Brahmā, for the sacrifice. // 20

16.23.s:
so'pi caṃdramaso maṃtrī hemagarbho mahāprabhaḥ ..
somājñāṃ śirasā kṛtvā yajñasaṃbhārasaṃbhṛtaḥ ..21..
16.23.d:
सोऽपि चंद्रमसो मंत्री हेमगर्भो महाप्रभः ..
सोमाज्ञां शिरसा कृत्वा यज्ञसंभारसंभृतः ..21..
16.23.m: The Moon's minister too, the golden-wombed one of great luster, / placing Soma's command upon his head, equipped with the sacrifice's provisions, // 21

16.23.s:
prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgatya yajñārthaṃ yatnavānabhūt ..
tathaiva cāhvayāṃcakre bhūrbhuvaḥsvarnivāsinaḥ .. .. 22 ..
16.23.d:
प्रभासं क्षेत्रमागत्य यज्ञार्थं यत्नवानभूत् ..
तथैव चाह्वयांचक्रे भूर्भुवःस्वर्निवासिनः .. .. 22 ..
16.23.m: arrived at the Prabhāsa sacred field and exerted himself for the sacrifice. / And in the same way, he summoned the dwellers of the earth, intermediate space, and heaven. // 22

16.23.s:
śrutvā tu ghoṣaṇāṃ sarve śīghraṃ tatra samāyayuḥ..
raviyojanaparyaṃtaṃ kṣetramālokya tatra tat ..23..
16.23.d:
श्रुत्वा तु घोषणां सर्वे शीघ्रं तत्र समाययुः..
रवियोजनपर्यंतं क्षेत्रमालोक्य तत्र तत् ..23..
16.23.m: Hearing the proclamation, all arrived there quickly. / Having surveyed that sacred field extending to a yojana of the sun, // 23

16.23.s:
brāhmaṇāṃśca samāhūya somādhyakṣaṃ uvāca tān ..
yajñāṃgaṃ sarvamānītaṃ mayā somājñayā dvijāḥ ..
anaṃtaraṃ tu yatkṛtyaṃ bhavadbhistadvidhīyatām .. 24 ..
16.23.d:
ब्राह्मणांश्च समाहूय सोमाध्यक्षं उवाच तान् ..
यज्ञांगं सर्वमानीतं मया सोमाज्ञया द्विजाः ..
अनंतरं तु यत्कृत्यं भवद्भिस्तद्विधीयताम् .. 24 ..
16.23.m: and having summoned the brahmins, the superintendent of Soma said to them: / “All the sacrificial accessories have been brought by me at the command of Soma, O twice-born ones. / Whatever needs to be done next, let that be performed by you.” // 24

16.23.s:
ityuktā brāhmaṇāḥ sarve taponirdhūtakalmaṣāḥ ..
tatraiva dadṛśuḥ sarve tvaṣṭāraṃ devaśilpinam .. 25 ..
16.23.d:
इत्युक्ता ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे तपोनिर्धूतकल्मषाः ..
तत्रैव ददृशुः सर्वे त्वष्टारं देवशिल्पिनम् .. 25 ..
16.23.m: Addressed thus, all the brahmins, their impurities shaken off by austerity, / saw Tvaṣṭṛ, the artisan of the gods, right there. // 25

16.23.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tu dvijāḥ sarve liṃgaṃ dṛṣṭvā samīpataḥ ..
kathametaditi procurviśvakarmanbravīhi naḥ ..
kasmādatra sthitastvaṃ vai śilpikoṭisamanvitaḥ .. 26 ..
16.23.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा तु द्विजाः सर्वे लिंगं दृष्ट्वा समीपतः ..
कथमेतदिति प्रोचुर्विश्वकर्मन्ब्रवीहि नः ..
कस्मादत्र स्थितस्त्वं वै शिल्पिकोटिसमन्वितः .. 26 ..
16.23.m: Having seen him, and seeing the liṅga nearby, all the twice-born said: / “How is this? Tell us, O Viśvakarman! / Why do you stand here, accompanied by ten million artisans?” // 26

16.23.s:
.. viśvakarmmovāca .. ..
ahaṃ somaniyuktastu yukto'smi liṃgarakṣaṇe ..
tadājñāpālane yatnaḥ kriyate'to mayā dvijāḥ .. 27 ..
16.23.d:
.. विश्वकर्म्मोवाच .. ..
अहं सोमनियुक्तस्तु युक्तोऽस्मि लिंगरक्षणे ..
तदाज्ञापालने यत्नः क्रियतेऽतो मया द्विजाः .. 27 ..
16.23.m: Viśvakarman said: / “Appointed by Soma, I am engaged in guarding the liṅga. / Therefore an effort is being made by me, O twice-born ones, to carry out his command.” // 27

16.23.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
evaṃ śrutvā yadā viprā jñātvā sarvaṃ tu kāraṇam ..
caritā yajñakāryārthaṃ tataścakrurupa kramam .. 28 ..
16.23.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एवं श्रुत्वा यदा विप्रा ज्ञात्वा सर्वं तु कारणम् ..
चरिता यज्ञकार्यार्थं ततश्चक्रुरुप क्रमम् .. 28 ..
16.23.m: Īśvara said: / When the brahmins heard this and understood the whole reason, / they prepared themselves and then commenced the sacrificial rite. // 28

16.23.s:
tatra yojanaparyaṃtaṃ devānāṃ yajanaṃ śubham ..
taddevayajanaṃ kṛtvā patnīśālāṃ ca cakrire .. 29 ..
16.23.d:
तत्र योजनपर्यंतं देवानां यजनं शुभम् ..
तद्देवयजनं कृत्वा पत्नीशालां च चक्रिरे .. 29 ..
16.23.m: There was an auspicious sacrificial ground for the gods, extending for a yojana. / Having prepared that sacrificial ground of the gods, they also built the hall for the patron's wife. // 29

16.23.s:
havirddhānaṃ sadaścaiva uttarā vedireva ca ..
brahmaṇaḥ sadanāgnīdhrītyevaṃ sthānāni cakrire .. 7.1.23.30 ..
16.23.d:
हविर्द्धानं सदश्चैव उत्तरा वेदिरेव च ..
ब्रह्मणः सदनाग्नीध्रीत्येवं स्थानानि चक्रिरे .. 7.1.23.30 ..
16.23.m: They constructed the oblation-hall, the assembly shed, the northern altar, / the abode of the Brahman priest, and the fire-house—such places as these. // 30

16.23.s:
tatra yojanaparyaṃtaṃ yajñayūpāṃśca maṃḍapān ..
viśvakarmā cakārāśu kuṃḍāni vividhāni ca .. 31 ..
16.23.d:
तत्र योजनपर्यंतं यज्ञयूपांश्च मंडपान् ..
विश्वकर्मा चकाराशु कुंडानि विविधानि च .. 31 ..
16.23.m: Extending over a yojana, sacrificial posts, pavilions, / and various sacrificial pits Viśvakarman swiftly fashioned there. // 31

16.23.s:
sahasrasaṃkhyayā tatra kuṇḍānāṃ maṃḍapāvadhi ..
tatra te brāhmaṇāḥ sarve pratiṣṭhāyajñakovidāḥ .. 32 ..
16.23.d:
सहस्रसंख्यया तत्र कुण्डानां मंडपावधि ..
तत्र ते ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे प्रतिष्ठायज्ञकोविदाः .. 32 ..
16.23.m: The fire-pits there numbered in the thousands, up to the pavilion. / There all those brahmins, skilled in the rites of consecration, // 32

16.23.s:
nānābharaṇaratnaiśca brāhmaṇāḥ samalaṃkṛtāḥ ..
cakruḥ sarve yathanyāyaṃ śāstraṃ dṛṣṭvā punaḥpunaḥ .. 33 ..
16.23.d:
नानाभरणरत्नैश्च ब्राह्मणाः समलंकृताः ..
चक्रुः सर्वे यथन्यायं शास्त्रं दृष्ट्वा पुनःपुनः .. 33 ..
16.23.m: well adorned with various ornaments and jewels, / did everything in accordance with proper rule, having consulted the treatise again and again. // 33

16.23.s:
vṛkṣāṃstathauṣadhīrdivyā samitpuṣpakuśādikān ..
homadravyādikaṃ sarva mājyaṃ prājyaṃ navaṃ payaḥ .. 34 ..
16.23.d:
वृक्षांस्तथौषधीर्दिव्या समित्पुष्पकुशादिकान् ..
होमद्रव्यादिकं सर्व माज्यं प्राज्यं नवं पयः .. 34 ..
16.23.m: [Collecting] divine trees and herbs, firewood, flowers, kuśa grass, and the like, / all sacrificial materials, plentiful ghee, and fresh milk;

16.23.s:
tathānyadapi yatkiṃcidyajñopakaraṇaṃ smṛtam ..
varddhanīkalaśādyaṃ ca sarvaṃ hemamayaṃ śubham .. 35 ..
16.23.d:
तथान्यदपि यत्किंचिद्यज्ञोपकरणं स्मृतम् ..
वर्द्धनीकलशाद्यं च सर्वं हेममयं शुभम् .. 35 ..
16.23.m: likewise whatever other paraphernalia of sacrifice is prescribed, / pitchers, jars, and other vessels, all made of auspicious gold;

16.23.s:
cakruḥ sarvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ pratiṣṭhāmakhamādṛtāḥ ..
tatra vipragaṇo hṛṣṭo bhakṣyabhojyāditarpitaḥ .. 36 ..
16.23.d:
चक्रुः सर्वं यथान्यायं प्रतिष्ठामखमादृताः ..
तत्र विप्रगणो हृष्टो भक्ष्यभोज्यादितर्पितः .. 36 ..
16.23.m: the respectful [priests] performed the consecration sacrifice in full accordance with the rules. / The company of brahmins there rejoiced, gratified with various types of food, sweetmeats, and delicacies.

16.23.s:
vedadhvanitanirghoṣairdivaṃ bhūmiṃ ca saṃspṛśan ..
suśubhe maṃḍapastatra patākābhiralaṃkṛtaḥ .. 37 ..
16.23.d:
वेदध्वनितनिर्घोषैर्दिवं भूमिं च संस्पृशन् ..
सुशुभे मंडपस्तत्र पताकाभिरलंकृतः .. 37 ..
16.23.m: Touching heaven and earth with the loud roar of Vedic chanting, / the pavilion shone resplendently there, decorated with banners,

16.23.s:
divyasiṃhāsanopeto muktādāmapariṣkṛtaḥ ..
divyacandanamālābhiḥ kalpapallavatoraṇaiḥ .. 38 ..
16.23.d:
दिव्यसिंहासनोपेतो मुक्तादामपरिष्कृतः ..
दिव्यचन्दनमालाभिः कल्पपल्लवतोरणैः .. 38 ..
16.23.m: furnished with divine thrones, adorned with strings of pearls, / with garlands of divine sandalwood, and with festoons of Kalpa-tree shoots,

16.23.s:
divyagandha sugandhādyaiḥ svargasthānamivābhavat ..
caturdaśavidhastatra bhūtagrāmaḥ samāgataḥ .. 39 ..
16.23.d:
दिव्यगन्ध सुगन्धाद्यैः स्वर्गस्थानमिवाभवत् ..
चतुर्दशविधस्तत्र भूतग्रामः समागतः .. 39 ..
16.23.m: and with divine fragrances and perfumes; it became like the realm of heaven. / The fourteen classes of living beings gathered there:

16.23.s:
sthāvaraḥ sarpajātiśca pakṣijātistathaiva ca ..
mṛgasaṃjñaścaturthaśca paśvākhyaḥ pañcamaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 7.1.23.40 ..
16.23.d:
स्थावरः सर्पजातिश्च पक्षिजातिस्तथैव च ..
मृगसंज्ञश्चतुर्थश्च पश्वाख्यः पञ्चमः स्मृतः .. 7.1.23.40 ..
16.23.m: inanimate beings, serpents, and likewise birds; / beasts of the wild are counted as the fourth, and domestic animals as the fifth;

16.23.s:
ṣaṣṭhaśca mānuṣaḥ proktaḥ paiśācaḥ saptamaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
aṣṭamo rākṣasaḥ prokto navamo yajña eva ca .. 41 ..
16.23.d:
षष्ठश्च मानुषः प्रोक्तः पैशाचः सप्तमः स्मृतः ..
अष्टमो राक्षसः प्रोक्तो नवमो यज्ञ एव च .. 41 ..
16.23.m: men are declared the sixth, and the piśāca class is taught as seventh; / rākṣasas are proclaimed the eighth, and sacrifices are the ninth;

16.23.s:
gāṃdharvaśākrasaumyāśca prājāpatyastathaiva ca ..
brāhmaśceti samākhyātaścaturdaśavidho gaṇaḥ .. 42 ..
16.23.d:
गांधर्वशाक्रसौम्याश्च प्राजापत्यस्तथैव च ..
ब्राह्मश्चेति समाख्यातश्चतुर्दशविधो गणः .. 42 ..
16.23.m: gandharvas, the deities of Indra's host, the saumyas, the prājāpatyas, / and the brāhmas—thus is the fourteenfold host declared.

16.23.s:
viśvedevāstathā sādhyā maruto vasavastathā ..
lokapālāstathāṣṭau ca nakṣatrāṇi grahaiḥ saha .. 43 ..
16.23.d:
विश्वेदेवास्तथा साध्या मरुतो वसवस्तथा ..
लोकपालास्तथाष्टौ च नक्षत्राणि ग्रहैः सह .. 43 ..
16.23.m: The Viśvedevas, the Sādhyas, the Maruts, and the Vasus, / the eight guardians of the world, and the lunar mansions along with the planets,

16.23.s:
brahmāṇḍe devatā yāśca tāḥ sarvāstatra cāgatāḥ ..
hṛṣṭāḥ prabhāsake kṣetre prārabdhe yajñakarmmaṇi .. 44 ..
16.23.d:
ब्रह्माण्डे देवता याश्च ताः सर्वास्तत्र चागताः ..
हृष्टाः प्रभासके क्षेत्रे प्रारब्धे यज्ञकर्म्मणि .. 44 ..
16.23.m: and whatever deities exist in the cosmic egg—they all arrived there, / rejoicing in the Prabhāsa sacred field when the sacrificial rite was undertaken.

16.23.s:
ghṛtakṣīravahā nadyo dadhipāyasakardamāḥ..
pakvānnānāṃ phalānāṃ ca rāśayaḥ parvatopamāḥ .. 45 ..
16.23.d:
घृतक्षीरवहा नद्यो दधिपायसकर्दमाः..
पक्वान्नानां फलानां च राशयः पर्वतोपमाः .. 45 ..
16.23.m: Rivers flowed with ghee and milk; their mire was curds and milk-rice. / Heaps of cooked foods and fruits rose like mountains;

16.23.s:
dṛśyante vividhākārāstasminyajñamahotsave ..
jagu(?)statraiva gandharvā nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ .. 46 ..
16.23.d:
दृश्यन्ते विविधाकारास्तस्मिन्यज्ञमहोत्सवे ..
जगु(?)स्तत्रैव गन्धर्वा ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः .. 46 ..
16.23.m: they were seen in diverse shapes at that great festival of sacrifice. / Gandharvas sang right there, and hosts of apsarases danced.

16.23.s:
bhakṣyabhojyaiśca vividhaiḥ kāmapānādibhistathā ..
tṛptā devāśca munayo bhūtagrāmāścaturdaśa .. 47 ..
16.23.d:
भक्ष्यभोज्यैश्च विविधैः कामपानादिभिस्तथा ..
तृप्ता देवाश्च मुनयो भूतग्रामाश्चतुर्दश .. 47 ..
16.23.m: With various types of food and delicacies, and desirable drinks, / the gods, sages, and the fourteen classes of beings were fully satisfied.

16.23.s:
evaṃ saṃbhārasahitaṃ yajñāṃgaṃ sarvameva hi ..
praguṇīkṛtya sacivo muktvā tatraiva rakṣakān ..
somasyāhvānanārthaṃ ca brahmalokaṃ jagāma ha .. 48 ..
16.23.d:
एवं संभारसहितं यज्ञांगं सर्वमेव हि ..
प्रगुणीकृत्य सचिवो मुक्त्वा तत्रैव रक्षकान् ..
सोमस्याह्वाननार्थं च ब्रह्मलोकं जगाम ह .. 48 ..
16.23.m: Having thus prepared every requisite component of the sacrifice together with all provisions, / the minister left guardians right there / and went to the world of Brahmā to invite Soma.

16.23.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
sa dṛṣṭvā brahmaṇaḥ pārśve sthitaṃ somamahāprabham ..
praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmau somaṃ brahmāṇameva ca .. 49 ..
16.23.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
स दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मणः पार्श्वे स्थितं सोममहाप्रभम् ..
प्रणम्य दण्डवद्भूमौ सोमं ब्रह्माणमेव च .. 49 ..
16.23.m: Īśvara said: / Seeing Soma of great brilliance standing beside Brahmā, / bowing down prostrate on the ground like a staff before Soma and Brahmā,

16.23.s:
kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā uvāca natakaṃdharaḥ ..
.. hemagarbha uvāca .. ..
bhagavanbhavadādeśādyajñāṃgaṃ sarvameva hi .. 7.1.23.50 ..
16.23.d:
कृतांजलिपुटो भूत्वा उवाच नतकंधरः ..
.. हेमगर्भ उवाच .. ..
भगवन्भवदादेशाद्यज्ञांगं सर्वमेव हि .. 7.1.23.50 ..
16.23.m: with folded hands and bowed neck, he spoke: / Hemagarbha said: / “O Blessed One, by your command every single part of the sacrifice

16.23.s:
tatra prābhāsike kṣetre mayā te praguṇīkṛtam ..
tatra brahmarṣayaḥ sarve tathā rājarṣayo'pare .. 51 ..
16.23.d:
तत्र प्राभासिके क्षेत्रे मया ते प्रगुणीकृतम् ..
तत्र ब्रह्मर्षयः सर्वे तथा राजर्षयोऽपरे .. 51 ..
16.23.m: has been prepared by me for you in the sacred field of Prabhāsa. / All the brahmin seers and other royal seers there

16.23.s:
tvanmārgaprekṣakāḥ sarve santiṣṭhante samākulāḥ ..
anantaraṃ tu yatkṛtyaṃ tadbhavānkartumarhati .. 52 ..
16.23.d:
त्वन्मार्गप्रेक्षकाः सर्वे सन्तिष्ठन्ते समाकुलाः ..
अनन्तरं तु यत्कृत्यं तद्भवान्कर्तुमर्हति .. 52 ..
16.23.m: are waiting anxiously, looking eagerly along your path. / You should now carry out whatever duty remains to be done.”

16.23.s:
.. .. īśvara uvāca .. ..
ityuktastu tadā candraḥ samudrasya sutena vai ..
prahasyovāca brahmāṇaṃ candramā lokasākṣiṇam .. 53 ..
16.23.d:
.. .. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
इत्युक्तस्तु तदा चन्द्रः समुद्रस्य सुतेन वै ..
प्रहस्योवाच ब्रह्माणं चन्द्रमा लोकसाक्षिणम् .. 53 ..
16.23.m: Īśvara said: / Being addressed in this way by the ocean's son, / the moon, smiling, then spoke to Brahmā, the witness of the worlds:

16.23.s:
bhagavansarvadeveśa mamānugrahakāmyayā ..
pratiṣṭhāyajñakāmasya mamātithyaṃ kuru prabho .. 54 ..
16.23.d:
भगवन्सर्वदेवेश ममानुग्रहकाम्यया ..
प्रतिष्ठायज्ञकामस्य ममातिथ्यं कुरु प्रभो .. 54 ..
16.23.m: “O Blessed Lord, ruler of all the gods, out of desire to grace me, / as I wish to perform the consecration sacrifice, accept my hospitality, O Lord!

16.23.s:
adya me saphalaṃ janma saphalaṃ ca tapaḥ prabho ..
devatvamadya me brahmaṃstvatprasādādbhaviṣyati .. 55 ..
16.23.d:
अद्य मे सफलं जन्म सफलं च तपः प्रभो ..
देवत्वमद्य मे ब्रह्मंस्त्वत्प्रसादाद्भविष्यति .. 55 ..
16.23.m: Today my birth has borne fruit, and my austerity has borne fruit, O Lord! / Today my godhood will come to pass by your grace, O Brahmā!

16.23.s:
mayā ca tapasogreṇa prāptaṃ liṃgamumāpateḥ ..
tatpratiṣṭhāvidhiṃ sarvaṃ tadbhavānkarttumarhati .. 56 ..
16.23.d:
मया च तपसोग्रेण प्राप्तं लिंगमुमापतेः ..
तत्प्रतिष्ठाविधिं सर्वं तद्भवान्कर्त्तुमर्हति .. 56 ..
16.23.m: Through fierce austerity I have obtained the liṅga of Umā's lord. / You should perform the entire rite of its consecration.”

16.23.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
avaśyaṃ tava karttāsmi pratiṣṭhāṃ śaṃkarātmikām ..
tvadārādhanaliṃge tu someśe'tiviśeṣataḥ .. 57 ..
16.23.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
अवश्यं तव कर्त्तास्मि प्रतिष्ठां शंकरात्मिकाम् ..
त्वदाराधनलिंगे तु सोमेशेऽतिविशेषतः .. 57 ..
16.23.m: Brahmā said: / “I shall certainly perform the consecration of the nature of Śaṃkara for you, / especially of Someśa, the liṅga of your worship.

16.23.s:
ye kecidbhavitāro vā atītā ye niśākarāḥ ..
teṣāṃ somānvayānāṃ ca sarveṣāmādyadaivatam .. 58 ..
16.23.d:
ये केचिद्भवितारो वा अतीता ये निशाकराः ..
तेषां सोमान्वयानां च सर्वेषामाद्यदैवतम् .. 58 ..
16.23.m: For whoever will be or have been the makers of the night (moons), / for all those belonging to the lunar lineage, this is the primal deity.

16.23.s:
yo'sau someśvaro deva ādau bhairavanāmabhṛt ..
manvantarāntare'tīte pratiṣṭhe'haṃ punaḥpunaḥ ..59..
16.23.d:
योऽसौ सोमेश्वरो देव आदौ भैरवनामभृत् ..
मन्वन्तरान्तरेऽतीते प्रतिष्ठेऽहं पुनःपुनः ..59..
16.23.m: This god Someśvara, who was called Bhairava in the beginning, / I consecrate again and again when one Manvantara passes after another.

16.23.s:
yadā prābhāsikaṃ kṣetre gato'haṃ cāṣṭavārṣikaḥ ..
āhūtaḥ pūrvamindreṇa bhairavasya pratiṣṭhite ..7.1.23.60...
16.23.d:
यदा प्राभासिकं क्षेत्रे गतोऽहं चाष्टवार्षिकः ..
आहूतः पूर्वमिन्द्रेण भैरवस्य प्रतिष्ठिते ..7.1.23.60...
16.23.m: When I, eight years of age, went to the sacred field of Prabhāsa, / summoned previously by Indra when Bhairava was consecrated,

16.23.s:
tatprabhṛtyeva me nāma bālarūpī nigadyate ..
anyeṣu sarvatīrtheṣu vṛddharūpī vasāmyaham ..61..
16.23.d:
तत्प्रभृत्येव मे नाम बालरूपी निगद्यते ..
अन्येषु सर्वतीर्थेषु वृद्धरूपी वसाम्यहम् ..61..
16.23.m: from that time forth my name is proclaimed as ‘the Child-Formed One’ (Bālarūpin). / In all other sacred fords I dwell in the form of an old man,

16.23.s:
prabhāse tu punaścaṃdra bālyāprabhṛti saṃvase ..
brahmāṇḍe yāni tīrthāni brāhmaṇāsteṣu ye smṛtāḥ ..62..
16.23.d:
प्रभासे तु पुनश्चंद्र बाल्याप्रभृति संवसे ..
ब्रह्माण्डे यानि तीर्थानि ब्राह्मणास्तेषु ये स्मृताः ..62..
16.23.m: but in Prabhāsa, O Moon, I reside continuously in childhood. / Whatever sacred fords exist in the cosmic egg, and whatever brahmins are renowned in them,

16.23.s:
teṣāmādyo niśānātha prabhāse'haṃ vyavasthitaḥ ..
kalpekalpe niśānātha mama nāmāṃtaraṃ bhavet..63..
16.23.d:
तेषामाद्यो निशानाथ प्रभासेऽहं व्यवस्थितः ..
कल्पेकल्पे निशानाथ मम नामांतरं भवेत्..63..
16.23.m: I, the foremost among them, am established in Prabhāsa, O lord of the night. / In every kalpa, O lord of the night, I have a different name:

16.23.s:
svayaṃbhūḥ prathame nāma dvitīye padmabhūḥ smṛtaḥ..
tṛtīye viśvakartteti bālarūpī turīyake ..64..
16.23.d:
स्वयंभूः प्रथमे नाम द्वितीये पद्मभूः स्मृतः..
तृतीये विश्वकर्त्तेति बालरूपी तुरीयके ..64..
16.23.m: ‘Svayambhū’ is the name in the first, ‘Padmabhū’ is remembered in the second, / ‘Viśvakartṛ’ in the third, and ‘Bālarūpin’ in the fourth.

16.23.s:
eṣāmeva parīvarto nāmnāṃ bhāvi punaḥpunaḥ ..
parārddhadvayaparyaṃtaṃ prabhāse saṃsthitasya me ..65..
16.23.d:
एषामेव परीवर्तो नाम्नां भावि पुनःपुनः ..
परार्द्धद्वयपर्यंतं प्रभासे संस्थितस्य मे ..65..
16.23.m: A repeated cycle of these very names will continue / as long as I remain established in Prabhāsa until the end of two parārdhas.

16.23.s:
ādisomena tatraiva śaṃbhornetrodbhavena vai ..
prabhāse tu tapastaptvā pratyakṣīkṛtaīśvaraḥ ..66..
16.23.d:
आदिसोमेन तत्रैव शंभोर्नेत्रोद्भवेन वै ..
प्रभासे तु तपस्तप्त्वा प्रत्यक्षीकृतईश्वरः ..66..
16.23.m: By the primal Soma, who was born from Śambhu's eye, / austerity was performed right there in Prabhāsa, and Īśvara was made visible.

16.23.s:
tato dadau varaṃ tuṣṭaḥ pūrvacandrasya śūladhṛk ..
yasmādārādhito'haṃ te soma bhaktyā cirantanam ..67..
16.23.d:
ततो ददौ वरं तुष्टः पूर्वचन्द्रस्य शूलधृक् ..
यस्मादाराधितोऽहं ते सोम भक्त्या चिरन्तनम् ..67..
16.23.m: Then the trident-bearer, pleased, gave a boon to that earlier moon: / ‘Because, O Soma, I have been worshipped by you with lasting devotion,

16.23.s:
tasmātsomeśanāmaivamasmim̐lliṃge bhaviṣyati ..
yāvadbrahmā śatānandaḥ prakṛtau na pralīyate .. 68 ..
16.23.d:
तस्मात्सोमेशनामैवमस्मिम्̐ल्लिंगे भविष्यति ..
यावद्ब्रह्मा शतानन्दः प्रकृतौ न प्रलीयते .. 68 ..
16.23.m: therefore the name Someśa shall belong to this liṅga, / as long as Brahmā Śatānanda does not dissolve back into Prakṛti.

16.23.s:
ye kecidbhavitāro vai rātrināthā niśākarāḥ ..
te madārādhanaṃ cātra kariṣyaṃti punaḥpunaḥ ..69..
ityuktvā bhagavāñchaṃbhustatraivāṃtaradhīyata ..
tasminkāle mayā soma ādyaṃ liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ..7.1.23.7...
16.23.d:
ये केचिद्भवितारो वै रात्रिनाथा निशाकराः ..
ते मदाराधनं चात्र करिष्यंति पुनःपुनः ..69..
इत्युक्त्वा भगवाञ्छंभुस्तत्रैवांतरधीयत ..
तस्मिन्काले मया सोम आद्यं लिंगं प्रतिष्ठितम् ..7.1.23.7...
16.23.m:
And whatever lords of the night and makers of the night shall come to be, / they shall worship me here again and again.’
Having spoken thus, the blessed Śambhu vanished right there. / At that time, O Soma, the primal liṅga was consecrated by me.

16.23.s:
tadāprabhṛti somānāṃ lakṣāṇāṃ dvitayaṃ gatam ..
sahasradvitayaṃ caiva śataṃ caikaṃ ṣaḍuttaram..71..
16.23.d:
तदाप्रभृति सोमानां लक्षाणां द्वितयं गतम् ..
सहस्रद्वितयं चैव शतं चैकं षडुत्तरम्..71..
16.23.m: Since then, two hundred thousand, / two thousand, and one hundred and six moons have passed.

16.23.s:
saptamastvaṃ mahāvāho varttase soma sāṃpratam ..
etāvantyeva liṃgāni pratiṣṭhāṃ prāpitāni me .. 72 ..
16.23.d:
सप्तमस्त्वं महावाहो वर्त्तसे सोम सांप्रतम् ..
एतावन्त्येव लिंगानि प्रतिष्ठां प्रापितानि मे .. 72 ..
16.23.m: You are now the seventh, O mighty-armed Soma! / So many liṅgas have been brought to consecration by me.

16.23.s:
eṣa evādhunā so'haṃ tadārādhanajaṃ phalam ..
pratiṣṭhātāsmi bhadraṃ te soma kṛtya mamaiva tat.. 73 .. ..
16.23.d:
एष एवाधुना सोऽहं तदाराधनजं फलम् ..
प्रतिष्ठातास्मि भद्रं ते सोम कृत्य ममैव तत्.. 73 .. ..
16.23.m: I am that very one now, [granting] the fruit arising from its worship; / I shall consecrate it—good fortune to you, Soma! That is my duty.”

16.23.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
ityuktvā bhagavānbrahmā vedavidyāsamanvitaḥ ..
sarvadevamayo devaiḥ sahitastīrthasaṃyutaḥ .. 74 ..
16.23.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
इत्युक्त्वा भगवान्ब्रह्मा वेदविद्यासमन्वितः ..
सर्वदेवमयो देवैः सहितस्तीर्थसंयुतः .. 74 ..
16.23.m: Īśvara said: / Having spoken thus, the blessed Brahmā, endowed with the lore of the Vedas, / containing all the deities, accompanied by the gods and joined by the sacred fords,

16.23.s:
sanatkumārapramukhai ryogīndrairṛṣibhiḥ saha ..
bṛhaspatiṃ samāhūya puraskṛtya purodhasam .. 75 ..
16.23.d:
सनत्कुमारप्रमुखै र्योगीन्द्रैरृषिभिः सह ..
बृहस्पतिं समाहूय पुरस्कृत्य पुरोधसम् .. 75 ..
16.23.m: together with lordly yogins and seers headed by Sanatkumāra, / summoned Bṛhaspati and placed the family priest at the head.

16.23.s:
haṃsayānaṃ samāruhya koṭibrahmarṣibhiḥ saha ..
āgataḥ somarājena tadā brahmā jagatpatiḥ .. 76 ..
16.23.d:
हंसयानं समारुह्य कोटिब्रह्मर्षिभिः सह ..
आगतः सोमराजेन तदा ब्रह्मा जगत्पतिः .. 76 ..
16.23.m: Mounting his swan vehicle, together with ten million celestial seers, / Brahmā, lord of the universe, then arrived with Soma, the king [of planets],

16.23.s:
prābhāsike mahātīrthe yatra dāruvanaṃ smṛtam ..
ṛṣitoyā nadī yatra mahāpātakanāśinī .. 77 ..
16.23.d:
प्राभासिके महातीर्थे यत्र दारुवनं स्मृतम् ..
ऋषितोया नदी यत्र महापातकनाशिनी .. 77 ..
16.23.m: at the great sacred ford of Prabhāsa, where the Dāruvana is remembered [to be], / where the river Ṛṣitoyā flows, destroyer of the greatest sins.

16.23.s:
asmiṃstīrthe prabhāse tu brahmabhāgaḥ sa ucyate ..
tridaivatamidaṃ kṣetraṃ mayā te kathitaṃ priye .. 78 ..
16.23.d:
अस्मिंस्तीर्थे प्रभासे तु ब्रह्मभागः स उच्यते ..
त्रिदैवतमिदं क्षेत्रं मया ते कथितं प्रिये .. 78 ..
16.23.m: In this sacred ford at Prabhāsa, that [part] is called the portion of Brahmā. / This sacred field belongs to three deities, as I have told you, my beloved.

16.23.s:
tatrāgatva caturvaktro brāhmabhāge'tinirmale ..
munīnākārayāmāsa unnata sthānavāsinaḥ .. 79 ..
16.23.d:
तत्रागत्व चतुर्वक्त्रो ब्राह्मभागेऽतिनिर्मले ..
मुनीनाकारयामास उन्नत स्थानवासिनः .. 79 ..
16.23.m: Having arrived there at the exceedingly pure portion of Brahmā, the four-faced [god] / summoned the sages residing in the elevated places.

16.23.s:
āyāṃtaṃ vedhasaṃ dṛṣṭvā devarṣigurusaṃyutam ..
te sarve pūjayāmāsuḥ saṃstavairvedasaṃmitaiḥ .. 7.1.23.80 ..
16.23.d:
आयांतं वेधसं दृष्ट्वा देवर्षिगुरुसंयुतम् ..
ते सर्वे पूजयामासुः संस्तवैर्वेदसंमितैः .. 7.1.23.80 ..
16.23.m: Seeing the Creator arrive together with the preceptor of the seers and gods, / they all worshipped him with eulogies conforming to the Vedas.

16.23.s:
athovāca dvijānsarvānbrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ..
ciramārādhya somena someśaṃ pāpanāśanam .. 81 ..
16.23.d:
अथोवाच द्विजान्सर्वान्ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः ..
चिरमाराध्य सोमेन सोमेशं पापनाशनम् .. 81 ..
16.23.m: Then Brahmā, grandfather of the worlds, addressed all the twice-born: / "Soma, having propitiated Someśa, the destroyer of sins, for a long time,

16.23.s:
tasminprasanne somena labdhaṃ liṅgamanuttamam ..
pratiṣṭhārthaṃ tu devasya āyātā dvijasattamāḥ .. 82 ..
16.23.d:
तस्मिन्प्रसन्ने सोमेन लब्धं लिङ्गमनुत्तमम् ..
प्रतिष्ठार्थं तु देवस्य आयाता द्विजसत्तमाः .. 82 ..
16.23.m: and he having become pleased, has obtained this unsurpassed liṅga. / O best among twice-born, you have come for the installation of the god.

16.23.s:
yathā mayā sadā kāryā pratiṣṭhā śaṃkarātmikā ..
bhavadbhiḥ parikāryā sā mama bhāgasamāśrayaiḥ .. 83 ..
16.23.d:
यथा मया सदा कार्या प्रतिष्ठा शंकरात्मिका ..
भवद्भिः परिकार्या सा मम भागसमाश्रयैः .. 83 ..
16.23.m: Just as the installation dedicated to Śaṃkara should always be performed by me, / so must it be performed by you who abide in my portion.

16.23.s:
yataḥ kopena bhavatāṃ liṃgaṃ prapatitaṃ bhuvi ..
pratiṣṭhā tasya kartavyā yuṣmābhirvai na saṃśayaḥ .. 84 ..
16.23.d:
यतः कोपेन भवतां लिंगं प्रपतितं भुवि ..
प्रतिष्ठा तस्य कर्तव्या युष्माभिर्वै न संशयः .. 84 ..
16.23.m: Since the liṅga fell down to earth because of your anger, / its installation must indeed be done by you without doubt."

16.23.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
gṛhītvā'tha munīnsarvānbrahmā lokapitā mahaḥ ..
ānītaḥ somarājena tadā brahmā jagatpatiḥ .. 85 ..
16.23.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
गृहीत्वाऽथ मुनीन्सर्वान्ब्रह्मा लोकपिता महः ..
आनीतः सोमराजेन तदा ब्रह्मा जगत्पतिः .. 85 ..
16.23.m:
Īśvara said:
Then taking all the sages, Brahmā, grandfather of the worlds— / Brahmā, the lord of the universe, was then led by Soma, the king,

16.23.s:
prābhāsike mahātīrthe sāvitryā sahitaḥ prabhuḥ ..
kārayāmāsa kuṇḍānāṃ maṇḍapānāṃ śataṃśatam .. 86 ..
16.23.d:
प्राभासिके महातीर्थे सावित्र्या सहितः प्रभुः ..
कारयामास कुण्डानां मण्डपानां शतंशतम् .. 86 ..
16.23.m: to the great sacred ford of Prabhāsa. Together with Sāvitrī, the lord / caused one hundred fire-pits and one hundred pavilions to be constructed.

16.23.s:
ekaike maṇḍape tatra cakre saptadaśartvijaḥ..
guruṇā prerito brahmā tatra devapurodhasā .. 87 ..
16.23.d:
एकैके मण्डपे तत्र चक्रे सप्तदशर्त्विजः..
गुरुणा प्रेरितो ब्रह्मा तत्र देवपुरोधसा .. 87 ..
16.23.m: In each pavilion he appointed seventeen officiating priests there; / urged by the preceptor, the priest of the gods, Brahmā

16.23.s:
pārśve sthitastadā brahmā vidhānairveda bhāṣitaiḥ ..
dīkṣayāmāsa somaṃ tu rohiṇyā sahitaṃ vibhum .. 88 ..
16.23.d:
पार्श्वे स्थितस्तदा ब्रह्मा विधानैर्वेद भाषितैः ..
दीक्षयामास सोमं तु रोहिण्या सहितं विभुम् .. 88 ..
16.23.m: stood at the side then, and initiated the lord Soma together with Rohiṇī / in accordance with the rites prescribed in the Vedas.

16.23.s:
patnīṃ ca rohiṇīṃ kṛtvā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutām ..
mṛgacarmadharāṃ devīṃ kṣaumavastrāvaguṃṭhitā m ..89 ..
16.23.d:
पत्नीं च रोहिणीं कृत्वा सर्वलक्षणसंयुताम् ..
मृगचर्मधरां देवीं क्षौमवस्त्रावगुंठिता म् ..89 ..
16.23.m: Having made Rohiṇī, who possessed all auspicious marks, the consecrated wife, / the goddess wearing an antelope skin, covered in a silk cloth,

16.23.s:
patnīśālāṃ samānītā ṛtvigbhirvedapāragaiḥ ..
caṃdramā dīkṣayā yukta ṛṣigaṃdharvasaṃstutaḥ .. 7.1.23.90 ..
16.23.d:
पत्नीशालां समानीता ऋत्विग्भिर्वेदपारगैः ..
चंद्रमा दीक्षया युक्त ऋषिगंधर्वसंस्तुतः .. 7.1.23.90 ..
16.23.m: was brought to the wife's chamber by the priests who had mastered the Vedas. / The moon, endowed with initiation, praised by seers and gandharvas,

16.23.s:
auduṃbareṇa daṃḍena saṃvṛto mṛgacarmaṇā ..
atīva tejasā yuktaḥ śuśubhe sadasi sthitaḥ .. 91 ..
16.23.d:
औदुंबरेण दंडेन संवृतो मृगचर्मणा ..
अतीव तेजसा युक्तः शुशुभे सदसि स्थितः .. 91 ..
16.23.m: holding an udumbara staff, wrapped in an antelope skin, / endowed with immense splendour, shone while seated in the assembly.

16.23.s:
tato brahmā mahādevi sarvalokapitāmahaḥ ..
ṛtvijāṃ varaṇaṃ cakre vedoktavidhinā tadā .. 92 ..
16.23.d:
ततो ब्रह्मा महादेवि सर्वलोकपितामहः ..
ऋत्विजां वरणं चक्रे वेदोक्तविधिना तदा .. 92 ..
16.23.m: Then, O great goddess, Brahmā, grandfather of all the worlds, / chose the officiating priests according to the Vedic rite.

16.23.s:
gururhotā vṛtastatra vasiṣṭho'dhvaryureva ca ..
tatrodgātā marīcistu brahmatve nāradaḥ kṛtaḥ .. 93 ..
16.23.d:
गुरुर्होता वृतस्तत्र वसिष्ठोऽध्वर्युरेव च ..
तत्रोद्गाता मरीचिस्तु ब्रह्मत्वे नारदः कृतः .. 93 ..
16.23.m: There the preceptor [Bṛhaspati] was chosen as the hotṛ, and Vasiṣṭha as the adhvaryu; / Marīci was the udgātṛ there, and Nārada was made the brahman priest.

16.23.s:
sanatkumārasaṃyuktāḥ sadasyāstatra vai kṛtāḥ ..
vastrairābharaṇairyuktā mukuṭairaṃgulīyakaiḥ .. 94 ..
16.23.d:
सनत्कुमारसंयुक्ताः सदस्यास्तत्र वै कृताः ..
वस्त्रैराभरणैर्युक्ता मुकुटैरंगुलीयकैः .. 94 ..
16.23.m: Members of the assembly, along with Sanatkumāra, were appointed there, / equipped with garments, ornaments, crowns, and rings,

16.23.s:
bhūṣitā bhūṣaṇaughena tasminyajñe tadartvijaḥ ..
caturṣu tajjñāścatvāra evaṃ te ṣoḍaśartvijaḥ .. 95 ..
16.23.d:
भूषिता भूषणौघेन तस्मिन्यज्ञे तदर्त्विजः ..
चतुर्षु तज्ज्ञाश्चत्वार एवं ते षोडशर्त्विजः .. 95 ..
16.23.m: adorned with a host of decorations in that sacrifice as priests for that purpose; / four experts were placed in each of the four [quarters], thus making sixteen priests.

16.23.s:
prastotā kaśyapastatra pratihartā tu gālavaḥ ..
subrahmaṇyastathā gargaḥ sadasyaḥ pulahaḥ kṛtaḥ .. 96 ..
16.23.d:
प्रस्तोता कश्यपस्तत्र प्रतिहर्ता तु गालवः ..
सुब्रह्मण्यस्तथा गर्गः सदस्यः पुलहः कृतः .. 96 ..
16.23.m: Kaśyapa was the prastotṛ there, and Gālava the pratihartṛ; / likewise Garga was the subrahmaṇya, and Pulaha was made a member of the assembly.

16.23.s:
hotā śukraḥ samākhyāto neṣṭā kratha udāhṛtaḥ ..
maitrāvaruṇo durvāsā brāhmaṇācchaṃsī kauśikaḥ .. 97 ..
16.23.d:
होता शुक्रः समाख्यातो नेष्टा क्रथ उदाहृतः ..
मैत्रावरुणो दुर्वासा ब्राह्मणाच्छंसी कौशिकः .. 97 ..
16.23.m: Śukra was designated the hotṛ, Kratha was cited as the neṣṭṛ; / Durvāsas was the maitrāvaruṇa, and Kauśika was the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin.

16.23.s:
acchāvākaśca śākalyo grāvasthaḥ kratureva ca ..
prasthātā pratipūrvo yaḥ śālaṃkāyana eva ca .. .. 98 ..
16.23.d:
अच्छावाकश्च शाकल्यो ग्रावस्थः क्रतुरेव च ..
प्रस्थाता प्रतिपूर्वो यः शालंकायन एव च .. .. 98 ..
16.23.m: Śākalya was the acchāvāka, Kratu was the grāvastut, / Śālaṅkāyana was the pratiprasthātṛ,

16.23.s:
agnīdhraśca manustatra unnetā tvaṃgirāḥ kṛtaḥ ..
evamādyānmaṇḍapeṣu kṛtvā tānṛtvijaḥ prabhuḥ .. 99 ..
16.23.d:
अग्नीध्रश्च मनुस्तत्र उन्नेता त्वंगिराः कृतः ..
एवमाद्यान्मण्डपेषु कृत्वा तानृत्विजः प्रभुः .. 99 ..
16.23.m: Manu was the agnīdhra there, and Aṅgiras was made the unnetṛ. / Having appointed these and other officiating priests in the pavilions, the lord,

16.23.s:
anyeṣu maṇḍapeṣveva pratyekamṛtvijaḥ kṛtāḥ ..
maṇḍapānāṃ śateṣveva kṛtvā kuṇḍānyakalpayat .. 7.1.23.100 ..
16.23.d:
अन्येषु मण्डपेष्वेव प्रत्येकमृत्विजः कृताः ..
मण्डपानां शतेष्वेव कृत्वा कुण्डान्यकल्पयत् .. 7.1.23.100 ..
16.23.m: appointed officiating priests in each of the other pavilions as well; / having set up the hundred pavilions, he fashioned the fire-pits.

16.23.s:
ekaiko maṇḍapastatra viṃśahastapramāṇataḥ ..
astreṇāśodhya bhūmiṃ tu paṃcagavyena prokṣya ca .. 101 ..
16.23.d:
एकैको मण्डपस्तत्र विंशहस्तप्रमाणतः ..
अस्त्रेणाशोध्य भूमिं तु पंचगव्येन प्रोक्ष्य च .. 101 ..
16.23.m: Each pavilion there measured twenty cubits; / purifying the ground with the astra-mantra and sprinkling it with the five products of the cow,

16.23.s:
carmaṇā cāvaguṃṭhyaiva ālikhyāstreṇa pārvati ..
ullikhya prokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā khātaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ .. 102 ..
16.23.d:
चर्मणा चावगुंठ्यैव आलिख्यास्त्रेण पार्वति ..
उल्लिख्य प्रोक्षणं कृत्वा खातं कृत्वा विधानतः .. 102 ..
16.23.m: covering it with a hide and drawing lines with the astra-mantra, O Pārvatī, / scratching the ground, sprinkling it, and digging the pit according to rule,

16.23.s:
aṣṭau kuṃḍāni saṃkalpya tathaikamaṇḍape priye ..
lepanaṃ maṇḍape kṛtvā vajrākaraṇameva ca .. 103..
16.23.d:
अष्टौ कुंडानि संकल्प्य तथैकमण्डपे प्रिये ..
लेपनं मण्डपे कृत्वा वज्राकरणमेव च .. 103..
16.23.m: and arranging eight fire-pits in a single pavilion, my beloved, / he smeared the pavilion and performed the vajrīkaraṇa rite.

16.23.s:
caturasrakārmukaṃ ca vartulaṃ kamalākṛti ..
pūrvāṃ diśaṃ samā rabhya kṛtvā tāni prayatnataḥ .. 104 ..
16.23.d:
चतुरस्रकार्मुकं च वर्तुलं कमलाकृति ..
पूर्वां दिशं समा रभ्य कृत्वा तानि प्रयत्नतः .. 104 ..
16.23.m: Square, bow-shaped, circular, and lotus-shaped, / he made them with great effort, beginning from the eastern direction:

16.23.s:
catuḥkoṇasamāyuktaṃ pūrve kuṇḍaṃ niveśya tu ..
bhagākṛti tathā''gneyyāṃ dakṣiṇe dhanurākṛti .. .. 105 ..
16.23.d:
चतुःकोणसमायुक्तं पूर्वे कुण्डं निवेश्य तु ..
भगाकृति तथा'ऽग्नेय्यां दक्षिणे धनुराकृति .. .. 105 ..
16.23.m: placing a four-cornered pit in the east, / a vulva-shaped one in the south-east, a bow-shaped one in the south,

16.23.s:
nairṛtye tu trikoṇaṃ vai vartulaṃ paścimena tu ..
ṣaṭkoṇaṃ caiva vāyavye padmākāraṃ tathottare .. 106 ..
16.23.d:
नैरृत्ये तु त्रिकोणं वै वर्तुलं पश्चिमेन तु ..
षट्कोणं चैव वायव्ये पद्माकारं तथोत्तरे .. 106 ..
16.23.m: a triangular one in the south-west, a circular one in the west, / a hexagonal one in the north-west, and a lotus-shaped one in the north,

16.23.s:
aiśānyāmaṣṭakoṇaṃ tu madhye caikaṃ vidhā nataḥ ..
pratyekaṃ maṇḍapaṃ śubhraṃ stambhaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiryutam .. 107 ..
16.23.d:
ऐशान्यामष्टकोणं तु मध्ये चैकं विधा नतः ..
प्रत्येकं मण्डपं शुभ्रं स्तम्भैः षोडशभिर्युतम् .. 107 ..
16.23.m: and an octagonal one in the north-east, with one [circular pit] in the center according to rule. / Each radiant pavilion had sixteen pillars,

16.23.s:
dhvajaiḥ satoraṇairyuktaṃ cakre brahmā vidhānataḥ ..
nyagrodhaṃ pūrvato nyasya dakṣe coduṃbaraṃ tathā .. 108 ..
16.23.d:
ध्वजैः सतोरणैर्युक्तं चक्रे ब्रह्मा विधानतः ..
न्यग्रोधं पूर्वतो न्यस्य दक्षे चोदुंबरं तथा .. 108 ..
16.23.m: equipped with banners and archways, Brahmā constructed according to rule; / placing a nyagrodha tree in the east, and likewise an udumbara in the south,

16.23.s:
aśvatthaṃ paścime caiva palāśaṃ cottare kramāt ..
bāhudaṃḍapramāṇena dhvajāṃstatra niveśya vai .. 109 ..
16.23.d:
अश्वत्थं पश्चिमे चैव पलाशं चोत्तरे क्रमात् ..
बाहुदंडप्रमाणेन ध्वजांस्तत्र निवेश्य वै .. 109 ..
16.23.m: an aśvattha in the west, and a palāśa in the north in sequence, / setting up banners of the measure of an arm's length there,

16.23.s:
aindryādau pītavarṇādi patākā parikalpitāḥ ..
tato brahmā hyagnikuṃḍe cāgnisthāpanamārabhat .. 7.1.23.110 ..
16.23.d:
ऐन्द्र्यादौ पीतवर्णादि पताका परिकल्पिताः ..
ततो ब्रह्मा ह्यग्निकुंडे चाग्निस्थापनमारभत् .. 7.1.23.110 ..
16.23.m: flags of yellow and other colours were arranged, beginning in the east. / Then Brahmā commenced the establishment of the fire in the fire-pit.

16.23.s:
svasthāne brāhmaṇāṃścaiva jāpye caiva nyayojayat ..
śrīsūktaṃ pāvamānaṃ ca sadā caiva ca vājinam .. 111 ..
16.23.d:
स्वस्थाने ब्राह्मणांश्चैव जाप्ये चैव न्ययोजयत् ..
श्रीसूक्तं पावमानं च सदा चैव च वाजिनम् .. 111 ..
16.23.m: He directed the brahmins in their respective places to chant prayers: / the Śrīsūkta, the Pāvamānasūkta, and constantly the Vājin [hymns],

16.23.s:
vṛṣākapiṃ tathaindraṃ ca bahvṛcaḥ pūrvato'japan ..
rudrānpuruṣasūktaṃ ca krokādhyāyaṃ(?) ca vaikriyam ..112..
16.23.d:
वृषाकपिं तथैन्द्रं च बह्वृचः पूर्वतोऽजपन् ..
रुद्रान्पुरुषसूक्तं च क्रोकाध्यायं(?) च वैक्रियम् ..112..
16.23.m: the Vṛṣākapi and the Indra hymn—the Ṛgvedins chanted them in the east; / the Rudra hymns, the Puruṣasūkta, and the […]

16.23.s:
brāhmaṇaṃ paitryamaiṃdraṃ ca japeranyajuṣo yame(?) ..
devavrataṃ vāmadevyaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ sāma rathaṃtaram .. 113 ..
16.23.d:
ब्राह्मणं पैत्र्यमैंद्रं च जपेरन्यजुषो यमे(?) ..
देवव्रतं वामदेव्यं ज्येष्ठं साम रथंतरम् .. 113 ..
16.23.m: the Brāhmaṇa, the ancestral hymns, and the Indra hymns the Yajurvedins chanted in the south; / the Devavrata, the Vāmadevya, the Jyeṣṭhasāman, the Rathaṃtara,

16.23.s:
bheruṃḍāni ca sāmāni cchaṃdogaḥ paścime'japat ..
atharvātharvaśirasaṃ skambhastaṃbhamatharvaṇam .. 114 ..
16.23.d:
भेरुंडानि च सामानि च्छंदोगः पश्चिमेऽजपत् ..
अथर्वाथर्वशिरसं स्कम्भस्तंभमथर्वणम् .. 114 ..
16.23.m: and the Bheruṇḍa sāmans the Sāmavedin chanted in the west; / the Atharvaśiras, the Skambhasūkta, the Atharvaṇa,

16.23.s:
nīlarudramatharvāṇamatharvā cottare'japat ..
garbhādhānādikaṃ sarvaṃ tato'gnerakarodvibhuḥ .. 115 ..
16.23.d:
नीलरुद्रमथर्वाणमथर्वा चोत्तरेऽजपत् ..
गर्भाधानादिकं सर्वं ततोऽग्नेरकरोद्विभुः .. 115 ..
16.23.m: and the Nīlarudra hymns the Atharvavedin chanted in the north. / Then the lord performed all the fire-rites, such as the rite of conception.

16.23.s:
pūrṇāhutiṃ tato dattvā snānakarma tathā'rabhat ..
paṃcapallavasaṃyuktaṃ mṛttikābhiḥ samanvitam .. 116 ..
16.23.d:
पूर्णाहुतिं ततो दत्त्वा स्नानकर्म तथाऽरभत् ..
पंचपल्लवसंयुक्तं मृत्तिकाभिः समन्वितम् .. 116 ..
16.23.m: Then, having offered the full offering, he began the rite of bathing [the liṅga] / using the five shoots and mixed with earths,

16.23.s:
kaṣāyaiḥ paṃcagavyaiśca paṃcāmṛtaphalaistathā ..
tīrthodakaiḥ sametaṃ tu maṃtraiḥ snānamathārabhat .. 117 ..
16.23.d:
कषायैः पंचगव्यैश्च पंचामृतफलैस्तथा ..
तीर्थोदकैः समेतं तु मंत्रैः स्नानमथारभत् .. 117 ..
16.23.m: with astringents, the five products of the cow, the five nectars, and fruits, / together with the waters of sacred fords; he then began the bath accompanied by mantras.

16.23.s:
netrāṇyutpādya devasya kṛtvā ca tilakakriyām ..
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni pātāle ca viśeṣataḥ .. 118 ..
16.23.d:
नेत्राण्युत्पाद्य देवस्य कृत्वा च तिलकक्रियाम् ..
पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि पाताले च विशेषतः .. 118 ..
16.23.m: Having fashioned the eyes of the god and applied the auspicious mark on the forehead, / [bringing] whatever sacred fords exist on the earth and especially in Pātāla,

16.23.s:
svarga loke ca yānyeva tatra tānyāyayustadā ..
etasminnantare brahmā devānāṃ paśyatāṃ tadā .. 119 ..
16.23.d:
स्वर्ग लोके च यान्येव तत्र तान्याययुस्तदा ..
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे ब्रह्मा देवानां पश्यतां तदा .. 119 ..
16.23.m: And whatever [sacred fords] there were in heaven, all arrived there at that moment. / Meanwhile, then, while the gods were looking on, Brahmā

16.23.s:
bhūmiṃ bhittvā viveśātha tatra liṃgamapaśyata ..
sparśākhyaṃ taṃ tu saṃchādya madhunā darbhamūlakaiḥ .. 7.1.23.120 ..
16.23.d:
भूमिं भित्त्वा विवेशाथ तत्र लिंगमपश्यत ..
स्पर्शाख्यं तं तु संछाद्य मधुना दर्भमूलकैः .. 7.1.23.120 ..
16.23.m: rent the earth and entered, and there he saw the liṅga. / Having covered that [liṅga] named Sparśa with honey and roots of darbha grass,

16.23.s:
tatra brahmaśilāṃ nyasya tasyā ūrdhvaṃ mahāprabham ..
liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhayāmāsa kṛtvā niścalamā tmavān .. 121 ..
16.23.d:
तत्र ब्रह्मशिलां न्यस्य तस्या ऊर्ध्वं महाप्रभम् ..
लिंगं प्रतिष्ठयामास कृत्वा निश्चलमा त्मवान् .. 121 ..
16.23.m: and placing the brahma-stone there, the self-controlled one installed the liṅga / of great splendour above it, having made it immovable.

16.23.s:
sthitvā ca parame tattve maṃtranyāsamathākarot ..
evaṃ liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya tatra brahmā jagadguruḥ ..
pūjayāmāsa vidhinā vedoktairmaṃtra vistaraiḥ .. 122 ..
16.23.d:
स्थित्वा च परमे तत्त्वे मंत्रन्यासमथाकरोत् ..
एवं लिंगं प्रतिष्ठाप्य तत्र ब्रह्मा जगद्गुरुः ..
पूजयामास विधिना वेदोक्तैर्मंत्र विस्तरैः .. 122 ..
16.23.m: And abiding in the highest reality, he then performed the ritual placement of mantras. / Having thus installed the liṅga there, Brahmā, the guru of the universe,

16.23.s:
mantranyāse kṛte tatra brahmaṇā lokakartṝṇā ..
tatra vipragaṇo hṛṣṭo jayaśabdādimaṃgalaiḥ ..
nirdhūmaścābhavadvahniḥ sūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ .. 123 ..
16.23.d:
मन्त्रन्यासे कृते तत्र ब्रह्मणा लोककर्तॄणा ..
तत्र विप्रगणो हृष्टो जयशब्दादिमंगलैः ..
निर्धूमश्चाभवद्वह्निः सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभः .. 123 ..
16.23.m: worshipped it according to ritual rule with elaborate mantras spoken in the Vedas. / When the ritual placement of mantras was performed there by Brahmā, the creator of the world,

16.23.s:
devadundubhayo neduḥ prasannāśca digīśvarāḥ ..
puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papātoccaistasminyajñamahotsave .. 124 ..
16.23.d:
देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुः प्रसन्नाश्च दिगीश्वराः ..
पुष्पवृष्टिः पपातोच्चैस्तस्मिन्यज्ञमहोत्सवे .. 124 ..
16.23.m: the assembly of brahmins rejoiced there with auspicious cries of victory and the like, / and the fire became smokeless, blazing with the radiance of ten million suns.

16.23.s:
pratiṣṭhāpya tato liṃgaṃ śrīsomeśaṃ pitāmahaḥ ..
dāpayāmāsa viprebhyo bhūriśo yajñadakṣiṇām .. 125 ..
16.23.d:
प्रतिष्ठाप्य ततो लिंगं श्रीसोमेशं पितामहः ..
दापयामास विप्रेभ्यो भूरिशो यज्ञदक्षिणाम् .. 125 ..
16.23.m: Celestial drums sounded, and the lords of the directions were pleased. / A shower of flowers fell profusely in that great festival of sacrifice.

16.23.s:
sanatkumārapramukhairādyairbrahmarṣibhirvṛtaḥ ..
dakṣiṇāmadadātsomastrīm̐llokānbrahmaṇe purā..126..
16.23.d:
सनत्कुमारप्रमुखैराद्यैर्ब्रह्मर्षिभिर्वृतः ..
दक्षिणामददात्सोमस्त्रीम्̐ल्लोकान्ब्रह्मणे पुरा..126..
16.23.m: Then, having installed the glorious liṅga of Someśa, the Grandfather / caused abundant sacrificial fees to be given to the brahmins.

16.23.s:
tebhyo brahmarṣimukhyebhyaḥ sadasyebhyastathaiva ca ..
dadau hiraṇyaṃ ratnāni koṭiśo bhūridakṣiṇāḥ .. 127 ..
16.23.d:
तेभ्यो ब्रह्मर्षिमुख्येभ्यः सदस्येभ्यस्तथैव च ..
ददौ हिरण्यं रत्नानि कोटिशो भूरिदक्षिणाः .. 127 ..
16.23.m: Surrounded by the foremost brahmin seers headed by Sanatkumāra, / Soma formerly gave the three worlds as a sacrificial fee to Brahmā.

16.23.s:
sobhiṣikto mahātejāḥ sarvairbrahmarṣibhistataḥ ..
trīm̐llokānbhāvayāmāsa svabhāsā bhāsatāṃ varaḥ .. 128 ..
16.23.d:
सोभिषिक्तो महातेजाः सर्वैर्ब्रह्मर्षिभिस्ततः ..
त्रीम्̐ल्लोकान्भावयामास स्वभासा भासतां वरः .. 128 ..
16.23.m: To those principal brahmin seers and likewise to the members of the assembly, / he gave gold, jewels, and abundant fees in the millions.

16.23.s:
taṃ sinī ca kuhūścaiva dyutiḥ puṣṭiḥ prabhā vasuḥ..
kīrttirdhṛtiśca lakṣmīśca nava devyaḥ siṣevire .. 129 ..
16.23.d:
तं सिनी च कुहूश्चैव द्युतिः पुष्टिः प्रभा वसुः..
कीर्त्तिर्धृतिश्च लक्ष्मीश्च नव देव्यः सिषेविरे .. 129 ..
16.23.m: Consecrated then by all the brahmin seers, that one of great lustre, / the best among luminous bodies, illuminated the three worlds with his own radiance.

16.23.s:
prāpyāvabhṛthamavyagraḥ kṛtvā māheśvaraṃ makham ..
kṛtārthaḥ paripūrṇaśca saṃbabhūva niśāpatiḥ .. 7.1.23.130 ..
16.23.d:
प्राप्यावभृथमव्यग्रः कृत्वा माहेश्वरं मखम् ..
कृतार्थः परिपूर्णश्च संबभूव निशापतिः .. 7.1.23.130 ..
16.23.m: Nine goddesses attended upon him: / Sinī, Kuhū, Dyuti, Puṣṭi, Prabhā, Vasu, Kīrti, Dhṛti, and Lakṣmī.

16.23.s:
tatastasmai dadau rājyaṃ prājyaṃ brahmā pitāmahaḥ ..
bījauṣadhīnāṃ viprāṇāmavannānāṃ ca varānane .. 131 ..
16.23.d:
ततस्तस्मै ददौ राज्यं प्राज्यं ब्रह्मा पितामहः ..
बीजौषधीनां विप्राणामवन्नानां च वरानने .. 131 ..
16.23.m: Having attained the concluding bath without agitation, having performed the sacrifice dedicated to Maheśvara, / the Lord of the Night became fulfilled and perfected.

16.23.s:
tasminyajñe samājagmurye kecitpṛthivīśvarāḥ ..
teṣāṃ rājyaṃ dhanaṃ bhogāndadau svargaṃ tathā'kṣayam .. 132 ..
16.23.d:
तस्मिन्यज्ञे समाजग्मुर्ये केचित्पृथिवीश्वराः ..
तेषां राज्यं धनं भोगान्ददौ स्वर्गं तथाऽक्षयम् .. 132 ..
16.23.m: Then Brahmā the Grandfather granted him an extensive kingdom, / O fair-faced one, over seeds, medicinal plants, brahmins, and waters.

16.23.s:
brāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsa svayamevauṣadhīpatiḥ ..
dadau sarvaṃ tadā teṣāṃ prabhāsakṣetravāsinām ... ... 133 ..
16.23.d:
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयामास स्वयमेवौषधीपतिः ..
ददौ सर्वं तदा तेषां प्रभासक्षेत्रवासिनाम् ... ... 133 ..
16.23.m: To whichever rulers of the earth had gathered at that sacrifice, / he granted kingdoms, wealth, pleasures, and likewise imperishable heaven.

16.23.s:
hiraṇyādīnyadāccaiva mahādānāni ṣoḍaśa ..
yo yadarthayate tatra sāmānyaḥ prākṛto janaḥ..
nijakarmānusāreṇa sa lebhe ca tadeva hi ..134..
16.23.d:
हिरण्यादीन्यदाच्चैव महादानानि षोडश ..
यो यदर्थयते तत्र सामान्यः प्राकृतो जनः..
निजकर्मानुसारेण स लेभे च तदेव हि ..134..
16.23.m: The Lord of Plants himself fed the brahmins; / he then gave everything to those dwelling in the Prabhāsa sacred field.

16.23.s:
evaṃ samarthite yajñe sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ ..
sthāpayitvā tu liṃgāni jagmuḥ sarve yathāgatam .. 136 ..
candramāstu punardevi brahmaṇā sahito vibhuḥ ..
liṃgamārādhayāmāsa prabhāse pāpanāśane .. 136 ..
16.23.d:
एवं समर्थिते यज्ञे सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः ..
स्थापयित्वा तु लिंगानि जग्मुः सर्वे यथागतम् .. 136 ..
चन्द्रमास्तु पुनर्देवि ब्रह्मणा सहितो विभुः ..
लिंगमाराधयामास प्रभासे पापनाशने .. 136 ..
16.23.m:
He also gave the sixteen great gifts, beginning with gold. / Whatever an ordinary, common person there requested,
that very thing he received in accordance with his own action. / When the sacrifice was thus completed, all the gods, accompanied by Indra,

16.23.s:
trikālaṃ pūjayāmāsa dhūpamālyānulepanaiḥ ..
taṃ praṇamya ca deveśi stauti nityaṃ niśāpatiḥ .. .. 137 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye someśvarapratiṣṭhāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃ
nāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 23 .. .. cha ..
16.23.d:
त्रिकालं पूजयामास धूपमाल्यानुलेपनैः ..
तं प्रणम्य च देवेशि स्तौति नित्यं निशापतिः .. .. 137 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सोमेश्वरप्रतिष्ठामाहात्म्यवर्णनं
नाम त्रयोविंशोऽध्यायः .. 23 .. .. छ ..
16.23.m:
having installed their own liṅgas, departed each as they had come. / But the Moon, the all-pervading lord, together with Brahmā, O goddess,
worshipped the liṅga again in sin-destroying Prabhāsa. / He worshipped it at the three junctures of the day with incense, garlands, and ointments; / having bowed to it, O ruler of the gods, the Lord of the Night praised it continually.

16.24.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
kasminkāle jagannātha tatra liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ..
kathamārādhanaṃ cakre kṛtārtho rohiṇīpatiḥ .. 1 ..
16.24.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
कस्मिन्काले जगन्नाथ तत्र लिंगं प्रतिष्ठितम् ..
कथमाराधनं चक्रे कृतार्थो रोहिणीपतिः .. 1 ..
16.24.m: Thus ends the twenty-third chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of the Installation of Someśvara' in the First [Book, namely] the Māhātmya of the Prabhāsa Field, in the Seventh Section [named] Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.24.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tretāyuge ca daśame manorvaivasvatasya hi ..
saṃjāto rohiṇīnātho yukto durvāsasā priye .. 2 ..
16.24.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
त्रेतायुगे च दशमे मनोर्वैवस्वतस्य हि ..
संजातो रोहिणीनाथो युक्तो दुर्वाससा प्रिये .. 2 ..
16.24.m: The Goddess said: / At what time, O Lord of the Universe, was the liṅga installed there? / How did the husband of Rohiṇī worship it and achieve his purpose?

16.24.s:
tasminkāle tadā tatra gate varṣasahasrake ..
tataḥ kṛtvā tapaścāyaṃ pratyakṣīkṛtaśaṃkaraḥ .. 3 ..
16.24.d:
तस्मिन्काले तदा तत्र गते वर्षसहस्रके ..
ततः कृत्वा तपश्चायं प्रत्यक्षीकृतशंकरः .. 3 ..
16.24.m: Īśvara said: / In the tenth Tretāyuga of Vaivasvata Manu, / the husband of Rohiṇī was born, accompanied by Durvāsas, O dear one.

16.24.s:
liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhayāmāsa brahmaṇā lokakartṝṇā ..
punarvarṣasahasraṃ tu pūjayāmāsa śaṃkaram.. 4 ..
16.24.d:
लिंगं प्रतिष्ठयामास ब्रह्मणा लोककर्तॄणा ..
पुनर्वर्षसहस्रं तु पूजयामास शंकरम्.. 4 ..
16.24.m: At that time, when a thousand years had passed there, / he, having performed austerity and brought Śaṃkara before his eyes,

16.24.s:
tataḥ saṃpūjya vidhinā nijakāryārthasiddhaye ..
stutiṃ cakre niśānāthaḥ pratyakṣīkṛtaśaṃkaraḥ .. 5 ..
16.24.d:
ततः संपूज्य विधिना निजकार्यार्थसिद्धये ..
स्तुतिं चक्रे निशानाथः प्रत्यक्षीकृतशंकरः .. 5 ..
16.24.m: installed the liṅga together with Brahmā, the creator of the worlds; / and for another thousand years he worshipped Śaṃkara.

16.24.s:
.. caṃdra uvāca ..
nāsti śarvasamo devo nāsti śarvasamā gatiḥ ..
nāsti śarvasamo devo nāsti śarvasamā gatiḥ .. 6 ..
16.24.d:
.. चंद्र उवाच ..
नास्ति शर्वसमो देवो नास्ति शर्वसमा गतिः ..
नास्ति शर्वसमो देवो नास्ति शर्वसमा गतिः .. 6 ..
16.24.m: Then, having worshipped according to the ritual rules for the accomplishment of his purpose, / the Lord of the Night, having brought Śaṃkara before his eyes, uttered a praise.

16.24.s:
yaṃ paṭhaṃti sadā sāṃkhyāścitayaṃti ca yoginaḥ ..
paraṃ pradhānaṃ puruṣaṃ tasmai jñeyātmane namaḥ .. 7 ..
16.24.d:
यं पठंति सदा सांख्याश्चितयंति च योगिनः ..
परं प्रधानं पुरुषं तस्मै ज्ञेयात्मने नमः .. 7 ..
16.24.m: The Moon said: / There is no god equal to Śarva; there is no refuge equal to Śarva. / There is no god equal to Śarva; there is no refuge equal to Śarva.

16.24.s:
utpattau ca vināśe ca kāraṇaṃ yaṃ vidurbudhāḥ ..
devāsuramanuṣyāṇāṃ tasmai jñānātmane namaḥ .. 8 ..
16.24.d:
उत्पत्तौ च विनाशे च कारणं यं विदुर्बुधाः ..
देवासुरमनुष्याणां तस्मै ज्ञानात्मने नमः .. 8 ..
16.24.m: Whom the Sāṃkhyas constantly study and the yogins contemplate, / the supreme, the primary cause, the spirit—homage to that one whose self is the knowable.

16.24.s:
yamavyayamanādyaṃtaṃ yaṃ nityaṃ śāśvataṃ dhruvam ..
niṣkalaṃ paramaṃ brahma tasmai yogātmane namaḥ .. 9 ..
16.24.d:
यमव्ययमनाद्यंतं यं नित्यं शाश्वतं ध्रुवम् ..
निष्कलं परमं ब्रह्म तस्मै योगात्मने नमः .. 9 ..
16.24.m: Whom the wise know as the cause in origination and destruction / of gods, demons, and human beings—homage to that one whose self is knowledge.

16.24.s:
yaḥ pavitraṃ pavitrāṇāmādidevo maheśvaraḥ ..
punāti darśanādeva tasmai tīrthātmane namaḥ .. 7.1.24.10 ..
16.24.d:
यः पवित्रं पवित्राणामादिदेवो महेश्वरः ..
पुनाति दर्शनादेव तस्मै तीर्थात्मने नमः .. 7.1.24.10 ..
16.24.m: Who is imperishable, without beginning or end, who is eternal, perpetual, steadfast, / partless, the supreme Brahman—homage to that one whose self is yoga.

16.24.s:
yataḥ pravarttate sarvaṃ yasminsarvaṃ vilīyate ..
pālayedyo jagatsarvaṃ tasmai sarvātmane namaḥ .. 11 ..
16.24.d:
यतः प्रवर्त्तते सर्वं यस्मिन्सर्वं विलीयते ..
पालयेद्यो जगत्सर्वं तस्मै सर्वात्मने नमः .. 11 ..
16.24.m: Who is the pure of the pure, the primordial god, Maheśvara, / who purifies by mere darśana—homage to that one whose self is the sacred ford.

16.24.s:
aniṣṭomādibhiryajñairyaṃ yajaṃti dvijātayaḥ ..
saṃpūrṇadakṣiṇaireva tasmai yajñātmane namaḥ .. 12 ..
16.24.d:
अनिष्टोमादिभिर्यज्ञैर्यं यजंति द्विजातयः ..
संपूर्णदक्षिणैरेव तस्मै यज्ञात्मने नमः .. 12 ..
16.24.m: From whom everything proceeds, into whom everything dissolves, / who protects the entire universe—homage to that one whose self is all.

16.24.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
evaṃ sa saṃstute yāvaddivārātrau niśākaraḥ ..
abravīdbhagavānprītaḥ prahasanniva śaṃkaraḥ .. 13 ..
16.24.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एवं स संस्तुते यावद्दिवारात्रौ निशाकरः ..
अब्रवीद्भगवान्प्रीतः प्रहसन्निव शंकरः .. 13 ..
16.24.m: Whom the twice-born worship with sacrifices such as the Agniṣṭoma / with complete sacrificial gifts—homage to that one whose self is sacrifice.

16.24.s:
.. śaṃkara uvāca .. ..
parituṣṭo'smi te vatsa stotreṇānena śītago ..
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te bhūyo yatte manogatam .. 14 ..
16.24.d:
.. शंकर उवाच .. ..
परितुष्टोऽस्मि ते वत्स स्तोत्रेणानेन शीतगो ..
वरं वरय भद्रं ते भूयो यत्ते मनोगतम् .. 14 ..
16.24.m: Īśvara said: / While the Maker of the Night praised him thus day and night, / the blessed Lord Śaṃkara spoke, pleased and as if smiling:

16.24.s:
.. caṃdra uvāca .. ..
yadi deyo varo'smākaṃ yadi tuṣṭo'si me prabho ..
sāṃnidhyaṃ kuru deveśa liṃge'sminsarvadā vibho ..15..
16.24.d:
.. चंद्र उवाच .. ..
यदि देयो वरोऽस्माकं यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे प्रभो ..
सांनिध्यं कुरु देवेश लिंगेऽस्मिन्सर्वदा विभो ..15..
16.24.m: Śaṃkara said: / I am well-pleased with you, my child, by this hymn of praise, O cold-rayed one! / Choose a boon; may good fortune be yours; whatever else is in your heart.

16.24.s:
ye tvāṃ paśyaṃti cātrasthaṃ bhaktyā paramayā yutāḥ ..
teṣāṃ tu paramā siddhistvatprasādātsureśvara .. .. 16 ..
16.24.d:
ये त्वां पश्यंति चात्रस्थं भक्त्या परमया युताः ..
तेषां तु परमा सिद्धिस्त्वत्प्रसादात्सुरेश्वर .. .. 16 ..
16.24.m: The Moon said: / If a boon is to be given to me, if you are pleased with me, O Lord, / abide always in this liṅga, O Lord of Gods, O all-pervading one!

16.24.s:
.. śaṃbhuruvāca .. ..
agre tu mama sāṃnidhyamasmim̐lliṃge mahāprabho ..
viśeṣato'dhunā caṃdra tava bhaktyā niraṃtaram .. 17 ..
16.24.d:
.. शंभुरुवाच .. ..
अग्रे तु मम सांनिध्यमस्मिम्̐ल्लिंगे महाप्रभो ..
विशेषतोऽधुना चंद्र तव भक्त्या निरंतरम् .. 17 ..
16.24.m: And those who see you abiding here, endowed with supreme devotion, / to them may there be supreme perfection by your grace, O Lord of Gods!

16.24.s:
sthātavyamadyaprabhṛti kṣetre'sminnumayā saha ..
yasmāttvayā prabhā labdhā kṣetre'sminmatprasādataḥ ..
tasmātprabhāsamityevaṃ nāmāsya prabhaviṣyati .. 18 ..
16.24.d:
स्थातव्यमद्यप्रभृति क्षेत्रेऽस्मिन्नुमया सह ..
यस्मात्त्वया प्रभा लब्धा क्षेत्रेऽस्मिन्मत्प्रसादतः ..
तस्मात्प्रभासमित्येवं नामास्य प्रभविष्यति .. 18 ..
16.24.m: Śambhu said: / Formerly there was already my presence in this liṅga, O great lord; / especially now, O Moon, through your devotion, it shall be continuous.

16.24.s:
yasmātpratiṣṭhitaṃ liṃgaṃ tvayā soma śubhaṃ mama ..
somanātheti me nāma tasmātkhyātiṃ gamiṣyati .. 19 ..
16.24.d:
यस्मात्प्रतिष्ठितं लिंगं त्वया सोम शुभं मम ..
सोमनाथेति मे नाम तस्मात्ख्यातिं गमिष्यति .. 19 ..
16.24.m: From this day forth I must abide in this sacred field together with Umā. / Because splendour (prabhā) was obtained by you in this sacred field by my grace,

16.24.s:
yanmamāgretanaṃ nāmakhyātaṃ brahmāvasānikam..
somanātheti ca punastadeva pracariṣyati..
drakṣyaṃti hi narā ye māmatrasthaṃ bhaktitatparāḥ .. 7.1.24.20 ..
16.24.d:
यन्ममाग्रेतनं नामख्यातं ब्रह्मावसानिकम्..
सोमनाथेति च पुनस्तदेव प्रचरिष्यति..
द्रक्ष्यंति हि नरा ये मामत्रस्थं भक्तितत्पराः .. 7.1.24.20 ..
16.24.m: The name of mine which was famed in former times as Brahmāvasānika / shall indeed spread again by that very name, 'Somanātha'. / For those men devoted to bhakti who behold me residing here,

16.24.s:
śṛṇu teṣāṃ phalaṃ vatsa bhaviṣyati niśākara ..
na teṣāṃ jāyate vyādhirna dāridryaṃ na durgatiḥ ..
na ceṣṭena viyogaśca mama caṃdra prabhāvataḥ .. 21 ..
16.24.d:
शृणु तेषां फलं वत्स भविष्यति निशाकर ..
न तेषां जायते व्याधिर्न दारिद्र्यं न दुर्गतिः ..
न चेष्टेन वियोगश्च मम चंद्र प्रभावतः .. 21 ..
16.24.m: hear, dear child, maker of the night, what their reward will be: / to them comes no sickness, no poverty, no misfortune, / and no separation from what is cherished, through my power, O moon.

16.24.s:
yātrāṃ kurvaṃti ye bhaktyā mama darśanakāṃkṣiṇaḥ ..
pade padeśvamedhasya teṣāṃ phalamudāhṛtam.. 22 ..
16.24.d:
यात्रां कुर्वंति ये भक्त्या मम दर्शनकांक्षिणः ..
पदे पदेश्वमेधस्य तेषां फलमुदाहृतम्.. 22 ..
16.24.m: Those who, desiring my darśana, undertake a pilgrimage with devotion, / have the reward of an Aśvamedha sacrifice declared for them at every step.

16.24.s:
kiṃ kṛtairbahubhiryajñairupavāsairniśākara ..
sakṛtpaśyaṃti māṃ ye'tra te sarve lebhire phalam ... 23 ..
16.24.d:
किं कृतैर्बहुभिर्यज्ञैरुपवासैर्निशाकर ..
सकृत्पश्यंति मां येऽत्र ते सर्वे लेभिरे फलम् ... 23 ..
16.24.m: What need of performing many sacrifices and fasts, O maker of the night? / Those who behold me here even once have obtained all that reward.

16.24.s:
ekamāsopavāsaṃ tu kurute bhaktitatparaḥ ..
yāvadvarṣasahasraṃ tu ekaḥ paśyaṃti māmiha .. 24 ..
16.24.d:
एकमासोपवासं तु कुरुते भक्तितत्परः ..
यावद्वर्षसहस्रं तु एकः पश्यंति मामिह .. 24 ..
16.24.m: One who, devoted to bhakti, observes a fast for one month, / while another beholds me here for as long as a thousand years—

16.24.s: dvābhyāmapi phalaṃ tulyaṃ nāsti kācidvicāraṇā .. 25 ..
16.24.d: द्वाभ्यामपि फलं तुल्यं नास्ति काचिद्विचारणा .. 25 ..
16.24.m: the reward is equal for both; there is no doubt about it.

16.24.s:
eko bhavedbrahmacārī yāvajjīvaṃ niśākara ..
sakṛtpaśyati māmatra samaṃ tābhyāṃ phalaṃ smṛtam .. 26 ..
16.24.d:
एको भवेद्ब्रह्मचारी यावज्जीवं निशाकर ..
सकृत्पश्यति मामत्र समं ताभ्यां फलं स्मृतम् .. 26 ..
16.24.m: One might remain a celibate student for as long as he lives, O maker of the night, / while another beholds me here once: the reward is traditionally remembered as equal for the two.

16.24.s:
eko dānāni sarvāṇi prayacchati dvijātaye ..
ekaḥ paśyati māmatra samaṃ tābhyāṃ phalaṃ smṛtam .. 27 ..
16.24.d:
एको दानानि सर्वाणि प्रयच्छति द्विजातये ..
एकः पश्यति मामत्र समं ताभ्यां फलं स्मृतम् .. 27 ..
16.24.m: One bestows all manner of gifts upon the twice-born, / while another beholds me here: the reward is traditionally remembered as equal for the two.

16.24.s:
eko vratāni sarvāṇi kurute mṛgalāṃchana ..
anyaḥ paśyati māmatra samaṃ tābhyāṃ phalaṃ smṛtam.. 28..
16.24.d:
एको व्रतानि सर्वाणि कुरुते मृगलांछन ..
अन्यः पश्यति मामत्र समं ताभ्यां फलं स्मृतम्.. 28..
16.24.m: One performs all religious observances, O deer-marked moon, / while another beholds me here: the reward is traditionally remembered as equal for the two.

16.24.s:
ekastīrthāni kurute japajāpyāni bhūriśaḥ ..
anyaḥ paśyati māmatra phalaṃ tābhyāṃ samaṃ smṛtam .. 29 ..
eko jñānādiyogena mumukṣurjāyate dhruvam..
anyaḥ paśyati māmatra phalaṃ tābhyāṃ samaṃ smṛtam..7.1.24.3...
16.24.d:
एकस्तीर्थानि कुरुते जपजाप्यानि भूरिशः ..
अन्यः पश्यति मामत्र फलं ताभ्यां समं स्मृतम् .. 29 ..
एको ज्ञानादियोगेन मुमुक्षुर्जायते ध्रुवम्..
अन्यः पश्यति मामत्र फलं ताभ्यां समं स्मृतम्..7.1.24.3...
16.24.m:
One visits sacred fords and performs abundant recitations of mantras, / while another beholds me here: the reward is traditionally remembered as equal for the two.
One becomes an earnest seeker of liberation through the yoga of knowledge and the like, / while another beholds me here: the reward is traditionally remembered as equal for the two.

16.24.s:
ekastu bhṛgupātena yāti mṛtyuṃ niśākara..
anyaḥ paśyati māmatra samaṃ tābhyāṃ phalaṃ smṛtam .. 31 ..
16.24.d:
एकस्तु भृगुपातेन याति मृत्युं निशाकर..
अन्यः पश्यति मामत्र समं ताभ्यां फलं स्मृतम् .. 31 ..
16.24.m: One meets death by throwing himself from a precipice, O maker of the night, / while another beholds me here: the reward is traditionally remembered as equal for the two.

16.24.s:
ekaḥ snāti sadā māghaṃ prayāge narasattamaḥ ..
anyaḥ paśyati māmatra phalaṃ tābhyāṃ samaṃ smṛtam 32 ..
16.24.d:
एकः स्नाति सदा माघं प्रयागे नरसत्तमः ..
अन्यः पश्यति मामत्र फलं ताभ्यां समं स्मृतम् 32 ..
16.24.m: One best among men always bathes during the month of Māgha at Prayāga, / while another beholds me here: the reward is traditionally remembered as equal for the two.

16.24.s:
ekaḥ piṇḍapradānaṃ ca pitṛtīrthe samācaret ..
anyaḥ paśyati māmatra phalaṃ tābhyāṃ samaṃ smṛtam .. 33 ..
16.24.d:
एकः पिण्डप्रदानं च पितृतीर्थे समाचरेत् ..
अन्यः पश्यति मामत्र फलं ताभ्यां समं स्मृतम् .. 33 ..
16.24.m: One offers funeral cakes of rice at a sacred ford dedicated to the ancestors, / while another beholds me here: the reward is traditionally remembered as equal for the two.

16.24.s:
gosahasraprado hyeko brāhmaṇe vedapārage..
ekaḥ paśyati māmatra phalaṃ tābhyāṃ samaṃ smṛtam .. 34 ..
16.24.d:
गोसहस्रप्रदो ह्येको ब्राह्मणे वेदपारगे..
एकः पश्यति मामत्र फलं ताभ्यां समं स्मृतम् .. 34 ..
16.24.m: One bestows a thousand cows upon a brahmin who has mastered the Vedas, / while another beholds me here: the reward is traditionally remembered as equal for the two.

16.24.s:
pañcāgniṃ sādhayedeko grīṣmakāle sudāruṇe ..
ekaḥ paśyati māmatra phalaṃ tābhyāṃ samaṃ smṛtam .. 35 ..
16.24.d:
पञ्चाग्निं साधयेदेको ग्रीष्मकाले सुदारुणे ..
एकः पश्यति मामत्र फलं ताभ्यां समं स्मृतम् .. 35 ..
16.24.m: One practices the five-fire penance during the intensely fierce summer season, / while another beholds me here: the reward is traditionally remembered as equal for the two.

16.24.s:
snātaḥ somagrahe candra somavāre ca bhaktitaḥ ..
yo māṃ paśyati sarveṣāmeteṣāṃ labhate phalam .. 36 ..
16.24.d:
स्नातः सोमग्रहे चन्द्र सोमवारे च भक्तितः ..
यो मां पश्यति सर्वेषामेतेषां लभते फलम् .. 36 ..
16.24.m: Bathed during a lunar eclipse and on a Monday with devotion, O moon, / he who beholds me obtains the reward of all these.

16.24.s:
sarasvatī samudraśca somaḥ somagrahastathā ..
darśanaṃ somanāthasya sakārāḥ pañca durllabhāḥ .. 37 ..
16.24.d:
सरस्वती समुद्रश्च सोमः सोमग्रहस्तथा ..
दर्शनं सोमनाथस्य सकाराः पञ्च दुर्ल्लभाः .. 37 ..
16.24.m: Sarasvatī, samudra (the ocean), soma (the moon), somagraha (a lunar eclipse), / and darśana of Somanātha: these five starting with the syllable 'sa' are exceedingly rare.

16.24.s:
nairaṃtaryeṇa ṣaṇmāsānvidhinā yaḥ prapūjayet ..
puṇyaṃ tadeva saphalaṃ labhate viṣuvārcanāt .. 38 ..
16.24.d:
नैरंतर्येण षण्मासान्विधिना यः प्रपूजयेत् ..
पुण्यं तदेव सफलं लभते विषुवार्चनात् .. 38 ..
16.24.m: Whoever worships [me] continuously according to rule for six months, / obtains that very same fruitful merit from worship at an equinox.

16.24.s:
etadeva tu vijñeyaṃ grahaṇe cottarāyaṇe ..
saṃkrāṃtidinacchidreṣu ṣaḍaśītimukheṣu ca .. 39 ..
16.24.d:
एतदेव तु विज्ञेयं ग्रहणे चोत्तरायणे ..
संक्रांतिदिनच्छिद्रेषु षडशीतिमुखेषु च .. 39 ..
16.24.m: The very same is to be known during an eclipse, at the northern solstice, / on the interstitial days of transit, and at the beginnings of the eighty-six-solar-month periods.

16.24.s:
māsaiścaturbhiryatpuṇyaṃ vidhinā''pūjya śaṃkaram ..
kārttikyāṃ sa labhetpuṇyaṃ caitryāṃ taddviguṇaṃ smṛtam ..
puṇyametattu phālgunyāmāṣāḍhyāmevameva tu .. 7.1.24.40 ..
16.24.d:
मासैश्चतुर्भिर्यत्पुण्यं विधिना'ऽपूज्य शंकरम् ..
कार्त्तिक्यां स लभेत्पुण्यं चैत्र्यां तद्द्विगुणं स्मृतम् ..
पुण्यमेतत्तु फाल्गुन्यामाषाढ्यामेवमेव तु .. 7.1.24.40 ..
16.24.m: Whatever merit is obtained by worshiping Śaṃkara according to rule for four months, / that merit he obtains on the full-moon day of Kārttika; on that of Caitra it is considered twofold; / and this same merit is likewise [obtained] on the full-moon day of Phālguna and on that of Āṣāḍha.

16.24.s:
eko dadyādgavāṃ lakṣaṃ dogdhrīṇāṃ vedapārage ..
eko mamārcayelliṃgaṃ tasya puṇyaṃ tato'dhikam .. 41 ..
16.24.d:
एको दद्याद्गवां लक्षं दोग्ध्रीणां वेदपारगे ..
एको ममार्चयेल्लिंगं तस्य पुण्यं ततोऽधिकम् .. 41 ..
16.24.m: One might give a hundred thousand milch cows to a scholar of the Vedas; / another worships my liṅga: his merit is far greater than that.

16.24.s:
māsemāse ca yo'śnīyādyāvajjīvaṃ sureśvari ..
yaścārccayetsakṛlliṃgaṃ samametanna saṃśayaḥ .. 42 ..
16.24.d:
मासेमासे च योऽश्नीयाद्यावज्जीवं सुरेश्वरि ..
यश्चार्च्चयेत्सकृल्लिंगं सममेतन्न संशयः .. 42 ..
16.24.m: Whoever eats only once a month throughout his life, O goddess of the gods, / and whoever worships the liṅga even once: these two are equal, there is no doubt.

16.24.s:
tapaḥśīlaguṇopete pātre vedasya pārage ..
suvarṇakoṭiṃ yaddattvā tatphalaṃ kusumena tu .. 43 ..
16.24.d:
तपःशीलगुणोपेते पात्रे वेदस्य पारगे ..
सुवर्णकोटिं यद्दत्त्वा तत्फलं कुसुमेन तु .. 43 ..
16.24.m: Whatever [merit is gained] by giving ten million gold pieces to a worthy recipient endowed with austerity and virtuous conduct who has mastered the Vedas, / that same reward is gained merely by a single flower.

16.24.s:
arkapuṣpe'pi caikasmiñchivāya vinivedite ..
daśa dattvā suvarṇāni yatphalaṃ tadavāpnuyāt .. 44 ..
16.24.d:
अर्कपुष्पेऽपि चैकस्मिञ्छिवाय विनिवेदिते ..
दश दत्त्वा सुवर्णानि यत्फलं तदवाप्नुयात् .. 44 ..
16.24.m: Even when a single arka flower is offered to Śiva, / one obtains whatever reward is gained by giving ten gold pieces.

16.24.s:
arkapuṣpasahasrebhyaḥ karavīraṃ viśiṣyate ..
karavīra sahasrebhyo droṇapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate .. 45 ..
16.24.d:
अर्कपुष्पसहस्रेभ्यः करवीरं विशिष्यते ..
करवीर सहस्रेभ्यो द्रोणपुष्पं विशिष्यते .. 45 ..
16.24.m: A karavīra flower is superior to thousands of arka flowers; / a droṇapuṣpa flower is superior to thousands of karavīra flowers;

16.24.s:
droṇapuṣpasahasrebhyo hyapāmārgaṃ viśiṣyate ..
apāmārgasahasrebhyaḥ kuśapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate ..
kuśapuṣpa sahasrebhyaḥ śamīpuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate .. 46 ..
16.24.d:
द्रोणपुष्पसहस्रेभ्यो ह्यपामार्गं विशिष्यते ..
अपामार्गसहस्रेभ्यः कुशपुष्पं विशिष्यते ..
कुशपुष्प सहस्रेभ्यः शमीपुष्पं विशिष्यते .. 46 ..
16.24.m: an apāmārga flower is superior to thousands of droṇapuṣpa flowers; / a kuśa flower is superior to thousands of apāmārga flowers; / a śamī flower is superior to thousands of kuśa flowers;

16.24.s:
śamīpuṣpaṃ bṛhatyāśca kusumaṃ tulyamucyate ..
karavīrasamā jñeyā jātīvijayapāṭalāḥ .. 47 ..
16.24.d:
शमीपुष्पं बृहत्याश्च कुसुमं तुल्यमुच्यते ..
करवीरसमा ज्ञेया जातीविजयपाटलाः .. 47 ..
16.24.m: the śamī flower is said to be equal to the blossom of the bṛhatī plant; / jātī, vijayā, and pāṭalā flowers are to be regarded as equal to the karavīra.

16.24.s:
śvetamaṃdāra kusumaṃ sitaṃpadmasamaṃ bhavet ..
nāgacaṃpakapunnāgadhattūrakusumaṃ smṛtam .. 48 ..
16.24.d:
श्वेतमंदार कुसुमं सितंपद्मसमं भवेत् ..
नागचंपकपुन्नागधत्तूरकुसुमं स्मृतम् .. 48 ..
16.24.m: The white mandāra flower is equal to the white lotus; / nagacampaka, punnāga, and dhattūra blossoms are celebrated.

16.24.s:
ketakījātimuktaṃ ca kandayūthīmadantikāḥ ..
śirīṣasarjajaṃbūkakusumāni vivarjjayet .. 49 ..
16.24.d:
केतकीजातिमुक्तं च कन्दयूथीमदन्तिकाः ..
शिरीषसर्जजंबूककुसुमानि विवर्ज्जयेत् .. 49 ..
16.24.m: Excepting the ketakī and the jātī, one should avoid the kanda, yūthī, madantikā, / sirīṣa, sarja, and jambūka flowers.

16.24.s:
ākulīkusumaṃ patraṃ karaṃjendrasamudbhavam ..
bibhītakāni puṣpāṇi kusumāni vivarjjayet .. 7.1.24.50 ..
16.24.d:
आकुलीकुसुमं पत्रं करंजेन्द्रसमुद्भवम् ..
बिभीतकानि पुष्पाणि कुसुमानि विवर्ज्जयेत् .. 7.1.24.50 ..
16.24.m: One should avoid the ākulī blossom, the leaf of the karañja and the indrasamudbhava, / and the flowers of the bibhītaka.

16.24.s:
kanakāni kadaṃbāni rātrau deyāni śaṃkare ..
devaśeṣāṇi puṣpāṇi divā rātrau ca mallikā .. 51 ..
16.24.d:
कनकानि कदंबानि रात्रौ देयानि शंकरे ..
देवशेषाणि पुष्पाणि दिवा रात्रौ च मल्लिका .. 51 ..
16.24.m: Dhattūra and kadamba flowers should be offered to Śaṃkara at night; / the remaining flowers of the god may be offered by day and the mallikā by night.

16.24.s:
praharaṃ tiṣṭhate mallī karavīramaharniśam ..
kīṭakeśāpaviddhāni rātrau paryuṣitāni ca .. 52 ..
16.24.d:
प्रहरं तिष्ठते मल्ली करवीरमहर्निशम् ..
कीटकेशापविद्धानि रात्रौ पर्युषितानि च .. 52 ..
16.24.m: The mallikā remains fresh for one watch, the karavīra for a day and night; / [flowers] infested with insects or contaminated with hair, and those left overnight,

16.24.s:
svayaṃ patitapuṣpāṇi tyajedupahatāni ca ..
tulasī śatapatraṃ ca gandhārī damanastathā .. 53 ..
16.24.d:
स्वयं पतितपुष्पाणि त्यजेदुपहतानि च ..
