तुलसी शतपत्रं च गन्धारी दमनस्तथा .. 53 ..
16.24.m: flowers that have fallen of their own accord, and those that are damaged, one should discard; / tulasī, the hundred-petaled lotus, gandhārī, and damana,

16.24.s:
sarvāsāṃ patrajātīnāṃ śreṣṭho marubakaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
etaiḥ puṣpaviśeṣaistu pūjyaḥ someśvaraḥ sadā .. 54 ..
16.24.d:
सर्वासां पत्रजातीनां श्रेष्ठो मरुबकः स्मृतः ..
एतैः पुष्पविशेषैस्तु पूज्यः सोमेश्वरः सदा .. 54 ..
16.24.m: and marubaka is remembered as the best among all kinds of leaves: / with these distinguished flowers Someśvara is always to be worshipped.

16.24.s:
yātrāyāḥ phalamāpnoti svargaloke mahīyate..
etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata .. 55 ..
16.24.d:
यात्रायाः फलमाप्नोति स्वर्गलोके महीयते..
एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं तत्रैवान्तरधीयत .. 55 ..
16.24.m: He attains the fruit of pilgrimage and is glorified in the heavenly realm." / Having spoken this speech, he disappeared right there.

16.24.s:
candramā yakṣmaṇā muktaḥ svasthānanirato'bhavat ..
āhūya viśvakarmāṇaṃ prāsādaṃ paryakalpayat ..
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ gokṣīradhavalojjvalam .. 56 ..
16.24.d:
चन्द्रमा यक्ष्मणा मुक्तः स्वस्थाननिरतोऽभवत् ..
आहूय विश्वकर्माणं प्रासादं पर्यकल्पयत् ..
शुद्धस्फटिकसंकाशं गोक्षीरधवलोज्ज्वलम् .. 56 ..
16.24.m: The moon, freed from consumption, returned happily to his own station; / having summoned Viśvakarman, he had a temple built, / resembling pure crystal, radiant and white as cow's milk,

16.24.s:
prāsādaṃ merunāmānaṃ hemaprākāratoraṇam ..
caturdaśānye paritaḥ prāsādāḥ parikalpitāḥ ..
teṣāṃ nāmāni vakṣyāmi pratyekaṃ tāni me śṛṇu .. 57 ..
16.24.d:
प्रासादं मेरुनामानं हेमप्राकारतोरणम् ..
चतुर्दशान्ये परितः प्रासादाः परिकल्पिताः ..
तेषां नामानि वक्ष्यामि प्रत्येकं तानि मे शृणु .. 57 ..
16.24.m: a temple named Meru, with golden walls and arched gateways; / and fourteen other temples were constructed all around it. / I shall tell you their names one by one; hear them from me:

16.24.s:
kesarī sarvatobhadro nadano nandiśālakaḥ ..
nandīśo mandaraścaiva śrīvṛkṣo hyamṛtodbhavaḥ .. 58 ..
16.24.d:
केसरी सर्वतोभद्रो नदनो नन्दिशालकः ..
नन्दीशो मन्दरश्चैव श्रीवृक्षो ह्यमृतोद्भवः .. 58 ..
16.24.m: Kesarī, Sarvatobhadra, Nadana, Nandiśālaka, / Nandīśa, Mandara, Śrīvṛkṣa, and Amṛtodbhava,

16.24.s:
himavānhemakūṭaśca kailāsaḥ pṛthivījayaḥ ..
indranīlo mahānīlo bhūdharo ratnakūṭakaḥ .. 59 ..
16.24.d:
हिमवान्हेमकूटश्च कैलासः पृथिवीजयः ..
इन्द्रनीलो महानीलो भूधरो रत्नकूटकः .. 59 ..
16.24.m: Himavān, Hemakūṭa, Kailāsa, Pṛthivījaya, / Indranīla, Mahānīla, Bhūdhara, Ratnakūṭaka,

16.24.s:
vaiḍūryaḥ padmarāgaśca vajrako mukuṭojjvalaḥ ..
airāvato rājahaṃso garuḍo vṛṣabhastathā .. 7.1.24.60 ..
16.24.d:
वैडूर्यः पद्मरागश्च वज्रको मुकुटोज्ज्वलः ..
ऐरावतो राजहंसो गरुडो वृषभस्तथा .. 7.1.24.60 ..
16.24.m: Vaiḍūrya, Padmarāga, Vajraka, Mukuṭojjvala, / Airāvata, Rājahaṃsa, Garuḍa, and Vṛṣabha;

16.24.s:
meruḥ prāsādarājā ca devānāmālayo hi saḥ ..
ādau pañcāṇḍako jñeyaḥ kesarīnāmataḥ sthitaḥ .. 61 ..
16.24.d:
मेरुः प्रासादराजा च देवानामालयो हि सः ..
आदौ पञ्चाण्डको ज्ञेयः केसरीनामतः स्थितः .. 61 ..
16.24.m: and Meru, the king of temples, for that is the abode of the gods. / At first, it is known as having five cupolas, established by the name Kesarī;

16.24.s: caturthāṃśā ca tadvṛddhiryāvanmeruḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 62 ..
16.24.d: चतुर्थांशा च तद्वृद्धिर्यावन्मेरुः प्रकीर्तितः .. 62 ..
16.24.m: and its increase is by a fourth part up to that which is proclaimed as Meru.

16.24.s:
evaṃ pṛthakkārayitvā prāsādāṃśca caturdaśa ..
brahmādīnāṃ devatānāṃ samīpasthānavāsinām .. 63 ..
16.24.d:
एवं पृथक्कारयित्वा प्रासादांश्च चतुर्दश ..
ब्रह्मादीनां देवतानां समीपस्थानवासिनाम् .. 63 ..
16.24.m: Having thus caused fourteen temples to be built separately / for the deities, Brahmā and others, who reside in the nearby places,

16.24.s:
daśa cānyānbhūdharādīnvṛṣabhāntānvarānane ..
ādau kaparddinaṃ kṛtvā prāsādānparyakalpayat .. 64 ..
16.24.d:
दश चान्यान्भूधरादीन्वृषभान्तान्वरानने ..
आदौ कपर्द्दिनं कृत्वा प्रासादान्पर्यकल्पयत् .. 64 ..
16.24.m: and ten others, O fair-faced one, beginning with the Bhūdhara and ending with the Vṛṣabha, / he first installed Kapardin and designed the temples.

16.24.s:
meruḥ prāsādarājo vai sa tu someśvare kṛtaḥ ..
tretāyuge tu daśame manovairvasvatasya ca .. 65 ..
16.24.d:
मेरुः प्रासादराजो वै स तु सोमेश्वरे कृतः ..
त्रेतायुगे तु दशमे मनोवैर्वस्वतस्य च .. 65 ..
16.24.m: The Meru temple, the king of temples, was built for Someśvara / in the tenth Tretāyuga of Vaivasvata Manu.

16.24.s:
kārayitvā maṃḍapāṃśca pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi ..
nadānāṃ tu śataṃ kṛtvā vāpīkūpa sahasrakam .. 66 ..
16.24.d:
कारयित्वा मंडपांश्च प्रतिष्ठाप्य यथाविधि ..
नदानां तु शतं कृत्वा वापीकूप सहस्रकम् .. 66 ..
16.24.m: Having pavilions erected and consecrating them according to the rules, / having created a hundred reservoirs and a thousand stepwells and wells,

16.24.s:
gṛhāṇāṃ tu sahasrāṇi dīnānāthāśrayāṇi ca ..
kārayitvā vidhānena viprebhyaḥ pradadau pṛthak .. 67 ..
16.24.d:
गृहाणां तु सहस्राणि दीनानाथाश्रयाणि च ..
कारयित्वा विधानेन विप्रेभ्यः प्रददौ पृथक् .. 67 ..
16.24.m: and having built thousands of houses providing refuge for the poor and helpless, / he duly distributed them to the brahmins separately.

16.24.s:
niveśya nagaraṃ somaḥ śrīsomeśvarasannidhau ..
svakarmaṇāṃ pracārārthamathābhyarthayata dvijān .. 68 ..
16.24.d:
निवेश्य नगरं सोमः श्रीसोमेश्वरसन्निधौ ..
स्वकर्मणां प्रचारार्थमथाभ्यर्थयत द्विजान् .. 68 ..
16.24.m: Having established the city near the glorious Someśvara, / Soma then made a request to the twice-born for the conduct of his duties:

16.24.s:
somo'smi bhavatāṃ rājā prasādātparameṣṭhinaḥ ..
tathāpi vinayenaiva bhaktyā vijñāpayāmi vaḥ .. 69 ..
16.24.d:
सोमोऽस्मि भवतां राजा प्रसादात्परमेष्ठिनः ..
तथापि विनयेनैव भक्त्या विज्ञापयामि वः .. 69 ..
16.24.m: “I am Soma, your king by the grace of the Supreme Lord. / Yet with utmost humility and devotion I make this submission to you:

16.24.s:
dhanaṃ hiraṇyaratnādi dhānyaṃ vrīhiyavādikam ..
gomahiṣyādipaśavo vastrāṇi vividhāni ca .. .. 7.1.24.70 ..
16.24.d:
धनं हिरण्यरत्नादि धान्यं व्रीहियवादिकम् ..
गोमहिष्यादिपशवो वस्त्राणि विविधानि च .. .. 7.1.24.70 ..
16.24.m: Wealth consisting of gold, jewels, and the like; grain consisting of rice, barley, and the like; / livestock such as cows and buffaloes; and diverse kinds of garments;

16.24.s:
kadalīnālikerāṇi tāṃbūlīpūgamālinaḥ ..
mano'bhirāmacaramā ārāmāḥ paritaḥ sthitāḥ .. 71 ..
16.24.d:
कदलीनालिकेराणि तांबूलीपूगमालिनः ..
मनोऽभिरामचरमा आरामाः परितः स्थिताः .. 71 ..
16.24.m: plantains, coconuts, garlands of betel vines and areca palms, / and delightful groves lie all around.

16.24.s:
jaṃbūdvīpādhipāḥ sarve bhavatāmatravāsi nām..
ādeśaṃ ca kariṣyaṃti śirasyādhāya śobhanam ..72..
16.24.d:
जंबूद्वीपाधिपाः सर्वे भवतामत्रवासि नाम्..
आदेशं च करिष्यंति शिरस्याधाय शोभनम् ..72..
16.24.m: All the rulers of Jambudvīpa will bow their heads / and carry out the noble command of you who reside here.

16.24.s:
dvīpāṃtarādāgataiśca karpūrāgurucaṃdanaiḥ ..
anyaiśca vividhairdravyaiḥ saṃpūrṇā bhavatāṃ gṛhāḥ ..73..
16.24.d:
द्वीपांतरादागतैश्च कर्पूरागुरुचंदनैः ..
अन्यैश्च विविधैर्द्रव्यैः संपूर्णा भवतां गृहाः ..73..
16.24.m: Your houses are filled with camphor, agallochum, and sandalwood brought from other continents, / and with various other goods.

16.24.s:
paṇyānāṃ śatasaṃkhyānāṃ vyavahāranidarśinaḥ ..
brahmottarāṇi tanvaṃti vaṇijo lābhakāṃkṣiṇaḥ .. 74 ..
16.24.d:
पण्यानां शतसंख्यानां व्यवहारनिदर्शिनः ..
ब्रह्मोत्तराणि तन्वंति वणिजो लाभकांक्षिणः .. 74 ..
16.24.m: Merchants eager for profit, who show mastery in commerce involving hundreds of commodities, / establish grants for brahmins.

16.24.s:
bhavatsu bhṛtyabhāvena varttamānā hitaiṣiṇaḥ ..
te cānye ca tathā paurā nāvasīdaṃti karhicit .. 75 ..
16.24.d:
भवत्सु भृत्यभावेन वर्त्तमाना हितैषिणः ..
ते चान्ये च तथा पौरा नावसीदंति कर्हिचित् .. 75 ..
16.24.m: Remaining as your servants, wishing for your welfare, / they and other citizens will never suffer distress.

16.24.s:
evaṃ saṃpūrṇavibhavairbhavadbhiḥ śreyase mama ..
kratukriyā vitanyaṃtāṃ vidhivadbhūridakṣiṇāḥ .. 76 ..
16.24.d:
एवं संपूर्णविभवैर्भवद्भिः श्रेयसे मम ..
क्रतुक्रिया वितन्यंतां विधिवद्भूरिदक्षिणाः .. 76 ..
16.24.m: Therefore, being completely endowed with wealth, for my welfare / let sacrificial rites be performed according to rule, with lavish gifts to the priests.

16.24.s:
brahmādīni ca sarvāṇi pravartaṃtāmaharniśam ..
dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇādīnāṃ kriyatāmārtināśanam .. 77 ..
16.24.d:
ब्रह्मादीनि च सर्वाणि प्रवर्तंतामहर्निशम् ..
दीनांधकृपणादीनां क्रियतामार्तिनाशनम् .. 77 ..
16.24.m: Let all rites, beginning with the sacred study, proceed day and night; / let the distress of the poor, the blind, and the destitute be dispelled.

16.24.s:
abhyāgatānāmaucityādātithyaṃ ca vidhīyatām..
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena sametānāṃ mahātmanām .. 78 ..
16.24.d:
अभ्यागतानामौचित्यादातिथ्यं च विधीयताम्..
तीर्थयात्राप्रसंगेन समेतानां महात्मनाम् .. 78 ..
16.24.m: Let hospitality be properly extended to guests / and to the great-souled men who have arrived on pilgrimage to the sacred ford.

16.24.s:
brahmarṣīṇāmāśrameṣu dīyatāmāśrayāḥ sadā ..
mayātra sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ sarvakālaṃ dṛḍhavratāḥ .. 79 ..
16.24.d:
ब्रह्मर्षीणामाश्रमेषु दीयतामाश्रयाः सदा ..
मयात्र स्थापितं लिंगं सर्वकालं दृढव्रताः .. 79 ..
16.24.m: Let refuge always be granted in the hermitages of the brahmin seers. / The liṅga established here by me, O you of firm vows,

16.24.s:
pavitrairupacāraiśca pūjayaṃtu dvijottamāḥ ..
aṣṭau pramāṇapuruṣāḥ paurāṇāṃ kāryadarśinaḥ .. 7.1.24.80 ..
16.24.d:
पवित्रैरुपचारैश्च पूजयंतु द्विजोत्तमाः ..
अष्टौ प्रमाणपुरुषाः पौराणां कार्यदर्शिनः .. 7.1.24.80 ..
16.24.m: let the best of the twice-born worship at all times with pure offerings. / Let eight authoritative men, overseers of the affairs of the citizens,

16.24.s:
vyavahārānavekṣadhvaṃ smṛtyācāraviśāradāḥ ..
vyavasthāṃ matkṛtāmetāṃ bhavaṃto'tra dvijottamāḥ .. 81..
16.24.d:
व्यवहारानवेक्षध्वं स्मृत्याचारविशारदाः ..
व्यवस्थां मत्कृतामेतां भवंतोऽत्र द्विजोत्तमाः .. 81..
16.24.m: look after legal affairs, skilled in sacred tradition and custom. / This regulation established by me, O best of the twice-born,

16.24.s:
dhārayaṃtu mahātmāno diggajā iva medinīm ..
evaṃ prabhutvamāsthāya sthāne'smiñchivaśālini ..82..
16.24.d:
धारयंतु महात्मानो दिग्गजा इव मेदिनीम् ..
एवं प्रभुत्वमास्थाय स्थानेऽस्मिञ्छिवशालिनि ..82..
16.24.m: let the great-souled men uphold, just as the quarter-elephants support the earth. / Thus exercising authority in this place blessed by Śiva,

16.24.s:
śrutismṛtipurāṇoktāndharmānācarata dvijāḥ ..
niśamya somasya vaco vinītamiti te dvijāḥ .. 83 ..
16.24.d:
श्रुतिस्मृतिपुराणोक्तान्धर्मानाचरत द्विजाः ..
निशम्य सोमस्य वचो विनीतमिति ते द्विजाः .. 83 ..
16.24.m: practice the duties prescribed by the Vedas, smṛtis, and Purāṇas, O twice-born.” / Hearing this humble speech of Soma, those twice-born [deliberated];

16.24.s:
uvāca kauśikasteṣu gotrāṇāṃ prathamo dvijaḥ ..
sādhūpadiṣṭamasmākaṃ dvijarājena sarvathā ..84..
16.24.d:
उवाच कौशिकस्तेषु गोत्राणां प्रथमो द्विजः ..
साधूपदिष्टमस्माकं द्विजराजेन सर्वथा ..84..
16.24.m: Kauśika, the foremost twice-born among the clans, said to them: / “All that has been instructed to us by the king of the twice-born is excellent in every way.

16.24.s:
sarvametatkariṣyāmaḥ kiṃtu kiṃcinniśāmaya ..
niyogataḥ pūjayatāṃ śivanirmālyasevinām .. .. 85 ..
16.24.d:
सर्वमेतत्करिष्यामः किंतु किंचिन्निशामय ..
नियोगतः पूजयतां शिवनिर्माल्यसेविनाम् .. .. 85 ..
16.24.m: We will do all this, yet listen to something: / for those who worship by mandatory assignment, partaking of the offerings dedicated to Śiva,

16.24.s:
pātityaṃ jāyate'smākaṃ śrutismṛtivigarhitam ..
śrutismṛtī hi rudrasya yasmādājñādvayaṃ mahat .. 86 ..
16.24.d:
पातित्यं जायतेऽस्माकं श्रुतिस्मृतिविगर्हितम् ..
श्रुतिस्मृती हि रुद्रस्य यस्मादाज्ञाद्वयं महत् .. 86 ..
16.24.m: there arises a fall from caste, condemned by the Vedas and the smṛtis. / For the Vedas and the smṛtis are the two great commands of Rudra.

16.24.s: kastadullaṃghayenmūḍhaḥ prāṇaiḥ kaṃṭhaga tairapi .. 87 ..
16.24.d: कस्तदुल्लंघयेन्मूढः प्राणैः कंठग तैरपि .. 87 ..
16.24.m: What fool would transgress that, even if his life-breaths were at his throat?

16.24.s:
aṣṭamūrteḥ punarmūrttāvagnau devamukhe makhān ..
kurvāṇāḥ śrutimārgeṇa prīṇayāmo'khilaṃ jagat .. 88 ..
16.24.d:
अष्टमूर्तेः पुनर्मूर्त्तावग्नौ देवमुखे मखान् ..
कुर्वाणाः श्रुतिमार्गेण प्रीणयामोऽखिलं जगत् .. 88 ..
16.24.m: Moreover, offering sacrifices according to the Vedic path in the fire, the mouth of the gods, / which is a manifestation of the Eight-formed Lord, we satisfy the entire universe.

16.24.s:
jagadbhagavato rūpaṃ vyaktameta tpuradviṣaḥ ..
mitho vibhinnamityetadabhinnaṃ punarīśvarāt .. 89 ..
16.24.d:
जगद्भगवतो रूपं व्यक्तमेत त्पुरद्विषः ..
मिथो विभिन्नमित्येतदभिन्नं पुनरीश्वरात् .. 89 ..
16.24.m: This world is the manifest form of the Lord, the foe of Tripura; / though manifold among itself, it is nevertheless non-different from Īśvara.

16.24.s:
agnau prāstāhutiḥ samyagādityamupatiṣṭhate ..
ādityājjāyate vṛṣṭirvṛṣṭerannaṃ tataḥ prajāḥ .. 7.1.24.90 ..
16.24.d:
अग्नौ प्रास्ताहुतिः सम्यगादित्यमुपतिष्ठते ..
आदित्याज्जायते वृष्टिर्वृष्टेरन्नं ततः प्रजाः .. 7.1.24.90 ..
16.24.m: An oblation properly cast into the fire reaches the sun; / from the sun rain is born, from rain food, and from that all creatures.

16.24.s:
śrutismṛtipurāṇādisadabhyāsaprasaṃginām ..
tattadartheṣu puṇyārthaṃ pravṛttākhilakarmaṇām .. 91 ..
16.24.d:
श्रुतिस्मृतिपुराणादिसदभ्यासप्रसंगिनाम् ..
तत्तदर्थेषु पुण्यार्थं प्रवृत्ताखिलकर्मणाम् .. 91 ..
16.24.m: For us, who are devoted to the noble study of the Vedas, smṛtis, Purāṇas, and other texts, / and whose actions are entirely engaged in those respective duties for merit,

16.24.s:
asmākamavakāśo'pi viralo liṃga pūjane ..
rudrajāpyairmahāyajñairyajānāścaivamīśvaram .. 92 ..
16.24.d:
अस्माकमवकाशोऽपि विरलो लिंग पूजने ..
रुद्रजाप्यैर्महायज्ञैर्यजानाश्चैवमीश्वरम् .. 92 ..
16.24.m: even the leisure for liṅga worship is scarce. / Worshipping Īśvara through the great sacrifices and the recitation of the Rudra prayers,

16.24.s:
yathākṣaṇaṃ yathākālaṃ liṃgaṃ vedamupāsmahe ..
yattu te'bhimataṃ soma śrīsomeśvarapūjanam ..
tacca saṃpādayiṣyāmaḥ saviśeṣaṃ mahāmate .. 93 ..
16.24.d:
यथाक्षणं यथाकालं लिंगं वेदमुपास्महे ..
यत्तु तेऽभिमतं सोम श्रीसोमेश्वरपूजनम् ..
तच्च संपादयिष्यामः सविशेषं महामते .. 93 ..
16.24.m: we worship the liṅga and the Veda whenever there is an opportune moment and time. / As for what you desire, O Soma, namely the worship of the glorious Someśvara,

16.24.s:
yena tvadīpsitaṃ sidhyettamupāyaṃ niśāmaya ..
gaurīśaṃkarasaṃvādaṃ śrutvā bhagavato mukhāt .. 94 ..
16.24.d:
येन त्वदीप्सितं सिध्येत्तमुपायं निशामय ..
गौरीशंकरसंवादं श्रुत्वा भगवतो मुखात् .. 94 ..
16.24.m: that we shall accomplish with special care, O noble-minded one. / Listen to the means by which what you desire may be achieved:

16.24.s:
nāradaḥ prāha naḥ pūrvaṃ kathayāmastameva te ..
brahmadevadviṣaḥ pūrvaṃ śataśo daityadānavāḥ ..
tapobhirugrairvividhaiḥ śaṃkaraṃ pratipedire .. 95 ..
16.24.d:
नारदः प्राह नः पूर्वं कथयामस्तमेव ते ..
ब्रह्मदेवद्विषः पूर्वं शतशो दैत्यदानवाः ..
तपोभिरुग्रैर्विविधैः शंकरं प्रतिपेदिरे .. 95 ..
16.24.m: having heard the dialogue between Gaurī and Śaṃkara from the mouth of the Lord, / Nārada told it to us previously; that we shall now tell you.

16.24.s:
teṣāmatyugratapasāmananyāsaktacetasām ..
prasādamīśvaraścakre kāruṇyāmṛtasāgaraḥ .. 96 ..
16.24.d:
तेषामत्युग्रतपसामनन्यासक्तचेतसाम् ..
प्रसादमीश्वरश्चक्रे कारुण्यामृतसागरः .. 96 ..
16.24.m: Formerly, Daityas and Dānavas in their hundreds, haters of brahmins and gods, / approached Śaṃkara with diverse and severe austerities.

16.24.s:
sa hi tribhuvanasvāmī devadevo maheśvaraḥ ..
apekṣate varaṃ dātuṃ bhaktimevānapāyinīm .. 97 ..
16.24.d:
स हि त्रिभुवनस्वामी देवदेवो महेश्वरः ..
अपेक्षते वरं दातुं भक्तिमेवानपायिनीम् .. 97 ..
16.24.m: Upon them, endowed with exceedingly severe austerity and single-minded focus, / Īśvara, the ocean of the nectar of compassion, bestowed his grace.

16.24.s:
dadau sa bhuvanaiśvaryyaprāyānabhimatānvarān ..
teṣāṃ bhaktyaiva saṃtuṣṭo devabrahmadviṣāmapi .. 98 ..
16.24.d:
ददौ स भुवनैश्वर्य्यप्रायानभिमतान्वरान् ..
तेषां भक्त्यैव संतुष्टो देवब्रह्मद्विषामपि .. 98 ..
16.24.m: For he, the master of the three worlds, the god of gods, Maheśvara, / requires only imperishable devotion to grant a boon.

16.24.s:
brahmaṇā viṣṇunā cāpi yasyāṃto nādhigamyate ..
tasyātarkyaprabhāvasya ko nu vedāśayaṃ prabhoḥ .. 99 ..
16.24.d:
ब्रह्मणा विष्णुना चापि यस्यांतो नाधिगम्यते ..
तस्यातर्क्यप्रभावस्य को नु वेदाशयं प्रभोः .. 99 ..
16.24.m: Pleased solely by their devotion, he granted the desired boons, / mostly consisting of universal sovereignty, even to those who hated gods and brahmins.

16.24.s:
durvṛttebhyo'pi daityebhyastapobhirvaradāyinam ..
papraccha svacchhṛdayā pārvatī parameśvaram .. 7.1.24.100 ..
16.24.d:
दुर्वृत्तेभ्योऽपि दैत्येभ्यस्तपोभिर्वरदायिनम् ..
पप्रच्छ स्वच्छ्हृदया पार्वती परमेश्वरम् .. 7.1.24.100 ..
16.24.m: Whose limit is not reached even by Brahmā and Viṣṇu— / who indeed knows the intention of that lord of unfathomable power?

16.24.s:
.. pārvatyuvāca .. ..
bhagavanprasādaṃ te prāpya dhṛṣyaṃto bhuvanatrayam ..
upadravaṃtīṃdramukhāndevānsaṃkṣobhayaṃti ca .. 101 ..
16.24.d:
.. पार्वत्युवाच .. ..
भगवन्प्रसादं ते प्राप्य धृष्यंतो भुवनत्रयम् ..
उपद्रवंतींद्रमुखान्देवान्संक्षोभयंति च .. 101 ..
16.24.m: To the Supreme Lord who grants boons through austerities even to evil-natured Daityas, / Pārvatī, pure in heart, asked:

16.24.s:
varaṃ dadāsi kiṃ teṣāṃ tādṛśānāṃ durātmanām ..
jagataḥ svastaye yeṣāṃ na manāgapi ceṣṭitam .. 102..
16.24.d:
वरं ददासि किं तेषां तादृशानां दुरात्मनाम् ..
जगतः स्वस्तये येषां न मनागपि चेष्टितम् .. 102..
16.24.m: Pārvatī said: / “O Blessed One, having attained your grace and becoming arrogant, they torment the three worlds / and harass and agitate the gods headed by Indra.

16.24.s:
tvayā dattavarānetāndivyānbhogopabhoginaḥ ..
avadhīrya tavaiśvaryaṃ kathaṃ viṣṇurnihaṃti ca .. 103 ..
16.24.d:
त्वया दत्तवरानेतान्दिव्यान्भोगोपभोगिनः ..
अवधीर्य तवैश्वर्यं कथं विष्णुर्निहंति च .. 103 ..
16.24.m: Why do you grant a boon to such evil-minded ones, / whose deeds do not contribute even in the least to the welfare of the world?

16.24.s: hatānāṃ ca punasteṣāṃ kā gatiḥ syādvada prabho .. 104 ..
16.24.d: हतानां च पुनस्तेषां का गतिः स्याद्वद प्रभो .. 104 ..
16.24.m: When they enjoy divine pleasures after being granted boons by you, / how is it that Viṣṇu slays them, disregarding your sovereignty?

16.24.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
sāttvikā rājasāścaiva tāmasāśceti vai tridhā ..
bhavaṃti lokāsteṣvete tamaḥprāyā durāsadāḥ .. 105 ..
16.24.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
सात्त्विका राजसाश्चैव तामसाश्चेति वै त्रिधा ..
भवंति लोकास्तेष्वेते तमःप्राया दुरासदाः .. 105 ..
16.24.m: And when they are slain, what destination is theirs? Tell me, O Lord.”

16.24.s:
suraiḥ saha spardhamānāstapobhirapi tāmasaiḥ ..
māṃ bhajaṃte muhurmohājjagadutsādanodyatāḥ .. 106 ..
16.24.d:
सुरैः सह स्पर्धमानास्तपोभिरपि तामसैः ..
मां भजंते मुहुर्मोहाज्जगदुत्सादनोद्यताः .. 106 ..
16.24.m: Īśvara said: / “Creatures are threefold: sāttvika, rājasika, / and tāmasika; among them, these [Daityas] are mostly tāmasika and difficult to subdue.

16.24.s:
varaṃ dadāmi yatteṣāṃ bhaktistatra tu kāraṇam ..
ahaṃ hi bhaktyā sugrāhyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. ..107..
16.24.d:
वरं ददामि यत्तेषां भक्तिस्तत्र तु कारणम् ..
अहं हि भक्त्या सुग्राह्यो नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. ..107..
16.24.m:
That I grant them a boon is solely on account of devotion;
for I am easily won through devotion; no doubt should be held in this regard.

16.24.s:
taponurūpānāsādya varāṃste pāpakāriṇaḥ ..
viṣṇunā yannihanyate tacca devi nibodha me..108..
16.24.d:
तपोनुरूपानासाद्य वरांस्ते पापकारिणः ..
विष्णुना यन्निहन्यते तच्च देवि निबोध मे..108..
16.24.m:
Having obtained boons suited to their austerities, those evildoers
are slain by Viṣṇu; understand that from me, O goddess.

16.24.s:
ahaṃ hariśca yadbhinnau guṇabhāgo'tra kāraṇam ..
paramārthādabhinnau ca rahasyaṃ paramaṃ hyadaḥ..109..
ārādhyārādhakādiśca bhedaḥ sāmānya eva nau..
tathā hyahamimāṃ gaṃgāṃ viṣṇoḥ pādāgraniḥsṛtām..7.1.24.11...
16.24.d:
अहं हरिश्च यद्भिन्नौ गुणभागोऽत्र कारणम् ..
परमार्थादभिन्नौ च रहस्यं परमं ह्यदः..109..
आराध्याराधकादिश्च भेदः सामान्य एव नौ..
तथा ह्यहमिमां गंगां विष्णोः पादाग्रनिःसृताम्..7.1.24.11...
16.24.m:
That Hari and I are distinct is due to the division of the guṇas,
yet in the ultimate sense we are non-different; this indeed is the supreme secret.
The distinction of worshipper, object of worship, and so forth is merely conventional between us.
For instance, I bear this Gaṅgā, flowing from the tip of Viṣṇu's foot,

16.24.s:
vahāmi śirasā bhaktyā tvadīkṣāśaṃkito'pi san ..
api viṣṇustribhuvanaṃ paritrātuṃ vyavasthayā ..111..
16.24.d:
वहामि शिरसा भक्त्या त्वदीक्षाशंकितोऽपि सन् ..
अपि विष्णुस्त्रिभुवनं परित्रातुं व्यवस्थया ..111..
16.24.m:
upon my head with devotion, even while apprehensive of your glance.
Viṣṇu too, in order to protect the three worlds according to cosmic order,

16.24.s:
māmupāsya ciraṃ lebhe cakraṃ duṣṭanibarhaṇam..
tvāṃ ca tasya mahāmāyāmaprameyātmano hareḥ .. 112..
16.24.d:
मामुपास्य चिरं लेभे चक्रं दुष्टनिबर्हणम्..
त्वां च तस्य महामायामप्रमेयात्मनो हरेः .. 112..
16.24.m:
worshipped me for a long time and obtained the discus that slays the wicked.
And you, the great māyā of that Hari whose self is immeasurable,

16.24.s:
ārādhayāmi tadbhaktyā trijagajanmakāraṇam ..
śirasyādhāya cānyāṃ me śaktirūpāṃ tathā hariḥ ..113..
16.24.d:
आराधयामि तद्भक्त्या त्रिजगजन्मकारणम् ..
शिरस्याधाय चान्यां मे शक्तिरूपां तथा हरिः ..113..
16.24.m:
I worship with devotion to him as the cause of the birth of the three worlds.
Likewise, Hari, placing upon his head another [goddess] who is the form of my power,

16.24.s:
ajo'pi janmānyāsādya lokarakṣāṃ karoti vai ..
haṃtuṃ hiraṇyakaśipuṃ narasiṃhavapuśca saḥ ..114..
16.24.d:
अजोऽपि जन्मान्यासाद्य लोकरक्षां करोति वै ..
हंतुं हिरण्यकशिपुं नरसिंहवपुश्च सः ..114..
16.24.m:
though unborn, takes births and performs the protection of the worlds.
And in order to slay Hiraṇyakaśipu, having assumed the form of Narasiṃha,

16.24.s:
jagajjighāṃsuḥ śamito mayā śarabha rūpiṇā ..
māṃ ca bāṇaparitrāṇe triśūlodyamakāriṇam .. 115 ..
16.24.d:
जगज्जिघांसुः शमितो मया शरभ रूपिणा ..
मां च बाणपरित्राणे त्रिशूलोद्यमकारिणम् .. 115 ..
16.24.m:
he wished to destroy the world and was pacified by me in the form of Śarabha.
And when I raised my trident in defense of Bāṇa,

16.24.s:
mānuṣye'pyavatāre'sau staṃbhayitvā sa līlayā ..
prabhāvaṃ mahimānaṃ ca varddhayanmāmakaṃ hariḥ ..
varivasyati māṃ nityamaṃtarātmāpi me vibhuḥ .. 116 ..
16.24.d:
मानुष्येऽप्यवतारेऽसौ स्तंभयित्वा स लीलया ..
प्रभावं महिमानं च वर्द्धयन्मामकं हरिः ..
वरिवस्यति मां नित्यमंतरात्मापि मे विभुः .. 116 ..
16.24.m:
he, playfully paralyzing [me] even in a human incarnation,
enhancing my power and majesty, Hari,
though the all-pervading inner Self of mine, continually worships me.

16.24.s:
athāhaṃ paramātmānamenamādyaṃtavarjitam ..
dhyānayogaiḥ samādhau ca bhāvayāmi niraṃtaram .. 117 ..
16.24.d:
अथाहं परमात्मानमेनमाद्यंतवर्जितम् ..
ध्यानयोगैः समाधौ च भावयामि निरंतरम् .. 117 ..
16.24.m:
Then I, through the yogas of meditation and in absorption,
constantly contemplate him as the supreme Self, devoid of beginning or end.

16.24.s:
tadevaṃ nāvayorbhedo vidyate pāramārthikaḥ ..
bhedaṃ ca tāratamyaṃ ca mūḍhā eva vitanvate .. 119 ..
vaiṣṇavaṃ rūpamāsthāya durvṛttānhanmi tānaham ..
gatiṃ ca teṣāmadhunā maheśvari niśāmaya .. 119 ..
16.24.d:
तदेवं नावयोर्भेदो विद्यते पारमार्थिकः ..
भेदं च तारतम्यं च मूढा एव वितन्वते .. 119 ..
वैष्णवं रूपमास्थाय दुर्वृत्तान्हन्मि तानहम् ..
गतिं च तेषामधुना महेश्वरि निशामय .. 119 ..
16.24.m:
Thus there is no distinction between us in the ultimate truth;
only fools elaborate upon differences and degrees of superiority.
Assuming the Vaiṣṇava form, I myself slay those of wicked conduct.
And now hear of their destination, O Maheśvarī:

16.24.s:
mayi bhaktyavasāne tu hareḥ saṃdarśanena ca ..
krodhadarpābhibhūtatvānna muktiṃ prāpnuvaṃti te .. 7.1.24.120 ..
16.24.d:
मयि भक्त्यवसाने तु हरेः संदर्शनेन च ..
क्रोधदर्पाभिभूतत्वान्न मुक्तिं प्राप्नुवंति ते .. 7.1.24.120 ..
16.24.m:
At the end of their devotion to me and through the direct sight of Hari,
because they are overcome by anger and pride, they do not attain liberation.

16.24.s:
āvayostu prabhāvena te punarddhautakalmaṣāḥ ..
brahmarṣīṇāṃ kule janma saṃprāptā muktihetukam .. 121 ..
16.24.d:
आवयोस्तु प्रभावेन ते पुनर्द्धौतकल्मषाः ..
ब्रह्मर्षीणां कुले जन्म संप्राप्ता मुक्तिहेतुकम् .. 121 ..
16.24.m:
Yet by our power, with their blemishes washed away,
they obtain birth in the family of brahmin seers, which becomes the cause of their liberation.

16.24.s:
brahmacārivratā dūrdhvaṃ yogaṃ pāśupataṃ śritāḥ ..
prācīnakarmasaṃskārātte punarmāmupāsate .. 122 ..
16.24.d:
ब्रह्मचारिव्रता दूर्ध्वं योगं पाशुपतं श्रिताः ..
प्राचीनकर्मसंस्कारात्ते पुनर्मामुपासते .. 122 ..
16.24.m:
After taking the vow of celibacy, having resorted to the Pāśupata yoga,
they worship me once again through the impressions of former actions.

16.24.s:
bhaktiyogena cāsthāya vrataṃ pāśupatādikam ..
śmaśānavāsino nagnā apare caikavāsasaḥ .. 123 ..
16.24.d:
भक्तियोगेन चास्थाय व्रतं पाशुपतादिकम् ..
श्मशानवासिनो नग्ना अपरे चैकवाससः .. 123 ..
16.24.m:
Resorting to the Pāśupata and other vows through the yoga of devotion,
some dwell in cremation grounds, naked, and others wear a single garment;

16.24.s:
bhikṣābhujo bhūtibhṛto malliṃgānyarccayaṃti te ..
tathā madekāgradhiyo maddhyānaikadṛḍhavratāḥ .. 124 ..
16.24.d:
भिक्षाभुजो भूतिभृतो मल्लिंगान्यर्च्चयंति ते ..
तथा मदेकाग्रधियो मद्ध्यानैकदृढव्रताः .. 124 ..
16.24.m:
living on alms, smeared with sacred ash, they worship my liṅgas;
likewise, their minds are focused on me alone, their firm vow consisting solely of meditating on me.

16.24.s:
ye tvāmapi namasyaṃti jagatāṃ mama ceśvarīm..
dehāvasānayogena muktiṃ teṣāṃ dadāmyaham .. 125 ..
16.24.d:
ये त्वामपि नमस्यंति जगतां मम चेश्वरीम्..
देहावसानयोगेन मुक्तिं तेषां ददाम्यहम् .. 125 ..
16.24.m:
Those who also bow down to you, the sovereign mistress of the worlds and of myself,
to them, through yoga at the departure of their bodies, I grant liberation,

16.24.s:
sārūpyasālokyamayīṃ mayyāveśitacetasām ..
sāyujyamuktaye nāyaṃ yogaḥ pāśupato yataḥ ..
smṛtyācāreṇa munibhiḥ sa sadbhistena garhitaḥ .. 126 ..
16.24.d:
सारूप्यसालोक्यमयीं मय्यावेशितचेतसाम् ..
सायुज्यमुक्तये नायं योगः पाशुपतो यतः ..
स्मृत्याचारेण मुनिभिः स सद्भिस्तेन गर्हितः .. 126 ..
16.24.m:
which consists of having the same form and sharing the same realm, for those whose minds are absorbed in me.
Since this Pāśupata yoga does not lead to complete absorption (sāyujya),
for that reason it is censured by virtuous sages following traditional conduct.

16.24.s:
.. dvijā ūcuḥ .. ..
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena tāni hopagatāndvijān ..
svamānamupaneṣyāmo bhaktyāvarjjitamānasān .. 127 ..
16.24.d:
.. द्विजा ऊचुः .. ..
तीर्थयात्राप्रसंगेन तानि होपगतान्द्विजान् ..
स्वमानमुपनेष्यामो भक्त्यावर्ज्जितमानसान् .. 127 ..
16.24.m:
The twice-born said:
"On the occasion of a pilgrimage to sacred fords, we shall bring those brahmins
who have arrived here, their minds subdued with devotion, to their proper dignity.

16.24.s:
śucibhikṣānnakaupīnakamaṇḍalvādisatkṛtāḥ ..
ananyakāryyāḥ satatamihāgatya tapasvinaḥ .. 128 ..
16.24.d:
शुचिभिक्षान्नकौपीनकमण्डल्वादिसत्कृताः ..
अनन्यकार्य्याः सततमिहागत्य तपस्विनः .. 128 ..
16.24.m:
Honored with pure alms-food, loincloths, water pots, and the like,
having come here constantly with no other business, these ascetics,

16.24.s:
bhavatpradattairvividhairupahārairataṃdritāḥ ..
tattvatastattvasaṃkhyāste śivadharmaikatatparāḥ .. 129 ..
16.24.d:
भवत्प्रदत्तैर्विविधैरुपहारैरतंद्रिताः ..
तत्त्वतस्तत्त्वसंख्यास्ते शिवधर्मैकतत्पराः .. 129 ..
16.24.m:
unwearied, with the various offerings given by you,
the enumeration of the principles according to truth, solely intent on the dharma of Śiva,

16.24.s:
śrīsomeśvaramabhyarcya tava śreyo'bhivarddhakāḥ ..
muktimaṃte gamiṣyaṃti devasyātisudurllabhām.. 7.1.24.130 ..
16.24.d:
श्रीसोमेश्वरमभ्यर्च्य तव श्रेयोऽभिवर्द्धकाः ..
मुक्तिमंते गमिष्यंति देवस्यातिसुदुर्ल्लभाम्.. 7.1.24.130 ..
16.24.m:
having worshipped venerable Someśvara and increasing your welfare,
will ultimately attain the god's most difficult-to-attain liberation.

16.24.s:
tato'nye'tha tato'pyanye tataścānye tapodhanā ..
parīkṣitāstu te'smābhirbhavitāro niśāpate .. 131 ..
16.24.d:
ततोऽन्येऽथ ततोऽप्यन्ये ततश्चान्ये तपोधना ..
परीक्षितास्तु तेऽस्माभिर्भवितारो निशापते .. 131 ..
16.24.m:
Then others, and after them still others, and then other ascetics,
examined by us, shall arise, O lord of the night!"

16.24.s:
.. dvijā ūcuḥ .. ..
ityāha bhagavāndevyā pṛṣṭaḥ sa ca trilocanaḥ ..
tatraiva nāradaḥ sarvaṃ saṃvādaṃ śivayeritam(?).. 132 ..
16.24.d:
.. द्विजा ऊचुः .. ..
इत्याह भगवान्देव्या पृष्टः स च त्रिलोचनः ..
तत्रैव नारदः सर्वं संवादं शिवयेरितम्(?).. 132 ..
16.24.m:
The twice-born said:
Thus spoke the three-eyed Lord when asked by the goddess.
Right there, Nārada heard the whole dialogue uttered by Śiva and Śivā,

16.24.s:
śrutvā naḥ kathayāmāsa kathāṃ goṣṭhīṣu pṛcchatām..
tava cāsmābhiradhunā sarvametadudīritam .. 133 ..
16.24.d:
श्रुत्वा नः कथयामास कथां गोष्ठीषु पृच्छताम्..
तव चास्माभिरधुना सर्वमेतदुदीरितम् .. 133 ..
16.24.m:
and recounted that tale to us as we asked in assemblies.
And now all of this has been spoken to you by us.

16.24.s:
evamuktastu taiḥ prītaḥ somaḥ svabhavanaṃ yayau ..
tadājñayā ca tatsarvaṃ yathoktaṃ te'pi kurvate .. 134 ..
16.24.d:
एवमुक्तस्तु तैः प्रीतः सोमः स्वभवनं ययौ ..
तदाज्ञया च तत्सर्वं यथोक्तं तेऽपि कुर्वते .. 134 ..
16.24.m:
Addressed thus by them, Soma, delighted, went to his own abode;
and by his command, they too perform everything just as was told.

16.24.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
evaṃ prabhāvo deveśaḥ someśaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ ..
kenopāyena tuṣyeta vratena niyamena vā .. 135 ..
16.24.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
एवं प्रभावो देवेशः सोमेशः पापनाशनः ..
केनोपायेन तुष्येत व्रतेन नियमेन वा .. 135 ..
16.24.m:
The goddess said:
Such is the power of Someśa, the lord of gods, the destroyer of sins.
By what means would he be pleased—by which vow or observance?

16.24.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
kathayāmi sphuṭaṃ dharmmaṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ hitāya vai ..
sa yena tuṣyate devaḥ śṛṇu tvaṃ surasundari .. 136 ..
16.24.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
कथयामि स्फुटं धर्म्मं मानुषाणां हिताय वै ..
स येन तुष्यते देवः शृणु त्वं सुरसुन्दरि .. 136 ..
16.24.m:
Īśvara said:
I shall explain clearly the dharma for the benefit of mortals,
by which that god is pleased; hear, O beauty among gods!

16.24.s:
nityopavāsanaktāni vratāni vividhāni ca ..
tīrthe dānāni sarvāṇi pātre dattānyaśeṣataḥ .. 137 ..
16.24.d:
नित्योपवासनक्तानि व्रतानि विविधानि च ..
तीर्थे दानानि सर्वाणि पात्रे दत्तान्यशेषतः .. 137 ..
16.24.m:
Perpetual fasts, meals only at night, and various other vows;
all kinds of gifts given entirely to worthy recipients at sacred fords;

16.24.s:
tapaśca taptaṃ tenaiva snātaṃ tenaiva puṣkare ..
kedāre tu jalaṃ tena gatvā pītaṃ tu niścitam .. 138 ..
16.24.d:
तपश्च तप्तं तेनैव स्नातं तेनैव पुष्करे ..
केदारे तु जलं तेन गत्वा पीतं तु निश्चितम् .. 138 ..
16.24.m:
austerity has been performed by him, ritual ablution has been taken by him at Puṣkara,
and water at Kedāra has certainly been drunk by him;

16.24.s:
tena dṛṣṭaṃ varārohe jyotirliṃgaṃ mahāprabham ..
somavāravrataṃ divyaṃ yena cīrṇaṃ tu saṃśraye .. 139 ..
16.24.d:
तेन दृष्टं वरारोहे ज्योतिर्लिंगं महाप्रभम् ..
सोमवारव्रतं दिव्यं येन चीर्णं तु संश्रये .. 139 ..
16.24.m:
the jyotirliṅga of great radiance has been seen by him, O woman of shapely hips,
by whom the celestial vow of Monday has been undertaken in that refuge.

16.24.s: kimanyairbahubhirdānairdattaiḥ pātreṣu sundari .. 7.1.24.140 ..
16.24.d: किमन्यैर्बहुभिर्दानैर्दत्तैः पात्रेषु सुन्दरि .. 7.1.24.140 ..
16.24.m: What need is there for many other gifts given to worthy recipients, O beautiful one?

16.24.s:
pūjitaṃ yena bhāvena somavāradināṣṭa kam ..
tena sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ devi cīrṇaṃ tatra mahāvratam .. 141 ..
16.24.d:
पूजितं येन भावेन सोमवारदिनाष्ट कम् ..
तेन सर्वं कृतं देवि चीर्णं तत्र महाव्रतम् .. 141 ..
16.24.m:
By whomsoever worship has been performed with devotion on a group of eight Mondays,
by him everything has been done, O goddess; the great vow has been observed there.

16.24.s:
itihāsamimaṃ pūrvaṃ kathayāmi tava priye ..
yathāvṛttaṃ mahādevi somavāravrataṃ prati .. 142 ..
16.24.d:
इतिहासमिमं पूर्वं कथयामि तव प्रिये ..
यथावृत्तं महादेवि सोमवारव्रतं प्रति .. 142 ..
16.24.m:
I shall relate an ancient narrative to you regarding this, O my beloved,
just as it occurred, O great goddess, concerning the Monday vow.

16.24.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
kailāsasya maheśāni uttare ca vyavasthitā..
niṣadhopari vistīrṇā purī nāma svayaṃprabhā .. .. 143 ..
16.24.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
कैलासस्य महेशानि उत्तरे च व्यवस्थिता..
निषधोपरि विस्तीर्णा पुरी नाम स्वयंप्रभा .. .. 143 ..
16.24.m:
Īśvara said:
Situated to the north of Kailāsa, O great sovereign,
spread out upon the Niṣadha mountain, is a city named Svayaṃprabhā,

16.24.s:
nānāratnasuśobhāḍhyā nānāgandharvasaṃkulā ..
sarvāvayavasaṃpūrṇā śakrasyevāmarāvatī .. 144 ..
16.24.d:
नानारत्नसुशोभाढ्या नानागन्धर्वसंकुला ..
सर्वावयवसंपूर्णा शक्रस्येवामरावती .. 144 ..
16.24.m:
richly adorned with various jewels, crowded with various gandharvas,
complete in all its parts like Amarāvatī of Śakra.

16.24.s:
ghanavāhananāmā ca gandharvastatra tiṣṭhati ..
bhuṃkte tatra mahābhogāndevairapi sudurlabhān .. 145 ..
16.24.d:
घनवाहननामा च गन्धर्वस्तत्र तिष्ठति ..
भुंक्ते तत्र महाभोगान्देवैरपि सुदुर्लभान् .. 145 ..
16.24.m:
A gandharva named Ghanavāhana dwells there;
he enjoys there great pleasures difficult to attain even for the gods.

16.24.s:
navayauvanasaṃyuktā bhāryā tasya manoharā ..
prauḍhavākyā suśīlā ca pīnonnatapayodharā .. 146 ..
16.24.d:
नवयौवनसंयुक्ता भार्या तस्य मनोहरा ..
प्रौढवाक्या सुशीला च पीनोन्नतपयोधरा .. 146 ..
16.24.m:
His captivating wife was endowed with fresh youth,
possessed of mature speech, good conduct, and full, raised breasts.

16.24.s:
tayā sārddhaṃ tu sambhogānbhuṃkte gaṃdharvanāyakaḥ ..
utpannā tasya kālena putrī putrāṣṭakopari .. 147 ..
16.24.d:
तया सार्द्धं तु सम्भोगान्भुंक्ते गंधर्वनायकः ..
उत्पन्ना तस्य कालेन पुत्री पुत्राष्टकोपरि .. 147 ..
16.24.m:
Together with her the leader of the gandharvas enjoyed pleasures;
in time, after eight sons, a daughter was born to him.

16.24.s:
sarvāvayavasaṃpannā sarvavijñānavedinī ..
gaṃdharvasenā vikhyātā nāmnā sā parameśvari .. 148 ..
16.24.d:
सर्वावयवसंपन्ना सर्वविज्ञानवेदिनी ..
गंधर्वसेना विख्याता नाम्ना सा परमेश्वरि .. 148 ..
16.24.m:
Endowed with all auspicious features, learned in all branches of knowledge,
she became famous by the name Gandharvasenā, O supreme sovereign.

16.24.s:
kanyānāṃ tu sahasreṣu pravarā rūpaśālinī ..
kautūhalena sā pitrā proktā krīḍasva bhāmini .. 149 ..
16.24.d:
कन्यानां तु सहस्रेषु प्रवरा रूपशालिनी ..
कौतूहलेन सा पित्रा प्रोक्ता क्रीडस्व भामिनि .. 149 ..
16.24.m:
She was foremost among thousands of maidens and endowed with great beauty.
Affectionately, her father said to her, "Play, O radiant maiden!"

16.24.s:
udyāne ramaṇīye'tra nānādrumalatākule ..
vṛkṣairanekaiḥ saṃkīrṇe phalapuṣpasamanvite .. 7.1.24.150 ..
16.24.d:
उद्याने रमणीयेऽत्र नानाद्रुमलताकुले ..
वृक्षैरनेकैः संकीर्णे फलपुष्पसमन्विते .. 7.1.24.150 ..
16.24.m: “In this delightful garden crowded with various trees and creepers, / densely packed with many trees and endowed with fruits and flowers.”

16.24.s:
evaṃ sā ramate nityaṃ kanyāparivṛtā sadā ..
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā krīḍamānā mātā bhartāramabravīt ..151 ..
16.24.d:
एवं सा रमते नित्यं कन्यापरिवृता सदा ..
एवं दृष्ट्वा क्रीडमाना माता भर्तारमब्रवीत् ..151 ..
16.24.m: Thus she rejoiced constantly, always surrounded by maiden companions. / Seeing her playing in this way, her mother said to her husband:

16.24.s:
jīvitaṃ niṣphalaṃ svāminmama te saha bāṃdhavaiḥ ..
yasyedṛśī gṛhe kanyā tiṣṭhate bhartṛvarjjitā .. 152 ..
16.24.d:
जीवितं निष्फलं स्वामिन्मम ते सह बांधवैः ..
यस्येदृशी गृहे कन्या तिष्ठते भर्तृवर्ज्जिता .. 152 ..
16.24.m: “My life and yours together with our kinsmen is fruitless, my lord, / in whose house such a maiden remains without a husband.”

16.24.s:
ityuktaḥ sa tu gaṃdharvo bhāryāṃ vacanamabravīt ..
anveṣayāmi bharttāraṃ putryarthe tu manoharam .. 153 ..
16.24.d:
इत्युक्तः स तु गंधर्वो भार्यां वचनमब्रवीत् ..
अन्वेषयामि भर्त्तारं पुत्र्यर्थे तु मनोहरम् .. 153 ..
16.24.m: Thus addressed, the gandharva said these words to his wife: / “I shall seek a charming husband for the sake of our daughter.”

16.24.s:
ityuktvā''hvāpayāmāsa putrīṃ tāṃ ghanavāhanaḥ ..
āhūtā pitṛmātṛbhyāṃ tvaritā''gatya sundari .. 154 ..
16.24.d:
इत्युक्त्वा'ऽह्वापयामास पुत्रीं तां घनवाहनः ..
आहूता पितृमातृभ्यां त्वरिता'ऽगत्य सुन्दरि .. 154 ..
16.24.m: Having said this, Ghanavāhana summoned that daughter of his. / Summoned by her parents, having come swiftly, O beautiful woman,

16.24.s:
anukrameṇa sarveṣāṃ patitā pādayoḥ śubhā ..
ādeśaṃ dehi me tāta ki nu kāryaṃ mayā''dhunā .. 155 ..
16.24.d:
अनुक्रमेण सर्वेषां पतिता पादयोः शुभा ..
आदेशं देहि मे तात कि नु कार्यं मया'ऽधुना .. 155 ..
16.24.m: she, auspicious one, fell at the feet of all in due order: / “Give me a command, father! What task is to be done by me now?”

16.24.s:
uktaṃ ca ghanavāhena harṣitena vacastataḥ ..
he putri tava yaḥ kaścidvaraḥ saṃprati rocate ..
divyaṃ drakṣye tvatsadṛśaṃ gaṃdharvāṇāṃ śiromaṇim .. 156 ..
16.24.d:
उक्तं च घनवाहेन हर्षितेन वचस्ततः ..
हे पुत्रि तव यः कश्चिद्वरः संप्रति रोचते ..
दिव्यं द्रक्ष्ये त्वत्सदृशं गंधर्वाणां शिरोमणिम् .. 156 ..
16.24.m: Then these words were spoken by the delighted Ghanavāhana: / “O daughter, whichever bridegroom presently pleases you, / I shall see an extraordinary crest-jewel among the gandharvas worthy of you.”

16.24.s:
ityuktā krodhatāmrākṣī pitaraṃ vākyamabravīt ..
mama rūpasya koṭyaṃśe kiṃ kopyasti jagattraye ..
tacchrutvā cādbhutaṃ vākyaṃ pitā mātā ca mohitau.. 157 ..
16.24.d:
इत्युक्ता क्रोधताम्राक्षी पितरं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ..
मम रूपस्य कोट्यंशे किं कोप्यस्ति जगत्त्रये ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा चाद्भुतं वाक्यं पिता माता च मोहितौ.. 157 ..
16.24.m: Thus spoken to, her eyes red with anger, she said to her father: / “Is there anyone in the three worlds who equals even a ten-millionth part of my beauty?” / Hearing that astonishing statement, both mother and father were bewildered.

16.24.s:
sarve viṣādamāpannā bāṃdhavāśca pare janāḥ ..
aśobhanamidaṃ vākyaṃ kanyayā yatprabhāṣitam ..
ityuktvā tu gatāḥ sarve jananījanabāṃdhavāḥ .. 158 ..
16.24.d:
सर्वे विषादमापन्ना बांधवाश्च परे जनाः ..
अशोभनमिदं वाक्यं कन्यया यत्प्रभाषितम् ..
इत्युक्त्वा तु गताः सर्वे जननीजनबांधवाः .. 158 ..
16.24.m: All their relatives and the other people fell into dejection. / “Unfitting are these words that have been spoken by the maiden!” / Having said this, her mother, people, and kinsmen all departed.

16.24.s:
sā tatraiva mahodyāne ramate sakhisaṃyutā ..
hiṃḍolake samārūḍhā vasaṃte māsi bhāmini.. .. 159 ..
16.24.d:
सा तत्रैव महोद्याने रमते सखिसंयुता ..
हिंडोलके समारूढा वसंते मासि भामिनि.. .. 159 ..
16.24.m: She continued to sport there in the great garden with her female friends, / mounted upon a swing in the month of spring, O spirited woman.

16.24.s:
tāvaddivyavimānasthaḥ śikhaṇḍī gaṇanāyakaḥ ..
gacchankhe dadṛśe kanyāṃ rūpaudāryyasamākulām .. 7.1.24.160 ..
16.24.d:
तावद्दिव्यविमानस्थः शिखण्डी गणनायकः ..
गच्छन्खे ददृशे कन्यां रूपौदार्य्यसमाकुलाम् .. 7.1.24.160 ..
16.24.m: Meanwhile, the leader of the gaṇas, Śikhaṇḍin, situated in a divine aerial chariot / as he was traveling in the sky, saw the maiden endowed with beauty and majesty,

16.24.s:
gītavādyena nṛtyena ramatīṃ dudubhisvanaiḥ ..
sa mādhyāhnikasaṃdhyāyāmavatīrya vimānataḥ .. 161 ..
16.24.d:
गीतवाद्येन नृत्येन रमतीं दुदुभिस्वनैः ..
स माध्याह्निकसंध्यायामवतीर्य विमानतः .. 161 ..
16.24.m: rejoicing with song, musical instruments, dance, and the sounds of drums. / Having descended from his aerial chariot at the midday juncture,

16.24.s:
krīḍamāno'psarobhistu tatrodyāne sthitastataḥ ..
śuśrāva vākyaṃ kanyāyā gaṃdharvaduhitustadā .. 162 ..
16.24.d:
क्रीडमानोऽप्सरोभिस्तु तत्रोद्याने स्थितस्ततः ..
शुश्राव वाक्यं कन्याया गंधर्वदुहितुस्तदा .. 162 ..
16.24.m: he remained there in that garden, sporting with the apsarases. / Then he heard the words of the maiden, the gandharva’s daughter:

16.24.s:
na ko'pi sadṛśo loke mama rūpeṇa dṛśyate ..
devo vā dānavo vāpi koṭyaṃśe mama rūpataḥ .. 163 ..
16.24.d:
न कोऽपि सदृशो लोके मम रूपेण दृश्यते ..
देवो वा दानवो वापि कोट्यंशे मम रूपतः .. 163 ..
16.24.m: “None in the world is seen equal to my beauty, / whether god or dānava, even to a ten-millionth part of my beauty.”

16.24.s:
iti vākyaṃ tataḥ śrutvā gaṇaḥ krodhasamanvitaḥ ..
śaśāpa tāṃ sucārvaṃgīṃ sāhaṃkārāṃ gaṇeśvaraḥ .. 164 ..
16.24.d:
इति वाक्यं ततः श्रुत्वा गणः क्रोधसमन्वितः ..
शशाप तां सुचार्वंगीं साहंकारां गणेश्वरः .. 164 ..
16.24.m: Then, having heard this statement, the gaṇa became filled with rage; / the lord of the gaṇas cursed that lovely-limbed, arrogant maiden.

16.24.s:
.. gaṇa uvāca .. ..
māṃ dṛṣṭvā yadviśālākṣi rūpasaubhāgyagarvitā ..
samākṣipasi gaṃdharvāndevādyāṃścaiva garvitā .. 165 ..
16.24.d:
.. गण उवाच .. ..
मां दृष्ट्वा यद्विशालाक्षि रूपसौभाग्यगर्विता ..
समाक्षिपसि गंधर्वान्देवाद्यांश्चैव गर्विता .. 165 ..
16.24.m: The gaṇa said: / “Since, having seen me, O large-eyed woman, proud of your beauty and fortune, / you deride the gandharvas, gods, and others, full of vanity,

16.24.s:
tasmātte garvasaṃyukte kuṣṭhamaṃge bhaviṣyati ..
śrutvā śāpaṃ tataḥ kanyā bhayabhītā tapasvinī .. 166 ..
16.24.d:
तस्मात्ते गर्वसंयुक्ते कुष्ठमंगे भविष्यति ..
श्रुत्वा शापं ततः कन्या भयभीता तपस्विनी .. 166 ..
16.24.m: therefore, O proud woman, there shall be leprosy upon your body!” / Hearing the curse, the poor girl became terrified with fright.

16.24.s:
sāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇipatyāthānugrahārthamayācata ..
bhagavanmama dīnāyāḥ śāpasyānugrahaṃ prabho ..
prayaccha tvaṃ mahā bhāga naivaṃ kartrī punaḥ kvacit .. 167 ..
16.24.d:
साष्टांगं प्रणिपत्याथानुग्रहार्थमयाचत ..
भगवन्मम दीनायाः शापस्यानुग्रहं प्रभो ..
प्रयच्छ त्वं महा भाग नैवं कर्त्री पुनः क्वचित् .. 167 ..
16.24.m: Prostrating with all eight limbs, she then begged for mercy: / “O lord, grant mercy from the curse unto me, a wretched woman, O master! / Grant it, O illustrious one! I shall never do such a thing again!”

16.24.s:
ityuktastava kāruṇyācchikhaṇḍī gaṇanāyakaḥ ..
anugrahaṃ dadau tasyā gaṃdharvaduhitustadā .. 168 ... ..
16.24.d:
इत्युक्तस्तव कारुण्याच्छिखण्डी गणनायकः ..
अनुग्रहं ददौ तस्या गंधर्वदुहितुस्तदा .. 168 ... ..
16.24.m: Being thus addressed, Śikhaṇḍin, the leader of the gaṇas, out of compassion / then granted mercy to her, the daughter of the gandharva.

16.24.s:
.. śikhaṇḍyuvāca .. ..
jātirūpeṇa saṃyukto vidyāhaṃkārasaṃpadā ..
yo yena garvitaḥ prāṇī sa taṃ prāpya vinaśyati .. 169 ..
16.24.d:
.. शिखण्ड्युवाच .. ..
जातिरूपेण संयुक्तो विद्याहंकारसंपदा ..
यो येन गर्वितः प्राणी स तं प्राप्य विनश्यति .. 169 ..
16.24.m: Śikhaṇḍin said: / “Endowed with birth and beauty, with learning and the wealth of ego— / whichever creature is proud of whatever quality, he perishes when possessed by it.

16.24.s:
tasmādgarvo naiva kāryo garvasyaitatphalaṃ smṛtam ..
śṛṇuṣvānugrahaṃ bāle śrutvā caivāvadhāraya .. 7.1.24.170..
16.24.d:
तस्माद्गर्वो नैव कार्यो गर्वस्यैतत्फलं स्मृतम् ..
शृणुष्वानुग्रहं बाले श्रुत्वा चैवावधारय .. 7.1.24.170..
16.24.m: Therefore, pride should never be held; this is known as the fruit of pride. / Listen to the favor, O girl, and having heard it, keep it in mind.

16.24.s:
himavadvanamadhyastho gośṛṃga ṛṣipuṃgavaḥ ..
kariṣyatyupakāraṃ sa evamuktvā gataḥ priye .. 171 ..
16.24.d:
हिमवद्वनमध्यस्थो गोशृंग ऋषिपुंगवः ..
करिष्यत्युपकारं स एवमुक्त्वा गतः प्रिये .. 171 ..
16.24.m: The foremost seer Gośṛṅga, situated in the midst of the forest of Himavat, / will perform a service for you.” Having spoken thus, O beloved, he departed.

16.24.s: tāvatsaṃdhyā samāyātā tatkṣaṇādbhuvanāṃtare .. 172 ..
16.24.d: तावत्संध्या समायाता तत्क्षणाद्भुवनांतरे .. 172 ..
16.24.m: Meanwhile, the evening twilight arrived from another realm at that very moment.

16.24.s:
tato gaṃdharvvatanayā bhagnotsāhā natānanā ..
parityajya vanaṃ ramyamāgatā pituraṃtike .. 173 ..
16.24.d:
ततो गंधर्व्वतनया भग्नोत्साहा नतानना ..
परित्यज्य वनं रम्यमागता पितुरंतिके .. 173 ..
16.24.m: Then the daughter of the gandharva, her enthusiasm shattered and her face cast down, / abandoned the delightful forest and went into the presence of her father.

16.24.s:
kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ kāraṇaṃ kuṣṭhasaṃbhavam ..
tacchrutvā śokasaṃtaptau pitarau vigataprabhau .. 174 ..
16.24.d:
कथयामास तत्सर्वं कारणं कुष्ठसंभवम् ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा शोकसंतप्तौ पितरौ विगतप्रभौ .. 174 ..
16.24.m: She recounted all that cause for the origin of the leprosy. / Hearing that, her parents, afflicted with sorrow, lost their luster.

16.24.s:
himavaṃtaṃ giriṃ prāptau tvaritau sutayā saha ..
gośṛṃgasya ṛṣestatra dadṛśāte tathāśramam .. 175 ..
16.24.d:
हिमवंतं गिरिं प्राप्तौ त्वरितौ सुतया सह ..
गोशृंगस्य ऋषेस्तत्र ददृशाते तथाश्रमम् .. 175 ..
16.24.m: Swiftly they reached the Himavat mountain along with their daughter. / There they saw the hermitage of the seer Gośṛṅga.

16.24.s:
tatra madhyasthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā gośṛṃgamṛṣipuṃgavam ..
praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmau stutvā stotrairanekadhā .. 176 ..
16.24.d:
तत्र मध्यस्थितं दृष्ट्वा गोशृंगमृषिपुंगवम् ..
प्रणम्य दण्डवद्भूमौ स्तुत्वा स्तोत्रैरनेकधा .. 176 ..
16.24.m: Seeing Gośṛṅga, the foremost seer, seated in the middle of it, / bowing down like a staff upon the ground and praising him with various hymns,

16.24.s:
upaviṣṭogratastasya praṇipatya punaḥpunaḥ ..
provāca vacanaṃ tatra pūrvavṛttaṃ yathā'bhavat .. 177 ..
16.24.d:
उपविष्टोग्रतस्तस्य प्रणिपत्य पुनःपुनः ..
प्रोवाच वचनं तत्र पूर्ववृत्तं यथाऽभवत् .. 177 ..
16.24.m: the [gandharva] sat before him; having bowed down again and again, / he spoke words there concerning what had happened before.

16.24.s:
kathite caiva vṛttāṃte punaḥ papraccha kāraṇam..
pṛṣṭe tu kāraṇe tatra gaṃdharvaḥ proktavāṃstadā .. 178 ..
16.24.d:
कथिते चैव वृत्तांते पुनः पप्रच्छ कारणम्..
पृष्टे तु कारणे तत्र गंधर्वः प्रोक्तवांस्तदा .. 178 ..
16.24.m: When the event had been told, he asked again for the remedy. / When the remedy was asked, the gandharva said then:

16.24.s:
.. gaṃdharva uvāca .. ..
duhiturme śarīraṃ tu vyādhikuṣṭhenapīḍitam ..
yenopaśamanaṃ yāti tattvaṃ karttumihārhasi .. 179 ..
16.24.d:
.. गंधर्व उवाच .. ..
दुहितुर्मे शरीरं तु व्याधिकुष्ठेनपीडितम् ..
येनोपशमनं याति तत्त्वं कर्त्तुमिहार्हसि .. 179 ..
16.24.m: The gandharva said: / “The body of my daughter is afflicted with the disease of leprosy. / You ought to do that here by which it may attain pacification.

16.24.s:
prasādaṃ kuru viprarṣe mama dīnasya sāṃpratam ..
yathā kuṣṭhaṃ śamaṃ yāti mama putryāstu kāraṇam .. .. 7.1.24.180 .. ..
16.24.d:
प्रसादं कुरु विप्रर्षे मम दीनस्य सांप्रतम् ..
यथा कुष्ठं शमं याति मम पुत्र्यास्तु कारणम् .. .. 7.1.24.180 .. ..
16.24.m: Show grace, O brahmin-seer, to me, a wretched person, right now, / so that the leprosy of my daughter may be pacified.”

16.24.s:
gośṛṃga uvāca .. ..
bhārate tu mahātejāstiṣṭhatyudadhisannidhau ..
devaḥ someśvaronāma sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ .. 181 ..
16.24.d:
गोशृंग उवाच .. ..
भारते तु महातेजास्तिष्ठत्युदधिसन्निधौ ..
देवः सोमेश्वरोनाम सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः .. 181 ..
16.24.m: Gośṛṅga said: / “In Bhārata, indeed, near the ocean, there dwells the god of great splendor, / named Someśvara, worshiped by all gods.

16.24.s:
kṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā hi saṃpūjya ekāhāreṇa mānavaiḥ ..
sarvavyādhivināśāya sarvakāryārthasiddhaye .. 182 ..
16.24.d:
क्षणं कृत्वा हि संपूज्य एकाहारेण मानवैः ..
सर्वव्याधिविनाशाय सर्वकार्यार्थसिद्धये .. 182 ..
16.24.m: Having waited for an opportune time, indeed, being worshiped by men eating one meal a day, / for the destruction of all diseases and for the accomplishment of all desired ends,

16.24.s:
somavāravrateneśaṃ samārādhaya śaṃkaram ..
evaṃ kṛte vyādhināśastava putryā bhaviṣyati .. 183 ..
16.24.d:
सोमवारव्रतेनेशं समाराधय शंकरम् ..
एवं कृते व्याधिनाशस्तव पुत्र्या भविष्यति .. 183 ..
16.24.m: propitiate the Lord Śaṃkara with the vow of Somavāra. / When this is done, the destruction of the disease will happen for your daughter.”

16.24.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā maharṣerbhāvitātmanaḥ ..
tatra gaṃtuṃ manaścakre someśārādhanaṃ prati .. 184 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śrīsomeśvara varṇane somavāravratamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 24 ..
16.24.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा महर्षेर्भावितात्मनः ..
तत्र गंतुं मनश्चक्रे सोमेशाराधनं प्रति .. 184 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये श्रीसोमेश्वर वर्णने सोमवारव्रतमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुर्विंशोऽध्यायः .. 24 ..
16.24.m:
Īśvara said: / Having heard those words of the great seer of purified mind, / he set his mind on going there, intent upon the worship of Someśa.
Thus ends the twenty-fourth chapter, entitled “Description of the Greatness of the Monday Vow in the Description of Glorious Someśvara,” in the First Prabhāsa-kṣetra-māhātmya, in the Seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.25.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
sa gandharvastadā devi ārirādhayiṣurbhavam ..
somavāravrataṃnāma papraccha munisattamam .. 1 ..
16.25.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
स गन्धर्वस्तदा देवि आरिराधयिषुर्भवम् ..
सोमवारव्रतंनाम पप्रच्छ मुनिसत्तमम् .. 1 ..
16.25.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O goddess, that gandharva, wishing to propitiate Bhava, / asked the best of sages about the vow named Somavāravrata.

16.25.s:
.. gandharva uvāca .. ..
kathaṃ somavrataṃ kāryaṃ vidhānaṃ tasya kīdṛśam ..
kasminkāle ca tatkāryaṃ sarvaṃ vistarato vada .. 2 ..
16.25.d:
.. गन्धर्व उवाच .. ..
कथं सोमव्रतं कार्यं विधानं तस्य कीदृशम् ..
कस्मिन्काले च तत्कार्यं सर्वं विस्तरतो वद .. 2 ..
16.25.m: The gandharva said: / “How is the Monday vow to be performed? What is its procedure? / And at what time is it to be observed? Tell me everything in detail.”

16.25.s:
.. gośṛṃga uvāca .. ..
sādhusādhu mahāprājña sarvasattvopakārakam ..
yanna kasyacidākhyātaṃ tadadya kathayāmi te .. 3 ..
16.25.d:
.. गोशृंग उवाच .. ..
साधुसाधु महाप्राज्ञ सर्वसत्त्वोपकारकम् ..
यन्न कस्यचिदाख्यातं तदद्य कथयामि ते .. 3 ..
16.25.m: Gośṛṅga said: / “Excellent, excellent, O greatly wise one! Beneficial to all living beings, / that which has not been declared to anyone, I shall declare to you today.

16.25.s:
sarvarogaharaṃ divyaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam ..
somavāravrataṃnāma sarvakāmaphalapradam .. 4 ..
16.25.d:
सर्वरोगहरं दिव्यं सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायकम् ..
सोमवारव्रतंनाम सर्वकामफलप्रदम् .. 4 ..
16.25.m: It dispels all diseases, is divine, and bestows all perfections; / it is named the Somavāravrata, and grants the fruits of all desires.”

16.25.s:
sarvakālikamādeyaṃ varṇānāṃ śubhakārakam ..
nārī naraiḥ sadā kāryaṃ dṛṣṭvādṛṣṭvā phalodayam .. 5 ..
16.25.d:
सर्वकालिकमादेयं वर्णानां शुभकारकम् ..
नारी नरैः सदा कार्यं दृष्ट्वादृष्ट्वा फलोदयम् .. 5 ..
16.25.m: It should be undertaken at all times, bringing welfare to all varnas. / It should always be observed by women and men, whether or not its fruition is seen.

16.25.s:
brahmaviṣṇvādibhirdevaiḥ kṛtametanmahāvratam ..
punastu somarājena dakṣaśāpahatena ca .. 6 ..
16.25.d:
ब्रह्मविष्ण्वादिभिर्देवैः कृतमेतन्महाव्रतम् ..
पुनस्तु सोमराजेन दक्षशापहतेन च .. 6 ..
16.25.m: This great vow was performed by the gods, beginning with Brahmā and Viṣṇu, / and then again by Somarāja, who had been struck down by Dakṣa's curse.

16.25.s:
ārādhito'nena śaṃbhuḥ śaṃbhudhyānapareṇa tu ..
tatastuṣṭo mahādevaḥ somarājasya bhaktitaḥ ..7 ..
16.25.d:
आराधितोऽनेन शंभुः शंभुध्यानपरेण तु ..
ततस्तुष्टो महादेवः सोमराजस्य भक्तितः ..7 ..
16.25.m: Śambhu was worshipped by him by means of this, intent as he was on meditating on Śambhu. / Thereupon Mahādeva was pleased by Somarāja's devotion.

16.25.s: tenoktaṃ yadi tuṣṭo'si pratiṣṭhāstho niraṃtaram .. 8 ..
16.25.d: तेनोक्तं यदि तुष्टोऽसि प्रतिष्ठास्थो निरंतरम् .. 8 ..
16.25.m: He said: 'If you are pleased, remain constantly installed here.

16.25.s:
yāvaccaṃdraśca sūryaśca yāvattiṣṭhaṃti bhūdharāḥ ..
tāvanme sthāpitaṃ liṃgamumayā saha tiṣṭhatu .. 9 ..
16.25.d:
यावच्चंद्रश्च सूर्यश्च यावत्तिष्ठंति भूधराः ..
तावन्मे स्थापितं लिंगमुमया सह तिष्ठतु .. 9 ..
16.25.m: As long as the moon and the sun, and as long as the mountains remain, / so long let the liṅga established by me remain together with Umā.'

16.25.s:
sthāpitaṃ tu tadā tena prārthayitvā maheśvaram ..
ātmanāmāṃkitaṃ kṛtvā tato rogairvyamucyata.. 7.1.25.10 ..
16.25.d:
स्थापितं तु तदा तेन प्रार्थयित्वा महेश्वरम् ..
आत्मनामांकितं कृत्वा ततो रोगैर्व्यमुच्यत.. 7.1.25.10 ..
16.25.m: Then, having petitioned Maheśvara, it was established by him, / marking it with his own name; thereupon he was freed from diseases.

16.25.s: tataḥ śuddhaśarīro'sau gaganastho virājate .. 11 ..
16.25.d: ततः शुद्धशरीरोऽसौ गगनस्थो विराजते .. 11 ..
16.25.m: Then, his body purified, he shines brightly situated in the sky.

16.25.s:
tadāprabhṛti ye kecitkurvaṃti bhuvi mānavāḥ ..
te'pi tatpadamāyāṃti vimalāṃgāśca somavat .. 12 ..
16.25.d:
तदाप्रभृति ये केचित्कुर्वंति भुवि मानवाः ..
तेऽपि तत्पदमायांति विमलांगाश्च सोमवत् .. 12 ..
16.25.m: From that time forward, whatever human beings on earth perform it, / they too attain that realm, their bodies spotless like the Moon.

16.25.s:
atha kiṃ bahunoktena vidhānaṃ tasya kīrttaye ..
yasminkasmiṃśca māse vā śukle somasya vāsare .. .. 13..
16.25.d:
अथ किं बहुनोक्तेन विधानं तस्य कीर्त्तये ..
यस्मिन्कस्मिंश्च मासे वा शुक्ले सोमस्य वासरे .. .. 13..
16.25.m: Now, what need of speaking at length? I shall describe its ritual procedure: / in whatever month, during the bright fortnight, on a Monday,

16.25.s:
daṃtakāṣṭhaṃ purā brāhme kṛtvā snānaṃ samācaret ..
svadharmavihitaṃ karma kṛtvā sthāne manorame .. 14 ..
16.25.d:
दंतकाष्ठं पुरा ब्राह्मे कृत्वा स्नानं समाचरेत् ..
स्वधर्मविहितं कर्म कृत्वा स्थाने मनोरमे .. 14 ..
16.25.m: having first used a tooth-stick during the brāhma-muhūrta, one should perform ritual ablution. / Having performed the rites prescribed by one's own duty, in a charming place,

16.25.s:
susame bhūtale śuddhe nyasya kumbhaṃ suśobhitam ..
cūtapallavavinyaste caṃdanena sucitrite .. 15 ..
16.25.d:
सुसमे भूतले शुद्धे न्यस्य कुम्भं सुशोभितम् ..
चूतपल्लवविन्यस्ते चंदनेन सुचित्रिते .. 15 ..
16.25.m: upon very level, pure ground, placing an auspiciously adorned pot, / set with mango shoots and beautifully painted with sandalwood,

16.25.s:
śvetavastraparīdhāne sarvābharaṇabhūṣite ..
ādau pātre tu saṃnyasya ādhārasahitaṃ śivam .. .. 16 ..
16.25.d:
श्वेतवस्त्रपरीधाने सर्वाभरणभूषिते ..
आदौ पात्रे तु संन्यस्य आधारसहितं शिवम् .. .. 16 ..
16.25.m: dressed in white garments and adorned with all ornaments, / having first placed Śiva together with his support in a vessel,

16.25.s:
aṣṭamūrtyaṣṭakaṃ dikṣu somanāthaṃ saśaktikam ..
umayā sahitaṃ tatra śvetapuṣpaiśca pūjayet .. 17 ..
16.25.d:
अष्टमूर्त्यष्टकं दिक्षु सोमनाथं सशक्तिकम् ..
उमया सहितं तत्र श्वेतपुष्पैश्च पूजयेत् .. 17 ..
16.25.m: one should worship Somanātha together with his Śakti in the directions with the group of eight forms, / accompanied by Umā, with white flowers.

16.25.s:
vividhaṃ bhakṣyabhojyaṃ ca phalaṃ vai bījapūra kam ..
anenaiva tu maṃtreṇa sarvaṃ tatraiva kārayet .. 18 ..
16.25.d:
विविधं भक्ष्यभोज्यं च फलं वै बीजपूर कम् ..
अनेनैव तु मंत्रेण सर्वं तत्रैव कारयेत् .. 18 ..
16.25.m: With various foods to chew and eat, and citron fruits, / one should carry out everything right there, with this very mantra:

16.25.s:
oṃ namaḥ paṃcavaktrāya daśabāhutrinetriṇe ..
śvetaṃ vṛṣabhamārūḍha śvetābharaṇabhūṣita .. 19 ..
16.25.d:
ओं नमः पंचवक्त्राय दशबाहुत्रिनेत्रिणे ..
श्वेतं वृषभमारूढ श्वेताभरणभूषित .. 19 ..
16.25.m: 'Oṃ, homage to the five-faced, ten-armed, three-eyed one! / O you who mount the white bull, adorned with white ornaments,

16.25.s:
umādehārddhasaṃyukta namaste sarvamūrtaye ..
anenaiva tu maṃtreṇa pūjāṃ homaṃ ca kārayet .. 7.1.25.20 ..
16.25.d:
उमादेहार्द्धसंयुक्त नमस्ते सर्वमूर्तये ..
अनेनैव तु मंत्रेण पूजां होमं च कारयेत् .. 7.1.25.20 ..
16.25.m: joined with half of Umā's body, homage to you, the embodiment of all!' / With this very mantra one should perform the worship and the fire-oblation.

16.25.s:
kṛtvaivaṃ ca dine rātrau paśyaṃścaivaṃ svapennaraḥ ..
darbhaśayyā samārūḍho dhyāyansomeśvaraṃ haram .. 21 ..
16.25.d:
कृत्वैवं च दिने रात्रौ पश्यंश्चैवं स्वपेन्नरः ..
दर्भशय्या समारूढो ध्यायन्सोमेश्वरं हरम् .. 21 ..
16.25.m: Having done this by day, during the night a man should sleep while contemplating thus, / mounted on a bed of darbha grass, meditating on Hara, Someśvara.

16.25.s:
evaṃ kṛte'ṣṭādaśānāṃ kuṣṭhānāṃ nāśanaṃ bhavet ..
dvitīye somavāre tu karaṃjaṃ dantadhāvanam .. 22 ..
16.25.d:
एवं कृतेऽष्टादशानां कुष्ठानां नाशनं भवेत् ..
द्वितीये सोमवारे तु करंजं दन्तधावनम् .. 22 ..
16.25.m: When this is done, the destruction of the eighteen kinds of leprosy occurs. / On the second Monday, a karañja tooth-stick [is to be used].

16.25.s:
devaṃ saṃpūjayetsūkṣmaṃ jyeṣṭhāśaktisamanvitam ..
śatapatraiḥ pūjayitvā madhu prāśya yathāvidhi .. 23 ..
16.25.d:
देवं संपूजयेत्सूक्ष्मं ज्येष्ठाशक्तिसमन्वितम् ..
शतपत्रैः पूजयित्वा मधु प्राश्य यथाविधि .. 23 ..
16.25.m: One should worship the subtle deity accompanied by the power Jyeṣṭhā; / having worshipped with lotuses and tasted honey according to rule,

16.25.s:
nāraṃgaṃ tatra dattvā tu śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret ..
evaṃ kṛte dvitīye tu golakṣaphalamāpnuyāt .. 24 ..
16.25.d:
नारंगं तत्र दत्त्वा तु शेषं पूर्ववदाचरेत् ..
एवं कृते द्वितीये तु गोलक्षफलमाप्नुयात् .. 24 ..
16.25.m: and offering an orange there, one should perform the rest as before. / When this is done on the second [Monday], one obtains the fruit of a hundred thousand cows.

16.25.s:
somavāre tṛtīye tu apāmārgasamudbhavam ..
daṃtakāṣṭhādikaṃ kṛtvā trinetraṃ ca prapūjayet .. 25 ..
16.25.d:
सोमवारे तृतीये तु अपामार्गसमुद्भवम् ..
दंतकाष्ठादिकं कृत्वा त्रिनेत्रं च प्रपूजयेत् .. 25 ..
16.25.m: On the third Monday, having made a tooth-stick / from the apāmārga plant and the like, one should worship the three-eyed one.

16.25.s:
phalaṃ ca dāḍimaṃ dadyājjātīpuṣpaiśca pūjayet ..
rajanyāmaṃguraṃ prāśya siddhiyuktaṃ tu pūjayet .. 26 ..
16.25.d:
फलं च दाडिमं दद्याज्जातीपुष्पैश्च पूजयेत् ..
रजन्यामंगुरं प्राश्य सिद्धियुक्तं तु पूजयेत् .. 26 ..
16.25.m: One should offer a pomegranate fruit and worship with jasmine flowers; / having tasted an sprout at night, one should worship [him] endowed with Siddhi.

16.25.s:
caturthe somavāre tu kāṣṭhamaudumbaraṃ smṛtam ..
pūjayettatra gaurīśaṃ sūkṣmayā sahitaṃ tathā .. 27 ..
16.25.d:
चतुर्थे सोमवारे तु काष्ठमौदुम्बरं स्मृतम् ..
पूजयेत्तत्र गौरीशं सूक्ष्मया सहितं तथा .. 27 ..
16.25.m: On the fourth Monday, the wood is stated to be that of the udumbara tree; / there one should worship the Lord of Gaurī together with Sūkṣmā.

16.25.s:
nārikelaphalaṃ dadyāddamanena prapūjayet ..
śarkarāṃ prāśayedrātrau jāgaraṃ caiva kārayet .. 28 ..
16.25.d:
नारिकेलफलं दद्याद्दमनेन प्रपूजयेत् ..
शर्करां प्राशयेद्रात्रौ जागरं चैव कारयेत् .. 28 ..
16.25.m: One should offer a coconut and worship with damana [leaves]; / one should taste sugar at night and keep a vigil.

16.25.s:
pañcame somavāre tu pūjayecca gaṇādhipam ..
vibhūtyā sahitaṃ devaṃ kundapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet.. 29 ..
16.25.d:
पञ्चमे सोमवारे तु पूजयेच्च गणाधिपम् ..
विभूत्या सहितं देवं कुन्दपुष्पैः प्रपूजयेत्.. 29 ..
16.25.m: On the fifth Monday, one should worship the lord of the gaṇas; / one should worship the deity accompanied by Vibhūti with kunda flowers.

16.25.s:
āśvatthaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca arghyaṃ vai drākṣayā tathā ..
mocaṃ ca prāśayedrātrāvaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 7.1.25.30 ..
16.25.d:
आश्वत्थं दन्तकाष्ठं च अर्घ्यं वै द्राक्षया तथा ..
मोचं च प्राशयेद्रात्रावश्वमेधफलं लभेत् .. 7.1.25.30 ..
16.25.m: An aśvattha tooth-stick [is used], and the water-offering is made with grapes; / and one should taste a plantain at night; one obtains the fruit of an horse sacrifice.

16.25.s:
ṣaṣṭhe somasya vāre tu surūpaṃ nāma pūjayet ..
karpūraṃ prāśayettatra bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ .. 31 ..
16.25.d:
षष्ठे सोमस्य वारे तु सुरूपं नाम पूजयेत् ..
कर्पूरं प्राशयेत्तत्र भक्त्या परमया युतः .. 31 ..
16.25.m: On the sixth Monday, one should worship the one named Surūpa; / endowed with supreme devotion, one should taste camphor there.

16.25.s:
saptame somavāre tu dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca mallikā ..
sarvajñaṃ pūjayettatra dīptayā sahitaṃ tathā .. 32 ..
16.25.d:
सप्तमे सोमवारे तु दन्तकाष्ठं च मल्लिका ..
सर्वज्ञं पूजयेत्तत्र दीप्तया सहितं तथा .. 32 ..
16.25.m: On the seventh Monday, the tooth-stick is of mallikā; / there one should worship the Omniscient One, together with Dīptā.

16.25.s:
jambīraṃ ca phalaṃ dadyājjātīpuṣpaiśca pūjayet ..
lavaṅgaṃ prāśayettatra tasyānantaphalaṃ bhavet .. 33 ..
16.25.d:
जम्बीरं च फलं दद्याज्जातीपुष्पैश्च पूजयेत् ..
लवङ्गं प्राशयेत्तत्र तस्यानन्तफलं भवेत् .. 33 ..
16.25.m: One should offer a lime fruit and worship with jasmine flowers; / one should taste clove there; its fruit is endless.

16.25.s:
aṣṭame somavāre tu amoghāyutamīśvaram ..
kadalīphalakenārghyaṃ marubakena pūjayet ..
rātrau tu prāśayeddugdhamagniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet .. 34 ..
16.25.d:
अष्टमे सोमवारे तु अमोघायुतमीश्वरम् ..
कदलीफलकेनार्घ्यं मरुबकेन पूजयेत् ..
रात्रौ तु प्राशयेद्दुग्धमग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत् .. 34 ..
16.25.m: On the eighth Monday, [one should worship] Īśvara accompanied by Amoghā; / one should offer the water-offering with a plantain fruit and worship with marubaka; / at night one should consume milk; one obtains the fruit of the Agniṣṭoma sacrifice.

16.25.s:
gaṃgāsnāne kṛte samyakkoṭidhā yatphalaṃ smṛtam ..
daśahemasahasrāṇāṃ kurukṣetre ravergrahe .. 35 ..
16.25.d:
गंगास्नाने कृते सम्यक्कोटिधा यत्फलं स्मृतम् ..
दशहेमसहस्राणां कुरुक्षेत्रे रवेर्ग्रहे .. 35 ..
16.25.m: Whatever fruit is remembered as being multiplied ten-millionfold upon making a proper ablution in the Gaṅgā, / [or by the gift] of ten thousand [pieces] of gold at Kurukṣetra during a solar eclipse,

16.25.s:
brāhmaṇe vedaviduṣe yaddattvā phala māpnuyāt ..
tatpuṇyaṃ koṭiguṇitamasminnācarite vrate .. 36 ..
16.25.d:
ब्राह्मणे वेदविदुषे यद्दत्त्वा फल माप्नुयात् ..
तत्पुण्यं कोटिगुणितमस्मिन्नाचरिते व्रते .. 36 ..
16.25.m: whatever fruit one obtains by giving to a brahmin learned in the Vedas, / that merit is multiplied ten-millionfold when this vow is performed.

16.25.s:
gajānāṃ tu śate datte lakṣe ca rathavājinām..
tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ somavāravrate kṛte .. 37 ..
16.25.d:
गजानां तु शते दत्ते लक्षे च रथवाजिनाम्..
तत्फलं कोटिगुणितं सोमवारव्रते कृते .. 37 ..
16.25.m: Whatever fruit [comes] when a hundred elephants and a hundred thousand chariot-horses are given, / that fruit is multiplied ten-millionfold when the Monday vow is performed.

16.25.s:
guggulordhūpanaṃ kṛtvā koṭiśo yatphalaṃ labhet ..
tatpuṇyaṃ tu bhavettasya somavāravrate kṛte .. 38 ..
16.25.d:
गुग्गुलोर्धूपनं कृत्वा कोटिशो यत्फलं लभेत् ..
तत्पुण्यं तु भवेत्तस्य सोमवारव्रते कृते .. 38 ..
16.25.m: Whatever fruit one obtains ten-millionfold by burning guggulu incense, / that merit belongs to him when the Monday vow is performed.

16.25.s:
sarvaiśvaryasamāyuktaḥ śivatulyaparākramaḥ ..
rudraloke vasettāvadbrahmaṇaḥ pralayāvadhi .. 39 ..
16.25.d:
सर्वैश्वर्यसमायुक्तः शिवतुल्यपराक्रमः ..
रुद्रलोके वसेत्तावद्ब्रह्मणः प्रलयावधि .. 39 ..
16.25.m: Endowed with all sovereignty, with prowess equal to Śiva's, / he dwells in the realm of Rudra until the dissolution of Brahmā.

16.25.s:
saṃprāpte navame vāre kuryādudyāpanaṃ śubham ..
yathā bhavati gandharva tathā vakṣyāmi te'dhunā .. 7.1.25.40 ..
16.25.d:
संप्राप्ते नवमे वारे कुर्यादुद्यापनं शुभम् ..
यथा भवति गन्धर्व तथा वक्ष्यामि तेऽधुना .. 7.1.25.40 ..
16.25.m: When the ninth Monday arrives, one should perform the auspicious concluding rite. / O Gandharva, I shall now tell you how it is performed.

16.25.s:
maṃḍalaṃ maṃḍapaṃ kuṇḍaṃ patākādhvajaśobhitam ..
toraṇāni ca catvāri kuṇḍaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ .. 41 ..
16.25.d:
मंडलं मंडपं कुण्डं पताकाध्वजशोभितम् ..
तोरणानि च चत्वारि कुण्डं कृत्वा विधानतः .. 41 ..
16.25.m: A circle, a pavilion, and a sacrificial pit adorned with banners and flags, / and four archways, having made a sacrificial pit according to the rule,

16.25.s:
madhye vediḥ prakarttavyā caturasrā suśobhanā ..
niṣpādya maṃḍalaṃ tatra madhye padmaṃ prakalpayet .. 42 ..
16.25.d:
मध्ये वेदिः प्रकर्त्तव्या चतुरस्रा सुशोभना ..
निष्पाद्य मंडलं तत्र मध्ये पद्मं प्रकल्पयेत् .. 42 ..
16.25.m: an altar should be constructed in the middle, four-cornered and very beautiful. / Having drawn a maṇḍala there, one should fashion a lotus in the middle.

16.25.s:
kalaśānaṣṭadigbhāge sahiraṇyānpṛthakpṛthak ..
sthāpayitvā tu śaktistā vāmādyāḥ pūrvataḥ kramāt.. 43 ..
16.25.d:
कलशानष्टदिग्भागे सहिरण्यान्पृथक्पृथक् ..
स्थापयित्वा तु शक्तिस्ता वामाद्याः पूर्वतः क्रमात्.. 43 ..
16.25.m: Having placed pots in the eight directions, separately, each with gold, / [and having invoked] those powers, Vāmā and the others, in order starting from the east,

16.25.s:
karṇikāyāṃ tu padmasya śrīsomeśaṃ mahāprabham..
pratimārūpasaṃpannaṃ hemajaṃ śaktisaṃyutam .. 44 ..
16.25.d:
कर्णिकायां तु पद्मस्य श्रीसोमेशं महाप्रभम्..
प्रतिमारूपसंपन्नं हेमजं शक्तिसंयुतम् .. 44 ..
16.25.m: upon the pericarp of the lotus, [one should install] the glorious Someśa, the great lord, / fashioned as an image made of gold, endowed with his power,

16.25.s:
rukmaśayyāsamārūḍhaṃ manonmanyā samanvitam ..
hemapātrādike pātre madhunā paripūrite .. 45 ..
16.25.d:
रुक्मशय्यासमारूढं मनोन्मन्या समन्वितम् ..
हेमपात्रादिके पात्रे मधुना परिपूरिते .. 45 ..
16.25.m: mounted upon a golden couch, accompanied by Manonmanī. / In a gold vessel or other vessel filled with honey,

16.25.s:
rukmaśayyāsamācchanne tatrasthaṃ pūjayetkramāt ..
anaṃtādiśikhaṃḍyaṃtairnāmabhiḥ kramaśo'rcayet .. 46 ..
16.25.d:
रुक्मशय्यासमाच्छन्ने तत्रस्थं पूजयेत्क्रमात् ..
अनंतादिशिखंड्यंतैर्नामभिः क्रमशोऽर्चयेत् .. 46 ..
16.25.m: covered with a golden bed, one should worship him situated there in due order; / one should worship him successively with names beginning with Ananta and ending with Śikhaṇḍin.

16.25.s:
gandhasragdhūpadīpaiśca naivedyaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ ..
vastrālaṃkāratāṃbūlacchatracāmaradarppaṇam .. 47 ..
16.25.d:
गन्धस्रग्धूपदीपैश्च नैवेद्यैश्च पृथग्विधैः ..
वस्त्रालंकारतांबूलच्छत्रचामरदर्प्पणम् .. 47 ..
16.25.m: With scents, garlands, incenses, lamps, and various kinds of food-offerings, / garments, ornaments, betel, umbrella, chowrie, and mirror,

16.25.s:
dīpaghaṃṭāvitānaṃ ca paryaṃkaṃ ca satū likam ..
someśvaraṃ samuddiśya deyaṃ paurāṇike gurau .. 48 ..
16.25.d:
दीपघंटावितानं च पर्यंकं च सतू लिकम् ..
सोमेश्वरं समुद्दिश्य देयं पौराणिके गुरौ .. 48 ..
16.25.m: a lamp, a bell, a canopy, and a couch with a mattress— / dedicating them to Someśvara, they should be given to the Purāṇic guru.

16.25.s:
bhūṣayitvā tathā''cāryyaṃ homaṃ tatraiva kārayet ..
balikarmāvasāne ca rātrau tatraiva jāgṛyāt .. 49 ..
16.25.d:
भूषयित्वा तथा'ऽचार्य्यं होमं तत्रैव कारयेत् ..
बलिकर्मावसाने च रात्रौ तत्रैव जागृयात् .. 49 ..
16.25.m: Having thus adorned the ācārya, one should perform the fire-oblation right there; / and at the end of the offering-rite, one should keep a vigil right there at night.

16.25.s:
pañcagavyaṃ tataḥ pītvā dhyāyetsomeśvaraṃ hṛdi ..
prabhāte tu tataḥ snātvā dhyāyettaṃ ca vidhānataḥ .. 7.1.25.50 ..
16.25.d:
पञ्चगव्यं ततः पीत्वा ध्यायेत्सोमेश्वरं हृदि ..
प्रभाते तु ततः स्नात्वा ध्यायेत्तं च विधानतः .. 7.1.25.50 ..
16.25.m: Then, having drunk the five products of the cow, one should meditate on Someśvara in one's heart. / In the morning, having bathed, one should meditate on him according to the prescribed rules. 50.

16.25.s:
tato bhaktyā ca gaṃdharva kṣīrakhaṇḍādinirmmitam ..
bhakṣyabhojyairanekaiśca bhojayedbrāhmaṇānatha .. 51 ..
16.25.d:
ततो भक्त्या च गंधर्व क्षीरखण्डादिनिर्म्मितम् ..
भक्ष्यभोज्यैरनेकैश्च भोजयेद्ब्राह्मणानथ .. 51 ..
16.25.m: Then with devotion, O Gandharva, he should feed the brahmins / with various foods and refreshments prepared with sweetmeats and milk. 51.

16.25.s: vastrayugmaṃ tato dattvā gāṃ ca dattvā visarjayet .. 52 ..
16.25.d: वस्त्रयुग्मं ततो दत्त्वा गां च दत्त्वा विसर्जयेत् .. 52 ..
16.25.m: Then, having given a pair of garments and given a cow, he should dismiss them. 52.

16.25.s:
evaṃ cīrṇavrataḥ samyaglabhate puṇyamakṣayam ..
dhanadhānyasamṛddhātmā putradārasamanvitaḥ .. 53 ..
16.25.d:
एवं चीर्णव्रतः सम्यग्लभते पुण्यमक्षयम् ..
धनधान्यसमृद्धात्मा पुत्रदारसमन्वितः .. 53 ..
16.25.m: One who has properly performed this vow attains imperishable religious merit, / enriched with wealth and grain, endowed with sons and a wife. 53.

16.25.s:
na kule jāyate tasya daridro duḥkhito'pivā ..
aputro labhate putrānvandhyā putravatī bhavet .. 54 ..
16.25.d:
न कुले जायते तस्य दरिद्रो दुःखितोऽपिवा ..
अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रान्वन्ध्या पुत्रवती भवेत् .. 54 ..
16.25.m: In his family, no one is born poor or miserable; / one who has no son obtains sons, and a barren woman becomes a mother of sons. 54.

16.25.s:
kākavaṃdhyā tu yā nārī mṛtavatsā ca durbhagā ..
kanyāprasūśca yā kāryamābhiretadviśeṣataḥ .. 55 ..
16.25.d:
काकवंध्या तु या नारी मृतवत्सा च दुर्भगा ..
कन्याप्रसूश्च या कार्यमाभिरेतद्विशेषतः .. 55 ..
16.25.m: A woman who bears only one child, one whose children die, an unfortunate woman, / and one who gives birth only to daughters—this [vow] should especially be undertaken by them. 55.

16.25.s:
evaṃ kṛte vidhāne tu dehapāte śivaṃ vrajet ..
kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi kalpakoṭiśatāni ca ..
bhuṃkte'sau vipulānbho gānyāvadābhūtasaṃplavam .. 56 ..
16.25.d:
एवं कृते विधाने तु देहपाते शिवं व्रजेत् ..
कल्पकोटिसहस्राणि कल्पकोटिशतानि च ..
भुंक्तेऽसौ विपुलान्भो गान्यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् .. 56 ..
16.25.m: When the rite has been performed thus, at the fall of the body he goes to Śiva. / For thousands of crores of kalpas and hundreds of crores of kalpas, / until the dissolution of all beings, he enjoys vast pleasures. 56.

16.25.s:
iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ somavāravrataṃ kramāt ..
gaccha śīghraṃ mahābhāga yatra someśvaraḥ sthitaḥ .. 57 ..
16.25.d:
इति ते कथितं सर्वं सोमवारव्रतं क्रमात् ..
गच्छ शीघ्रं महाभाग यत्र सोमेश्वरः स्थितः .. 57 ..
16.25.m: Thus the entire Monday vow has been declared to you in due order. / Go swiftly, O fortunate one, where Someśvara resides. 57.

16.25.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
ityuktaḥ saca gandharvaḥ putryā saha varānane ..
sarvopahārasaṃyuktaḥ prabhāsakṣetramāśritaḥ .. 58 ..
16.25.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
इत्युक्तः सच गन्धर्वः पुत्र्या सह वरानने ..
सर्वोपहारसंयुक्तः प्रभासक्षेत्रमाश्रितः .. 58 ..
16.25.m: Īśvara said: / Thus addressed, O fair-faced one, that Gandharva, together with his daughter / and equipped with all offerings, took refuge in Prabhāsa-kṣetra. 58.

16.25.s:
tatra someśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā ānandāśrupariplutaḥ ..
yātrākrameṇa saṃpūjya cakre somavrataṃ kramāt .. 59 ..
16.25.d:
तत्र सोमेश्वरं दृष्ट्वा आनन्दाश्रुपरिप्लुतः ..
यात्राक्रमेण संपूज्य चक्रे सोमव्रतं क्रमात् .. 59 ..
16.25.m: Beholding Someśvara there, overwhelmed with tears of joy, / having worshipped according to the procedure of the pilgrimage, he performed the Soma-vow in due order. 59.

16.25.s:
putryā saha mahābhāgastasya tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ..
sarvarogavināśaṃ ca sarvakāmasamṛddhidam..
dadau gandharvarājyaṃ ca bhaktiṃ caivātmanastathā .. 69 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetra māhātmye someśvaramāhātmyavarṇane gandharvakanyāvṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 25 ..
16.25.d:
पुत्र्या सह महाभागस्तस्य तुष्टो महेश्वरः..
सर्वरोगविनाशं च सर्वकामसमृद्धिदम्..
ददौ गन्धर्वराज्यं च भक्तिं चैवात्मनस्तथा .. 69 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्र माहात्म्ये सोमेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णने गन्धर्वकन्यावृत्तान्तवर्णनंनाम पञ्चविंशोऽध्यायः .. 25 ..
16.25.m:
Together with his daughter, that fortunate one [worshipped him, and] Maheśvara was pleased with him. / The destroyer of all diseases, the granter of the fulfillment of all desires, / he gave [him] the kingdom of the Gandharvas and devotion to himself. 69.
Thus ends the twenty-fifth chapter, named 'The Narrative of the Gandharva's Daughter,' in the description of the māhātmya of Someśvara, in the first Māhātmya of Prabhāsa-kṣetra, in the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the venerable Skanda-Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 25.

16.26.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
atha labdhavarastatra kṛtārtho bhaktisaṃyutaḥ..
sthāpayāmāsa liṃgaṃ sa gandharvo ghanavāhanaḥ..
someśāduttare bhāge daṃḍapāṇisamīpataḥ..
gandharveśvaranāmānaṃ gāndharvaphaladāyakam..2..
16.26.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
अथ लब्धवरस्तत्र कृतार्थो भक्तिसंयुतः..
स्थापयामास लिंगं स गन्धर्वो घनवाहनः..
सोमेशादुत्तरे भागे दंडपाणिसमीपतः..
गन्धर्वेश्वरनामानं गान्धर्वफलदायकम्..2..
16.26.m: Īśvara said: / Then, having obtained the boon there, fulfilled in his purpose, full of devotion, / that Gandharva Ghanavāhana installed a liṅga / to the north of Someśa, near Daṇḍapāṇi, / named Gandharveśvara, which bestows the fruit of the Gandharva state. 2.

16.26.s:
varadāvāruṇe bhāge dhanuṣāṃ pañcake sthitam..
pañcamyāṃ pūjayitvā ca na duḥkhī jāyate naraḥ..
iti śrī skānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gandharveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ .. 26 ..
16.26.d:
वरदावारुणे भागे धनुषां पञ्चके स्थितम्..
पञ्चम्यां पूजयित्वा च न दुःखी जायते नरः..
इति श्री स्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये गन्धर्वेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षड्विंशतितमो ऽध्यायः .. 26 ..
16.26.m: It stands five bow-lengths to the western side of Varadā. / Having worshipped it on the fifth lunar day, a man does not suffer misery. / Thus ends the twenty-sixth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Gandharveśvara,' in the first Māhātmya of Prabhāsa-kṣetra, in the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the venerable Skanda-Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 26.

16.27.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
atha tatraiva deveśi liṃgaṃ gandharvasenayā ..
sthāpitaṃ ghanavāhasya putryā gaurīsamīpataḥ .. 1 ..
16.27.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
अथ तत्रैव देवेशि लिंगं गन्धर्वसेनया ..
स्थापितं घनवाहस्य पुत्र्या गौरीसमीपतः .. 1 ..
16.27.m: Īśvara said: / Then right there, O goddess of gods, a liṅga was installed / by Gandharvasenā, the daughter of Ghanavāhana, near Gaurī. 1.

16.27.s:
dhanuṣāṃ tritaye tatra sthitaṃ pūrvavibhāgataḥ ..
vimaleśvaranāmānaṃ sarvarogavināśanam .. 2 ..
16.27.d:
धनुषां त्रितये तत्र स्थितं पूर्वविभागतः ..
विमलेश्वरनामानं सर्वरोगविनाशनम् .. 2 ..
16.27.m: It stands three bow-lengths from there in the eastern direction, / named Vimaleśvara, the destroyer of all diseases. 2.
Having worshipped it on the third lunar day, a woman is freed from misfortunes; / established among sons and grandsons, she obtains all desires. 3.

16.27.s:
iti vrataṃ mahādevi tretāsaṃdhyāṃśake gate ..
gandharvasyaivamākhyātaṃ śrutaṃ pātakanāśanam.. 4 ..
16.27.d:
इति व्रतं महादेवि त्रेतासंध्यांशके गते ..
गन्धर्वस्यैवमाख्यातं श्रुतं पातकनाशनम्.. 4 ..
16.27.m: Thus, O great goddess, when the twilight portion of the Tretā age had passed, / this vow of the Gandharva was proclaimed; having been heard, it destroys sin. 4.

16.27.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gandharvaseneśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 27 .. .. ..
16.27.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये गन्धर्वसेनेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तविंशोऽध्यायः .. .. 27 .. .. ..
16.27.m: Thus ends the twenty-seventh chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Gandharvaseneśvara,' in the first Māhātmya of Prabhāsa-kṣetra, in the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the venerable Skanda-Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 27.
